confirmed.title: 晚上 7 点后启动或回到前台必定闪退（遮荫时段的 Range 越界）
confirmed.evidence: shadedFromHour 用 for h in hour...18，refreshWeatherTip 传入 max(hour, 14)。香港时间到 19:00 或之后就变成 19...18，触发 Fatal error: Range requires lowerBound <= upperBound。实测：在 iPhone Air 用 -demo -skipOnboarding -hour 19.5 启动，地图一装好就闪退。崩溃报告 StreetWalk-2026-10-08-152242.ips 的调用栈是 ShadeService.shadedFromHour:37 ← refreshWeatherTip:129 ← applyLiveWeather ← refreshLiveWeather。单独调用 shadedFromHour(after:19) 也以 SIGTRAP 结束。会触发的情况有三种：19:00 后启动或回到前台（appActive→refreshLiveWeather）；App 一直开着，keepFresh 定时刷新时跨过 19:00；时间滑杆拉到最右的 19:00（Slider 6...19）。
confirmed.rule: 不得闪退；F9 要在「前一晚或当天出门前」提示，晚上正是要用的时段
confirmed.fix: 在 shadedFromHour 开头加 guard hour <= 18 else { return nil }，或改用 stride(from: hour, through: 18, by: 1)。晚上改为计算明天的时段。补 after: 19、after: 23 两个单元测试。

verdict.reason:
I tried to disprove this and couldn't. The report is accurate. At ios/StreetWalk/Shade/ShadeService.swift:37 the loop is `for h in hour...18`. Its only caller is ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Places.swift:129, which passes `after: max(hour, 14)`, and `hour` there is the Hong Kong hour of `now`. `now` is the demo hour if one is set, otherwise the real `Date()` (AppStore.swift:103). From 19:00 to 23:59 the range becomes 19...18, and Swift traps on a closed range whose start is past its end ("Range requires lowerBound <= upperBound"). The `if let shade` guard only means the crash waits until the map has loaded. Every caller of refreshWeatherTip hits it:
(1) appActive(true) runs refreshLiveWeather, then applyLiveWeather (AppStore+Services.swift:8), on every launch and every return to foreground.
(2) The hko.keepFresh periodic refresh (AppStore+Services.swift:9) hits it while the app stays open across 19:00.
(3) The time slider runs 6...19 (Demo.swift:106). Its onChange calls store.setDemoHour(19), and setDemoHour calls refreshWeatherTip (AppStore+Map.swift:184).
(4) setWeather from the demo menu also hits it after 19:00.
The crash report ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/StreetWalk-2026-10-08-152242.ips does exist. Its stack is _assertionFailure ← ShadeService.shadedFromHour ← refreshWeatherTip ← applyLiveWeather ← refreshLiveWeather(force:), which matches the claim. None of the settled decisions cover this: "shade only roughly accurate" is about precision, not crashes. Evening is also when F9's "night before" prompt is supposed to run. The app crashes after 19:00 in real use, and on stage if the slider is dragged to the end.
verdict.fix: Minimal fix: in ShadeService.shadedFromHour (ShadeService.swift:37), add `guard hour <= 18 else { return nil }` before the loop, or change it to `for h in stride(from: hour, through: 18, by: 1)`. With nil, walkAdvice falls back to the tip without a shade time, so behavior stays sensible. Optional: after 19:00, have refreshWeatherTip pass tomorrow's date (`day: now + 86400`, `after: 14`) so the night-before tip shows tomorrow's shade time. Add unit tests for `after: 19` and `after: 23` in StreetWalkTests. Effort S (a few lines plus 2 tests).

confirmed.title: 语音改地标名不复述就生效（全圈都改），「撤回」撤不回，「講新名」按钮实际不能用
confirmed.evidence: handle() 的 .rename 分支把 needsConfirm 设为 false，并立刻调用 rename()：新名字写入 landmarkNames，调用 community.renameLandmark，同时播报「同圈嘅街坊都會見到」。复述卡显示「撤回」，按下后调用 rejectVoice()，但它的 switch 只处理 invite、leave、report、changeMeetup，.rename 走 default: break，所以卡片关掉了，名字却没改回，4 秒后卡片自动消失。复现：说「涼亭改名做大樹底」再按「撤回」，地标仍叫大樹底。识别错一个字也会直接改错全圈的地名。另外，InfoCard 改名模式下的「講新名」按钮调用 micTapped()，但 handle() 不看 store.renaming，TemplateAI 只认「X改名做Y」这种句式。用户照提示只讲新名（例如「大樹底」），会得到 .unknown：App 回「未聽明白」并弹出「揀一句」，列表里也没有改名选项。DemoScript 字幕和 prototype_status 却都说影响别人的动作一定先复述再按「好」。
confirmed.rule: 已定决定：影响别人的语音动作要先复述再按「好」，每个语音操作都有按钮入口；F3：改名对同圈所有用户生效；按钮的实际效果要和文字一致
confirmed.fix: .rename 一律设 needsConfirm: true，到 confirmVoice 里才调用 rename()。handle() 开头加判断：renaming != nil 且意图不是改名时，把整句当成新名，生成确认卡「X 改名做 Y？」。改名时 ListeningCard 的提示改为「講新名，例如『大樹底』」。如果对已生效的改名保留「撤回」，就让 VoiceCard 带上 oldName，rejectVoice 把名字改回旧名并通知 community。补单元测试，断言 rename 卡设了 needsConfirm。修好后更新 prototype_status。

verdict.reason:
I tried to disprove this and could not. The code backs every main point.
(1) In ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Voice.swift:65-68, the .rename case builds the VoiceCard with needsConfirm: false and calls rename(id, to: name) straight away. rename() in ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Places.swift:21-31 writes landmarkNames, which is persisted. It calls community.renameLandmark and scene.renameLandmark, then speaks "同圈嘅街坊都會見到". Spec F3 (docs/产品定稿:56) says a rename applies to everyone in the circle, so it affects other people. That breaks the settled rule that any voice action affecting others is read back first and needs 「好」. It also contradicts docs/prototype_status.md:36 and :47 ("现在所有会影响别人的操作已经都要复述确认") and the caption at DemoScript.swift:35. This is a bug, not one of the settled decisions: the settled rule actually requires the confirm step.
(2) For a non-confirm card, VoiceCard shows 「撤回」 (Overlays.swift:517-531), which calls rejectVoice(). rejectVoice() (AppStore+Voice.swift:109-118) only handles invite, leave, report and changeMeetup. .rename falls to default: break, so the card closes and the new name stays and stays saved. The button says one thing and does another. Also, VoiceCard (Models.swift:134) has no field for the old name, so the rename cannot be undone as written.
(3) 「講新名」 (Cards.swift:164-174) only calls micTapped(). handle() never checks store.renaming. TemplateAI.swift:31-36 needs "<existing landmark name>改名做<new name>". Saying just "大樹底", or even "改名做大樹底" with nothing in front, returns .unknown. The app then says 「未聽明白」 and opens the phrase picker. While listening, the hint shows suggestedPhrases.first, which is usually the invite sentence. So the button cannot do what its label says.
One small overstatement: the default suggestedPhrases (AppStore+Voice.swift:41) does include "<first landmark>改名做大樹底". It only appears when there is no walk, find or appointment, and it is for landmarks.first, not necessarily the selected landmark. This does not change the conclusion.
On severity: there is no crash and no privacy problem. In the demo, LocalCommunity.renameLandmark is a no-op, so the change only spreads to "the whole circle" in principle, and the user can rename the landmark back. That is why I rate it medium rather than high. It still breaks a settled interaction rule, the docs say the opposite, and one button does nothing useful.
verdict.fix:
AppStore+Voice.swift:
(a) In the .rename case of handle(), set needsConfirm: true and delete the immediate rename(id, to: name) call.
(b) In confirmVoice(), add `case .rename(let id, let name): rename(id, to: name)`. rejectVoice() needs no change, because with confirm in place 「唔係」 just discards the card.
(c) At the top of handle(), after parsing: if `let id = renaming` and the intent is not .rename (and not .leave or .report), take the trimmed text as the new name. Set the intent to .rename(landmarkID: id, newName: text) and show the same confirm card, titled 「<old name>改名做<new name>？」.
(d) Optional: while renaming != nil, have ListeningCard show the hint 「講新名，例如『大樹底』」 instead of phrases.first.
Tests: add a unit test asserting that handle("涼亭改名做大樹底") produces voiceCard?.needsConfirm == true and leaves the name unchanged until confirmVoice() runs.
Effort: S, about 15–20 lines. Once the fix is in, prototype_status.md:36 and :47 become accurate again and need no edit.

confirmed.title: 语音约非街坊时会说出对方楼层（名字和楼层被对上），所有居民的真名都交给了 AI
confirmed.evidence: 构造 AIContext 时传入 residents: residents，非街坊的真名也在里面。复现：演示模式下还没碰过黃太时，说或选「約黃太聽日行」。TemplateAI 用 text.contains(name) 匹配到黃太，返回 .invite；A 侧 guard p.isNeighbor 不通过，于是用文字加语音提示「你同3 樓仲未係街坊」。逐个试常见称呼，就能把非街坊的名字和楼层一一对上，还能确认对方在这个圈里。以后换成云端模型，非街坊的名字还会发给模型服务商。Contracts.swift:19 的注释写的是 AIContext 只给 AI 看最少的信息。
confirmed.rule: F4：非街坊之间不显示姓名、照片和门牌；backend_supabase.md：非街坊只显示楼层；Contracts 中 AIContext 的注释
confirmed.fix: AIContext 只放「我」和街坊。匹配不到街坊时，统一回答不带楼层、也不确认对方存在的句子，例如「你講嘅人仲未係你街坊，見到面碰一碰先可以約」。CommunityService 对非街坊不返回 name（Resident.name 改为可选）。补单元测试：用非街坊的名字发起约人，结果不含楼层。

verdict.reason:
I tried to refute this and could not. I checked every step in the code.

1. AppStore+Voice.swift:48 builds the AI context from the full `residents` list. In LocalCommunityService.circleMembers (Community.swift:83-92), every 示範 resident has a real `name`, including non-neighbours.

2. In TemplateAI.swift:45-50 (B's code), the phrase 「約黃太聽日行」 matches 黃太 by name and returns `.invite(wong, 1, nil)`. 黃太 is not a neighbour unless a saved link exists or the app was launched with -withNeighbor, and that flag only applies to residents[0], 陳太.

3. AppStore+Voice.swift:53 (A's code) then calls toast("你同\(p.floorLabel)仲未係街坊…"). toast() shows the text and also speaks it (AppStore.swift:160-162). So the app says aloud that 黃太 lives on 3 樓.

Why this matters: the leaderboard shows non-neighbours as floor plus daily line, e.g. 「3 樓今日行到…」, and Cards.swift:269 hides their names. So matching a name to a floor also tells you where that person walked today and their streak. That breaks three things:
- F4: 非街坊之间不显示姓名.
- backend_supabase.md:126: the leaderboard gives only floor and the like; a nickname is added only for people who are already neighbours.
- The comment at Contracts.swift:19, which says the AI context holds 最少信息.

This is not covered by any 已定决定. The 示範 residents are simulated, but the leaking logic is A's own product code, and it would carry over to real data.

Things that lower the severity:
- The tap-a-phrase list (suggestedPhrases) only uses neighbours' names, so the leak happens only when someone speaks a non-neighbour's name.
- In single-device demo mode the 'victims' are fake people.
- The audience would have to guess a name.

So I rate it medium, not high.

The goFind path (Voice.swift:60) and the change/cancel paths do not reveal the floor. AppStore+Meetup.swift:9 shows the floor only when the person was already picked from a floor-only entry, so that path leaks nothing new.
verdict.fix:
This is a small fix, all in A's code (S).

1. AppStore+Voice.swift:48: build the context from `residents.filter { $0.isMe || $0.isNeighbor }` so non-neighbours' names never reach the AI. A non-neighbour's name then comes back as `.unknown` (「未聽明白」), which neither shows a floor nor confirms the person exists.

2. AppStore+Voice.swift:53, as a backstop: drop the floor from the message, e.g. toast("你講嘅人仲未係你街坊。見到面碰一碰，先可以約。").

3. Add a test in CoreTests: put a non-neighbour in residents, have the store handle 「約<name>聽日行」, and assert that no toast or voice card contains that resident's floorLabel.

Side effect of step 1 to note: 「取消/改 同<non-neighbour>嘅約」 will no longer match that name, so it falls back to the latest appointment. That is acceptable, because the confirmation card names the actual partner and needs 「好」 before anything happens.

Making Resident.name optional so CommunityService never returns non-neighbour names is the long-term fix, but it is a bigger change and not needed now.

confirmed.title: 知情同意没讲清「谁能看到什么」，第三句与实际相反，也不能拒绝或重听
confirmed.evidence: 同意页的文字和语音只有三句：自动记录、位置只用地标讲、「只有你碰過一碰嘅街坊，先見到你喺邊」。但排行榜对同圈所有人（包括非街坊）都显示你的楼层、小人（轮椅等）、连续天数、请假状态，还有 dailyLine 生成的每日一句，例如「12 樓今日行到涼亭」或「喺X坐咗陣」。散步途中 markPassed 每经过一个地标就更新这一句，非街坊几乎能实时知道你去过哪里。以下几点完全没说：反映会匿名汇总交给屋邨管理和社工；改地标名全圈可见；街坊会收到你的出门提醒；家附近约 560 m 的格子会发给第三方 Overpass 镜像（包括 maps.mail.ru）；语音可能经 Apple 服务器识别（Speech.swift 没有设 requiresOnDeviceRecognition）；原始轨迹只留在手机。选楼层那一步也没说楼层会被全圈看到。同意页只有一个「好」按钮，没有「唔同意」和「再聽一次」，设置里也没有入口重看。
confirmed.rule: §4：首次使用时用语音说明「谁能看到什么」，完成知情同意；诚实原则
confirmed.fix: 按受众重写，文字和语音同步。同圈但没碰过的人：看到座数和楼层、小人、连续天数、今日一句（会提到地标），看不到名字。街坊：另外看到名字和出门时在哪个地标附近。屋邨管理和社工：只收到 10 人以上的匿名汇总。第三方：地图格子会发给 OpenStreetMap（Overpass），语音识别可能经过 Apple。原始轨迹只留在手机。删掉或改写「只有街坊先見到你喺邊」。选楼层页加一句「同圈嘅人會見到你住幾樓」。每日一句改成回家后才更新。加「再聽一次」和「唔同意」（不同意就只用本机、不进圈），设置页加「私隱說明」入口可以重看。

verdict.reason:
This is a real problem, but smaller than the report says. §4 requires a spoken explanation of "谁能看到什么" (who can see what) at first use. The consent page (ios/StreetWalk/UI/Onboarding.swift:156-159, with the same speech at :204) only says that recording is automatic, that places are named by landmark, and that only bumped neighbours can see where you are. It never says what other people in your circle who are not your neighbours can see. By spec F4 and docs/backend_supabase.md:12 and :126, they see your floor (plus block), your avatar, your streak, and a daily line that names a landmark, such as "8 樓今日行到涼亭" (Tabs.swift:441-447; Models.swift:26 shows only the floor for non-neighbours). The app demonstrates this: the leaderboard shows non-neighbours' landmark lines. So a user would infer that everyone in the circle sees their landmarks too, while the consent suggests no one but neighbours knows where they go. The floor step (Onboarding.swift:385-436) also never says the floor is shown to the whole circle. The avatar step (:507) does mention the leaderboard, but only for the avatar.

Parts of the report go too far. The third sentence is incomplete, not "the opposite of reality": neighbours really do get the "出門喺X附近" reminders. The "near-real-time leak" from markPassed is not real in this build. It only updates the local me.todayLine (AppStore+Walk.swift:86-92), and CommunityService has no call that publishes the daily line. The daily line itself is required by F4, so it is not a bug. The spec does not require a decline button, a "再聽一次" (play again) button, a settings entry to review the text, or disclosure of Overpass or Apple speech servers. It is a single-device demo, the OS permission prompts come after this page and can be refused, and the text is on screen while it is spoken. So those extra items are not spec violations. I rate it medium, not high: nothing actually leaves the phone today, but this consent page is required by the spec, it is visible in the demo, and it undersells what the circle can see.
verdict.fix: Effort S. Rewrite the three rows in OnbConsentStep (Onboarding.swift:156-159) and the speech at :204 together, so they match, grouped by who sees what. Example rows: (1) "你行街嘅時候自動記錄，唔使撳掣；行過嘅路線只留喺你部手機". (2) "同圈嘅人會見到你嘅小人、幾座幾樓、連續日數，同一句「今日行到邊個地標」，唔會見到你個名". (3) "碰過一碰嘅街坊先見到你個名，同埋你出門時喺邊個地標附近". (4, optional) "你嘅反映會匿名，夠 10 人先交俾社工同屋邨管理". Merge the speech into one sentence covering the same points. Add one subtitle line to the floor step (around :390/:438) saying "同圈嘅人會見到你住幾樓". Optional, not required by the spec: a "再聽一次" button that calls speak again, and the same text in the Settings privacy section (Settings.swift:60).

confirmed.title: 真机散步检测一退后台或锁屏就停，F1「全程不碰手机」做不到；新装真机默认是演示模式，根本不检测；文档和同意页却说会自动记录
confirmed.evidence: appActive(false) 调用 walkDetector.stop()，Core Motion 和定位都停了。定位只申请了使用期间（WhenInUse），没有 UIBackgroundModes=location，没设 allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates，也没有用 queryActivityStarting 回补。所以手机锁屏放进口袋后，整次散步都不会记录。散步途中退到后台的话，App 收不到回家事件，要等回到前台、超过 15 分钟没有新定位，才按 staleWalk 收尾。另外 startWalkDetection 有 guard !demoMode，而 demoMode 默认是 true，真机装好后不去设置里关掉演示模式，就永远不检测。但同意页、完成首次使用时的语音（「你行街嘅時候我會自動記錄」）和 NSMotionUsageDescription 都说自动记录、不用按掣，README 和 prototype_status 也把真机步行检测列为真的。
confirmed.rule: F1 验收：用户全程不碰手机，一次散步被完整记录；诚实标注
confirmed.fix: 短期：同意页、权限文案、README 和 prototype_status 写明「App 開住嗰陣先記錄」，而且要先关演示模式（或者真机首次启动时默认关掉演示模式）。回到前台时用 CMMotionActivityManager.queryActivityStarting 或 CMPedometer.queryPedometerData 回补后台期间的步行时段。长期：申请 Always 授权，加 UIBackgroundModes location 和 allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates，或者用家附近的 CLCircularRegion 离开事件、significant-change 唤醒 App，并在同意页说明原因。

verdict.reason:
问题属实，我没能反驳。下面是读代码核对的结果。

1. 锁屏或退后台就停止检测，这一点成立。
- ios/StreetWalk/App/StreetWalkApp.swift:13：只要 scenePhase 不是 .inactive，就调 store.appActive(p == .active)。锁屏或退后台进入 .background，会走到 appActive(false)。
- ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Services.swift:13：appActive(false) 调 walkDetector.stop()。
- WalkDetector.swift:85-92：stop() 里 motion.stopActivityUpdates()，并且 setLocating(false)，即 stopUpdatingLocation。
- 定位只申请了 WhenInUse（WalkDetector.swift:99）。project.pbxproj 里只有 NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription，没有 UIBackgroundModes。全仓也找不到 allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates、queryActivityStarting、CMPedometer。
- 结果：手机锁屏放进口袋，整次散步都不会被记录。在路上锁屏也一样，要等回到前台时才处理：如果最后一个定位已超过 15 分钟（AppStore+Walk.swift:124-127），就按锁屏前最后一个定位收尾，所以分钟数会被截短。
- 代码注释 WalkDetector.swift:5 自己写了「使用期间、前台」，但对外文档没有写。

2. 这违反了规格原文。docs/产品定稿 F1 的验收写的是「用户全程不碰手机，一次散步被完整记录」。现实中「不碰手机」就是锁屏放口袋，现在的实现做不到。

3. 文档与代码不符。README.md:13 和 docs/prototype_status.md:5、14 都把「真机步行检测」列为真的在跑，F1 一行只写「Core Motion 检测步行 → 只在步行时开定位 → 离家 55 m 开始、回到 40 m 内结束」，没有写只在前台有效。prototype_status 的「未做 / 需要真机」一节也没提这一点。用户能看到的文案（下面三处）都说自动记录、不用按掣：
- Onboarding.swift:154 和 :204
- AppStore+Map.swift:107 完成首次使用时的语音
- NSMotionUsageDescription

这是对评审夸大了完成度，属于诚实标注问题。

4. 和已定的决定不冲突。已定的决定只说单机演示、示範居民、AI 和碰一碰模拟，没有决定真机 F1 只在前台有效。

5. 「演示模式默认开」这一条不成立。AppStore.swift:89 默认值是 true，AppStore+Walk.swift:121 有 guard !demoMode，这些都对。但 prototype_status 已经写明「模拟器和演示模式里用…路线代替真实行走」和「设置里可以关掉演示模式」，这也是单机演示决定的自然结果，不算独立问题。最多在文档里补一句「真机要先在设置里关演示模式」。

严重程度定为 medium，不同意报告里的 high：
- 演示视频、评审现场走的都是模拟器加演示模式，不受影响。
- 但真机 F1 达不到验收，文档又把它说成是真的，评分里「哪些是真的」一项有失实风险。
verdict.fix:
最小修法：只改文档，工作量 S。
- docs/prototype_status.md 的 F1 一行和第 5 行一句话、README.md:13，改为「真机步行检测：App 喺前台时记录；锁屏或退到后台会暂停，返前台按最后定位收尾；要先喺设置关演示模式」。
- 「未做 / 需要真机」一节加一条「后台持续记录（要 Always 定位 + UIBackgroundModes location）」。

同时建议加一个回补，工作量 M，不改授权：
- 回到前台时，如果 walkDetector.recording 为真，在 AppStore.startWalkDetection 里用 CMPedometer.queryPedometerData(from: walk.start, to: now) 补回步数和时长。
- 也可以用 CMMotionActivityManager.queryActivityStarting 找出后台期间步行的结束时间，再用它收尾，不再只按 lastFixAt。

真正做到「全程不碰手机」要申请 Always 授权，加 UIBackgroundModes=location 和 allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates（或用家附近 region 的离开事件唤醒 App），并在同意页说明原因，工作量 L，可以留到后续。

confirmed.title: 真机只在离家 55–96 m 这一窄圈内才开始记录，走远后整次漏记或只记 1 分钟；定位精度差时会提早收尾
confirmed.evidence: 开始条件是 walk == nil && acc <= 30 && inside && fromHome > 55。inside 要求 |x| 和 |y| 都不超过 half-4，即 96 m（dioramaSize=200）。步行约 30 秒就会穿过这一圈；而 Core Motion 判定「行路」有延迟，判定之后才开 GPS，屋邨高楼下精度又常超过 30 m。第一个合格的定位点一旦已在 96 m 以外，出门这段就永远不会开始记录。回程再经过这一圈时才开始，到 40 m 内又马上结束，结果只记了约 1 分钟。开始时间用的是第一个定位点的 Date()，不是动作开始的时间。回家判定是 fromHome - acc < 40 && fromHome < 100，精度差时（例如离家 99 m、精度 60 m）会提早收尾，把一次散步切成几段。
confirmed.rule: F1：检测到步行时自动开始记录，完整记录一次散步
confirmed.fix: 开始条件去掉 inside。inside 只用来决定画不画轨迹，底座外照样计时、记地标。起点时间改用 CMMotionActivity.startDate。宽松的回家判定加精度上限（例如 acc ≤ 50），或要求连续两个点都在家附近才算回家。补 handleWalkEvent 单元测试：模拟一串 .location 事件，断言开始和结束都正确。

verdict.reason:
属实。代码与报告一致：AppStore+Map.swift:49-50 以我屋企为中心裁出底座，MapModel.swift:95 dioramaSize=200，所以 half=100。AppStore+Walk.swift:156 的 inside 要求 |x|、|y| ≤ 96 m。:162 的开始条件是 walk==nil && acc≤30 && inside && fromHome>55，所以只有离家 55–96 m（对角方向到约 136 m）这一圈内、而且精度不差的定位点才能开始记录。底座外的点只在 liveStep 里不画轨迹（:175），说明原本就打算底座外照样计时，只是开始条件多挡了一层。

后果：
(1) 第一个精度够的定位点已在圈外时，出门这段不会记录。电梯里静止会触发 walking(false)，未记录时会关定位（:142），出电梯要重新等 Core Motion 判定、等 GPS 定到位，所以这种情况在高楼屋邨下是有可能的。
(2) 回程穿过这一圈时才开始：会播「偵測到你出咗門」，跳到今日页，然后很快在 40 m（或放宽条件）内收尾，用 max(minutes,1) 记一笔 1 分钟（:103 recordWalk）。
(3) 放宽的回家条件 fromHome-acc<40 && fromHome<100（:159）。WalkDetector 会把精度 ≤100 m 的点都送进来，例如离家 99 m、精度 60 m 就判为到家并收尾。如果当时已在 96 m 外，余下的路程全部漏记。
(4) 我另外核实到一个确定会发生的问题：放宽的回家条件可以覆盖到离家 70 m（acc=30），开始阈值却只有 55 m，两条阈值方向反了。精度 20–30 m 时，在离家 55–70 m 内走动，会一笔开始、下一笔收尾，反复切换：每次都播报，每次都记一笔 1 分钟的散步，用户会听到多次「返到屋企喇…已經隱身」。
(5) 开始时间用的是 Date()（:28），略晚于实际出门，属次要问题。

违反 F1「检测到步行时自动开始记录…验收：用户全程不碰手机，一次散步被完整记录」。prototype_status 写的是「离家 55 m 开始」，没有提底座内的限制，文档与代码也不一致。与已定决定不冲突：「底座 200 m」只管场景显示，不管记录范围。CoreTests 里也没有 handleWalkEvent 的测试。

严重程度判为 medium 而不是 high：只影响真机、关掉演示模式的路径。演示主线用的是模拟散步，而且 prototype_status 也写明真机测试还没做。
verdict.fix:
只改 AppStore+Walk.swift，工作量 S：
1) :162 去掉 inside，改成宽松的距离上限，例如 fromHome < 400。不要完全不限：在别区落车后行路，不应当成「出咗門」。还要加上 !home 和 fromHome - acc > Self.leaveRadius，让开始阈值一定高于放宽后的回家阈值，消除 55–70 m 内一开一收的反复切换。
2) 开始点在底座外时，传给 beginWalk 的 route[0] 和镜头目标先夹到 ±(m.half-4) 以内，避免镜头飞出底座、nearestLandmark 取到远处的地标。之后的轨迹照现有逻辑：底座外只计时（:161、:175 已支持）。
3) :159 放宽的回家条件加精度上限（acc ≤ 50），或要求连续 2 个点都判为到家才收尾，防止一笔差的定位把散步切断。
4) 可选：beginWalk 的开始时间改用最近一次 walking(true) 的时间（WalkDetector 记下 CMMotionActivity.startDate）。
5) 在 CoreTests 补一个 handleWalkEvent 测试：送入一串 .location 事件（出圈后才有好精度、在 55–70 m 抖动、99 m 处精度 60 m），断言只开始一次、不会提早收尾。另外把 prototype_status 里「离家 55 m 开始」的描述同步到实际条件。

confirmed.title: 「重置演示」和演示散步会覆盖或吞掉真实散步纪录，和注释「真实记录唔郁」相反
confirmed.evidence: resetDemoData 先保留非示範纪录，但只要今天没有纪录，就调用 seedDemoHistory()。后者会无条件为过去 8 天写入 DayLog(demo:true)，把这几天的真实纪录盖掉。recordWalk(simulated:true) 遇到当天已有真实纪录时会设 l.demo = true，整天的真实分钟数和地标都变成示範；关掉演示模式后，这一天不再计入，连续天数断开；之后再「重置演示」，这一天会被整个删掉。复现：真机关着演示模式走几天，然后打开演示模式，在今天还没走时按「重置演示」，再关掉演示模式，真实的连续天数变成 0。
confirmed.rule: 数据安全；示範数据不得混入或覆盖真实纪录（Persist 注释、prototype_status）
confirmed.fix: DayLog 把真实和示範分开记（realMinutes/realWalks 与 demoMinutes/demoWalks，或分成 walkLog、demoLog 两本）。seedDemoHistory 只写 walkLog[key] == nil 的日子。recordWalk(simulated) 只累加示範部分。resetDemoData 只删示範部分。补单元测试：重置演示后真实纪录不变。

verdict.reason:
The report is accurate. I checked it against the code (read only, no simulator).

1. "Reset demo" can overwrite real records. In AppStore+Persist.swift:105-113, resetDemoData() keeps the non-demo entries in walkLog. But if today has no entry (line 111), it calls seedDemoHistory() (lines 178-184). That function writes DayLog(demo:true) for each of the past 8 days without checking whether a record is already there, so a real record on any of those days is replaced and its minutes and landmarks are gone for good.

   This path can be reached. On a real device with demo mode off, real walks are recorded (simulated: false when walkDetector.recording, AppStore+Walk.swift:98-103). If you then turn demo mode on, setDemoMode (Settings.swift:133) does not seed, because walkLog is not empty. The demo menu then appears (MainView.swift:231). Pressing 重置演示 (Demo.swift:42 → resetDemo → resetDemoData) before walking today overwrites the past 8 days. When demo mode is turned off again, those days count as demo, so the real streak drops to 0.

2. A simulated walk turns a real day into a demo day. recordWalk (lines 154-163) sets l.demo = true when simulated is true, even if today already has a real record, and adds the demo minutes to it. Once demo mode is off, log(for:), myStreak and the monthly totals hide that day. A later 重置演示 then deletes it at line 110.

Both directly contradict the comment at line 104 ("你自己的真实记录唔郁", "your own real records stay untouched"). They also go against prototype_status.md line 7, which says demo data is labelled and disappears when demo mode is off; real data should never become demo. None of the agreed decisions allow this: single-device demo and labelled demo data are agreed, but not destroying real data. No unit test covers it.

I'm rating it medium, not high. It only happens through the demo-only menu after real use on a device. That is the team's own workflow, though: walk-test on a real device for a few days, then switch to demo mode to present.
verdict.fix:
Smallest fix, effort S:
(1) In seedDemoHistory, write only empty days: `let k = LocalStore.dayKey(...); if walkLog[k] == nil { walkLog[k] = DayLog(..., demo: true) }`. Apply the same check to today's entry. The callers in restoreSaved, clearAllData and setDemoMode stay correct.
(2) In recordWalk, when simulated is true and today already has a real record (`walkLog[key]?.demo == false`), leave that record alone. Do not set demo = true and do not add the demo minutes; just call refreshMe() and return. That way real data never becomes demo data.
(3) Add a unit test: real records exist for days -1 to -3, today is empty; after resetDemoData, those days still have demo == false and the same minutes, and with demo mode off the streak is unchanged.
Only if the demo minutes on a day with a real record must also be kept is the M-sized option needed: split DayLog into real and demo fields.

confirmed.title: 附近没有「住宅楼」时，首次选楼走进死胡同（北都新屋邨正是这种情况）
confirmed.evidence: 把定位设在鳳凰嶺 22.508,114.135，跑 -resetOnboarding -scriptOnboarding。Overpass 实时拉回的 -5_1 格只有 1 座建筑（石湖新村公廁，building=yes，被归为 .other），住宅楼 0 座，pickView 里一座可选的楼都没有。画面仍写「撳一下你住嗰座樓／住宅樓已經亮咗橙色」，选楼这一步没有返回、跳过或「用示例屋邨」按钮，脚本的「確認」也没有作用；底部说明显示「實時 · 石湖新村公廁」。如果某个屋邨的楼在 OSM 只标了 building=yes，也全部不能选，pickHome 只会提示「請揀一座住宅樓」。刚入伙的北都屋邨往往还没有 OSM 资料。
confirmed.rule: 首次使用必须能完成；§4 包容性设计；目标用户是北都新入伙屋邨的居民
confirmed.fix: pickView 里没有住宅楼时，分三步处理：(1) 层数 ≥4 或面积 >400 m² 的 building=yes 也可以选；(2) 范围扩大到整格；(3) 还是没有，就显示「附近未有住宅樓資料」，给两个大按钮「用示例屋邨」和「淨係用我而家位置」（在定位处生成一座示意楼）。选楼这一步也加返回键。

verdict.reason:
我尝试反驳，但驳不倒，问题确实存在，也不和任何已定决定冲突（单机演示、200 m 底座、画风优先都不涉及首次选楼能不能走完）。

代码链路：
1. Map/MapService.swift:65-74：Overpass 只要返回超过 200 字节就当成功，标成「實時」，并写入 TileCache，缓存 30 天。没有检查里面有没有住宅楼。
2. Map/OSMParser.swift:142-161：只有 apartments、residential、dormitory、house 这几类才归为 .residential；building=yes 一律归为 .other。连内置的皇后山数据里也有 9 座 building=yes。
3. Map/MapModel.swift:203-209：pickView 以我为中心只看 300 m，只取中心约 144 m 以内的住宅楼，maxResidential 是 10。周围没有标住宅的楼，就是 0 座；就算整格里有，也不会扩大范围。
4. Store/AppStore+Map.swift:30-37：不管 v 里有没有住宅楼，都直接进入 .pickHome，然后 highlightResidential(true)，这时高亮的是空集合。
5. Store/AppStore+Map.swift:77：点 .other 的楼只会弹 toast「請揀一座住宅樓」。
6. UI/Onboarding.swift:66：canGoBack 只对 .floor 和 .avatar 成立。pickHome 这一步没有返回、跳过或改用示例的入口，「就係呢座」又必须先有 pendingHome。

结果：第一次使用就卡死。强制退出再开，onboarded 还是 false，又读到同一个缓存格，30 天内一直卡在这里。

另外还有一条报告没提到的路径：UI/Settings.swift:140 的 beginChangeHome 也走同一套流程，而且按「当前位置」取格。老用户在商场、公园这类没有住宅楼的地方点「重新揀樓」，也会卡住，并且回不到主界面。

演示时 run.sh 把定位设在皇后山，所以演示脚本不会触发。但真机测试还在待办里；在会场、学校或办公室这些不在家的地方打开 App，300 m 内没有标成住宅的楼的可能性很大，会直接卡在第一步。这违反了「首次使用必须能完成」和 §4 包容性设计（老人卡住了也没有任何出路）。画面上的「住宅樓已經亮咗橙色」此时也是错的。

严重程度判 high：一旦触发，整个 App 都用不了，还会被缓存固定下来。只是触发条件在演示路径之外。
verdict.fix:
最小修法（工作量 S，约 30 行），改 Store/AppStore+Map.swift 的 loadMap 中 onboarding 分支，分三步兜底：
1. 先算 `var v = m.pickView(near: me)`。如果 `!v.buildings.contains { $0.kind == .residential }`，就改用 `m.pickView(near: nil)`，即看整格、保留全部住宅楼。
2. 如果还是没有住宅楼，就用 `MapService.fallback()` 换成内置皇后山，同时设 `fullMap = fb`、`mapSource = .fallback`，再用 `fb.pickView(near: nil)`。底部来源说明会自动显示「示例」。另外在 OnbPickHomeStep 的说明卡上加一行文案「附近未有住宅樓資料，用緊示例屋邨」。

另外有两处小改动：
- MapService.load：解析出来没有任何建筑的格子不要写入 TileCache，免得重开后又读到同一个空格子。
- beginChangeHome 是从主界面进入的：在 pickHome 的 topBar 加一个返回或「取消」按钮，点了回到 .main 并重新装回原来的 homeTile。

放宽规则、让大面积或高层的 building=yes 也能选，属于后续改进（M），不是这次的最小修法必需的。

confirmed.title: 首次选楼只能点 3D 场景：读屏和切换控制用户完成不了首次使用，低层楼的可点范围只有约 10 pt
confirmed.evidence: 选屋企唯一的方法是在 SCNView 上单击，靠 hitTest 命中楼宇后调用 store.pickHome。DioramaView 整体只是一个无障碍元素「你附近嘅立體地圖」，没有子元素和自定义操作，OnbPickHomeStep 也没有楼宇列表或按钮。打开 VoiceOver 或切换控制时选不了楼，「就係呢座」确认卡永远不出现，首次使用卡在第 3 步。设置里的「改我住嘅樓」走同一流程，同样卡住。hitTest 按几何精确命中，没有容差。选楼镜头下正交视野半高约 500 m，古洞北 3 层村屋在屏幕上只有约 8–12 pt 宽，塔楼约 30–40 pt，都小于 44 pt，手抖的长者很难点中。
confirmed.rule: §4 包容性设计（老年人也能用）、每个操作都要有大按钮后备；HIG 最小点按区域 44 pt；读屏可达
confirmed.fix: 在选楼步骤的场景下方加「附近住宅樓」列表：用 store.residentialBuildings() 按离定位点的距离排序，每座楼一个大按钮（楼名、层数、距离），点了直接调用 pickHome(id)，另加「用最近嗰座」按钮作兜底。hitTest 改为取点击位置 30 pt 内最近的住宅楼。可选：给每座可选的楼提供 UIAccessibilityElement。

verdict.reason:
The core claim holds. I checked the code and the screenshots. Some details are overstated.

What the code shows:
- The only way to choose a home is the tap on the SCNView. OnbPickHomeStep (Onboarding.swift:276-370) has the instruction card, the toast, the source caption and the confirm card. The confirm card only appears once store.pendingHome is set. Only two places set it: the tap handler that calls store.pickHome (Onboarding.swift:20-23) and the -scriptOnboarding demo script (DemoScript.swift:82).
- loadMap (AppStore+Map.swift:28-37) never sets a default pendingHome. pickView works out a guess but only passes it to the scene, not to pendingHome. There is no list, no "use nearest" button and no skip.
- DioramaView is one opaque element labelled "你附近嘅立體地圖", with no child elements and no custom actions. A VoiceOver double-tap fires at the centre of that element, so the user gets whatever building happens to sit under the screen centre, or nothing.
- DioramaController.hit (481-495) is an exact hitTest with no tolerance. A tap on empty ground returns nil and the guard drops it with no feedback, so an older user who misses gets no response at all.
- Settings "改我住嘅樓" (beginChangeHome, Settings.swift:140-145) goes back through the same .locate to .pickHome flow, so it has the same problem.

Target sizes:
- The camera numbers match the report. Distance 2.85·k × 0.1763 gives an orthographic half-height of about 0.50 units, which is about 500 m at scale 0.001, or roughly 0.85 pt per metre.
- In so_6.png and tc_pick.png, the low-rise residential blocks (highlighted orange) are about 6-11 px wide on a 760 px-tall image, which is about 7-12 pt. Towers are about 28-40 pt. Everything is below 44 pt.
- Without location, pickView(near: nil) uses the whole map size with maxResidential .max, so the targets get even smaller.

Where the report overstates:
- §4 only says "每个语音操作都要有大按钮后备". Choosing a building is not a voice action, so the "每个操作都要大按钮" rule is stretched. The real basis is "所有功能遵循包容性设计，老年人也能用", the HIG 44 pt minimum, and the fact that this blocks the onboarding flow.
- Switch Control has point scanning, which can tap any spot, so "切换控制完成不了" is too strong. It is just very hard with 10 pt targets.
- prototype_status only lists "读屏顺序未逐屏人工检查" as a known gap. That is about reading order, not a step nobody can get past, so this is not an already-known issue.

It does not conflict with any settled decision. The decision itself says the only tap allowed in the scene is for choosing a home, and adding a button-based alternative outside the scene keeps the scene look-only.

Severity: medium, not high. The main demo always taps or scripts the choice, and VoiceOver users are not the core demo audience. But one step of the first-run flow cannot be done without precise taps on the 3D scene, and that is exactly the elderly-friendliness the spec asks for.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix (S-M), all in Onboarding.swift with one small helper in AppStore+Map.swift:

1. In OnbPickHomeStep, under sourceCaption, add a secondary big button "揀唔到？用清單揀". It opens a sheet, or expands in place, listing store.residentialBuildings() sorted by centroid.length. In pickView the centroids are already relative to my position, and there are at most 10 buildings. Each row is a big button of at least 64 pt. The label is b.name, or "住宅樓" when there is no name, plus "N 層" and "約 X 米". Tapping a row calls store.pickHome(b.id), and the existing confirm card "就係呢座" takes over.

2. In DioramaController.hit, when the exact hit is nil, fall back: project each residential building centroid with view.projectPoint and take the nearest one within about 30 pt of the tap. Also add a short toast for taps that hit nothing, such as "撳近啲你住嗰座樓", so a miss is no longer silent.

3. Optional: add an accessibilityHint on the DioramaView pointing to the list button, so VoiceOver users can find the alternative.

confirmed.title: 界面状态偶尔卡住：切标签后内容不刷新、横幅收不起、空白卡片和暗层留在屏幕上
confirmed.evidence: 6 次完整脚本运行中有 2 次出问题，另外跑 3 次开头段又复现 1 次。(1) -script 在 t=4 设 tab=.board 后，标签栏已经高亮「排行榜」，标题和内容却仍是「今日」，至少 5 秒没刷新（s1_7、s1_12，rep1_8 也一样）。(2) 同一次运行在 t=28 脚本把 banner 设为 nil，但「8 樓陳太啱啱出門…［約佢］」横幅仍在顶部停了约 45 秒，盖住找人全屏的顶部卡，按钮还是过时的「約佢」，直到 t=73 被新横幅换掉。(3) 大字号运行中，确认语音约人后提议卡仍在（sx_72、sx_78），之后变成只有拉手的空白卡加半屏暗层，盖住标签栏至少 8 秒（sx_84、sx_91）。三次的共同点：直接读 store 的子视图（MainTabBar、ProposalCard）已经刷新，父容器（MainView 内容区、BottomLayer/BottomCardDim，以及 BannerView 用 shown/expanded 镜像的状态）没有刷新。
confirmed.rule: 动画和界面状态不能卡住；代码注释（MainView.swift:136-137、498）自己也要求避免「卡片已经走咗、暗层仲留喺度」
confirmed.fix: 1) 把内容区拆成独立 View，在它自己的 body 里读 store.tab。2) BannerView 直接由 store.banner 驱动（if let 加 transition），去掉 shown/expanded 镜像状态、DispatchQueue.main.async 和 completion 回调。3) BottomCardSlot 去掉 shown 和 600 ms 的 Task，改用 transition 跟随 uiActiveCard。4) uiActiveCard 先校验数据是否有效（proposal 的 index 在范围内、selection 和 find 的目标存在），无效就返回 nil。5) 同时去掉场景标签每秒 30 次的无条件写入（见 A31）。修好后连跑 -script 10 次，截图回归。

verdict.reason:
I tried to disprove this and could not. The screenshots come from the current code: every UI and Store file was last modified on Oct 7, the screenshots were taken on Oct 8, and tools/run.sh rebuilds before installing and stops if the build fails. All three symptoms show the screen contradicting the store for much longer than any animation runs (the springs in Design.swift settle in about 1 s).
(1) s1_7 (15:12:56) and s1_12 (15:13:01) are 5 s apart, and rep1_8 is a separate run at 15:39. In all three the tab bar highlights 排行榜 while the title and the page still show 今日. MainTabBar and contentArea read the same store.tab (MainView.swift:91, 241-268), so the store had changed and the content area did not follow. The comment at MainView.swift:89-90 says this exact bug was already "fixed".
(2) s1_30, s1_43 and s1_71 cover t=30 to t=71. The expanded banner still reads "8 樓陳太啱啱出門…［約佢］". A banner cannot stay up legitimately: showBanner hides it after 8 s (AppStore.swift:138-145), and the script sets banner=nil at t=28. It is also not a new banner. During a walk a fresh one would say 過去搵佢 (AppStore+Neighbors.swift:105), and s1_30 shows that label on the today card underneath. So BannerView's mirrored shown/expanded state never ran its collapse (Overlays.swift:194-219), or the completion callback never fired. The button left on screen does nothing, because bannerAction() returns early when store.banner is nil.
(3) Large-text run: confirmVoice() clears both voiceCard and proposal straight away (AppStore+Voice.swift:92-96, AppStore+Meetup.swift:101). Even so, sx_78 still shows the read-back card 10 s later. sx_84 and sx_91 then show an empty card with only its grab handle, plus the 0.25 dim, covering the tab bar. If BottomLayer is still passing a stale card, tapping the dim calls uiDismiss on a card that no longer exists and nothing changes, so the user can get stuck.
None of this touches the settled decisions. It is a correctness and usability bug in the main demo flow, intermittent (3 of about 9 runs), and the code comments (MainView.swift:89-90, 136-137, 473-475, 497-498) show earlier fixes did not hold. One correction to the report: I could not pin down the root cause from the code. It may be the parent view not re-rendering, or a transition or animation completion that stalls. The report's suggested fix also partly goes back to the insert/remove transitions that the code comments say got stuck before. The fix should therefore make the final state independent of animation completion, not just switch to transitions.
verdict.fix:
Smallest fix that should work (effort M, about half a day including regression runs):
1) DioramaController.swift:727, inside renderer(_:updateAtTime:): assign only when the labels change: `if self.overlay.items != items { self.overlay.items = items }`. OverlayItem is already Equatable. This removes the constant 30 Hz invalidation while the camera is still (same as A31).
2) BannerView (Overlays.swift:179-220): stop relying on onChange plus a withAnimation completion to clear `shown`. Sync with `.task(id: store.banner?.id)`. When the value is nil, animate expanded=false, sleep about 450 ms, then set shown=nil if store.banner is still nil. Also, in island(), hide the action button when store.banner is nil, so a stale button can never be shown.
3) BottomLayer / BottomCardSlot / BottomCardDim (MainView.swift:473-556): replace onChange(of: card) with `.task(id: card)` and keep the 600 ms clear. When the data behind a card is gone (proposal or voiceCard nil, an out-of-range proposal index, a missing selection or find target), uiActiveCard should return nil so the dim and the slot collapse together.
4) contentArea (MainView.swift:238-268): move it into its own small view that reads store.tab in its own body. Either drop `.id(tab).transition` on the title and page, or keep only a non-blocking opacity change, so the content always matches the tab bar.
5) Regression check: run `-script` 10 times plus one large-text run, take screenshots at t=4/7/12, t=30/43 and t=72-91, and confirm the tab bar, title, banner and card always match the store.

confirmed.title: 「我喺X」播送的内容和用户说的、按的不一致：语音原话被丢掉，「我就到」被播成「我喺涼亭」
confirmed.evidence: broadcastHere() 固定发「我喺<约定地标>」，VoiceIntent.broadcast(String) 带来的文字被丢掉。例如讲「我喺巴士站」，复述卡显示「播俾對方聽：我喺巴士站」，按「好」后发出去的却是「我喺涼亭」。临时找人时底栏按钮写「我就到」，实际也播「我喺<地标>」，顶部卡显示「已話俾陳太知：我喺皇后山總站」，而用户离那个地标还有几十米，人在半路就宣布已经到了。约会模式下「我喺X」按钮不看距离，随时都能按。
confirmed.rule: F8：用户说一句「我在凉亭」，就能播送给对方；复述卡要如实复述将要执行的动作（诚实）
confirmed.fix: broadcastHere(text:) 改为接收文字。语音路径用复述过的原话，或原话里解析出的地标。按钮路径：临时找人发「我就到，大約 N 分鐘」；约会模式只在 f.distance 小于约 15 m 时发「我喺X」，否则发「我就到X」。复述卡的 detail 和实际发送的内容用同一个字符串。补测试。

verdict.reason:
I checked this against the code, and two of its three parts are real.

1. **The voice path broadcasts different text from what the confirmation card shows.** TemplateAI.swift:39 returns `.broadcast(raw)`, so the parser keeps the exact words, and Speech.swift uses real SFSpeechRecognizer (zh-HK), so users can say anything. AppStore+Voice.swift:72-73 builds the confirmation card from that text (title 播俾對方聽, detail = the spoken words). But both `case .broadcast:` at line 72 and `confirmVoice()` at line 98 drop the text and call `broadcastHere()`. AppStore+Find.swift:111-115 always sends `"我喺\(lm.name)"`. Example: in find mode the user says 「我喺巴士站」, the card shows 我喺巴士站, and after pressing 好 the app sends and speaks 我喺涼亭. This breaks the agreed rule that any voice action affecting someone else is read back first and then confirmed with 好: the read-back is wrong. It also wastes the `broadcast(String)` value defined in Contracts.swift:12. Picking the suggested phrase (AppStore+Voice.swift:35) happens to give the same text, so the scripted demo hides the bug, but free speech hits it.

2. **The 我就到 button sends 我喺X.** In a drop-by find (`spontaneous`), FullScreen.swift:340 labels the button 我就到. Pressing it calls `broadcastHere()`, which sends 我喺<the partner's landmark>, and the top card at FullScreen.swift:255-257 shows 已話俾陳太知：我喺皇后山總站. At that moment the user is still on the way, so the button says one thing and the app tells the other person something false.

3. **Not a bug: the appointment-mode 我喺X button works at any distance.** The button text and what gets sent are the same, and the user decides when to press it. F8 only says one sentence like 「我在凉亭」 should reach the other person; it says nothing about checking distance. So this part is not a spec violation.

This doesn't conflict with any agreed decision. The other residents are simulated, but the on-screen record and the spoken line are themselves wrong. I'm rating it medium rather than high: the scripted demo path doesn't trigger it, and nobody real receives the message.
verdict.fix:
Change it to `func broadcastHere(_ text: String? = nil)` in AppStore+Find.swift:111. Build one string: `let msg = text ?? (f.spontaneous ? "我就到\(lm.name)" : "我喺\(lm.name)")`. Use that same `msg` for both `f.broadcast` and `speaker.speak("已經話俾…知：\(msg)。")`.

In AppStore+Voice.swift:98, change it to `case .broadcast(let t): broadcastHere(t)`. Line 72 already shows that same `text` on the card, so the card and what is sent will match.

The FullScreen.swift:339 button can keep calling `broadcastHere()` with no argument; for a drop-by find this now sends 我就到X, matching the label.

Add a test: after `handle("我喺巴士站")` and `confirmVoice()`, `find?.broadcast == "我喺巴士站"`; and in spontaneous mode, after `broadcastHere()`, the result starts with 我就到.

Effort: S (about 10 lines plus 1 test). No distance check is needed for appointment mode.

confirmed.title: F1 的「落脚点」（停留 ≥2 分钟、半径 ≤30 m）没有实现：改成「经过 26 m 内」，每经过一个地标就上传，文档也没说明
confirmed.evidence: 全代码没有停留检测（grep 落脚、dwell 都没有结果）。markPassed 把离地标 26 m 以内都算作「经过」，并对每个地标调用 community.publishOuting，等于实时上传一串地标轨迹。DayLog 按日合并，只有 minutes、walks、landmarks，没有逐次的散步记录，也没有落脚点的数据结构。F2 划圈（一周内 ≥3 个落脚点重合）、F10「常停下却没有座位的地点」和「自发形成的聚脚点」都没有数据来源。prototype_status 的 F1 行没有提这项简化。
confirmed.rule: F1：一次散步生成一条散步记录和若干个落脚点，上传到服务器的只有落脚点对应的地标；F2；F10；§7 walks 表
confirmed.fix: 在 liveStep/tickWalk 里做停留检测：用滑动窗口，2 分钟内所有点都在 30 m 圆内，就生成一个落脚点并吸附到最近的地标。演示路线在地标处停顿来模拟。WalkSession 和 DayLog 加 stopovers。出门状态只发出门时的地标和落脚点地标，不再每经过一个就发。prototype_status 写明现状。

verdict.reason:
Only part of the report holds up, and it is minor.

What is true:
- The code has no concept of a stopover (落脚点), meaning a stay of at least 2 minutes within 30 m. There is no dwell detection anywhere.
- markPassed (AppStore+Walk.swift:85-94) counts any landmark within 26 m as "passed".
- DayLog (LocalStore.swift:23-29) merges each day's walks into one record.
- So the F1 sentence "一次散步生成…若干個落腳點" (each walk produces several stopovers) is not built.
- The F1 row in prototype_status.md:14 does not mention this simplification. That makes it a doc-vs-code mismatch.

What does not hold up:
1. **The privacy charge** (that the app uploads a live trail of landmarks) is wrong.
   - `publishOuting` is an empty function in the demo (Community.swift:98).
   - In the backend design, `outings` is keyed on `user_id`, so it holds a single row that is upserted with the current landmark and deleted on return home (backend_supabase.md:59-64). No trail of points is stored.
   - Only neighbours who turned on "receive" can see that row.
   - This is exactly the agreed rule that neighbours appear only while you are out, and only at landmark level. The F6 example "應該在河畔那邊" and F8's arrival estimate also need this per-landmark update. Server-side coordinates are still zero.
2. **The data shape follows the spec.** The spec's own §7 walks table lists "經過的地標 id 列表" (passed landmark ids), and the code and the backend `walks.landmark_ids` match §7.
3. **The stopover data has no consumer in the prototype.**
   - F2 says "原型階段使用預設的分組" (use preset groups in the prototype).
   - F3 picks its landmarks automatically from the map.
   - The F10 monthly report is marked 示範 (demo) data, so the "常停下" / "聚腳點" entries have no real source anyway.
4. **F1's acceptance criterion is met:** a walk is recorded in full without the user touching the phone.

So rating this high is not justified. What is left is an undocumented simplification of the F1 stopover feature.
verdict.fix:
Smallest fix (S, docs only): add one sentence to the "模拟 / 未做" (simulated / not done) column of the F1 row in docs/prototype_status.md:14. Suggested text: "落腳點（停 ≥2 分鐘、30 m 內）未做：原型用『經過的地標』（26 m 內）代替；劃圈用預設分組，月報的聚腳點 / 常停下地點是示範數據。"

Optionally, add the same note to the "每日散步分鐘、經過的地標" row of the privacy table in docs/backend_supabase.md.

Do not change the publishOuting logic. A single updated landmark is the agreed design for showing where a neighbour is. Real dwell detection (a sliding window in liveStep that turns "all points within 30 m for 2 minutes" into a stopover) can wait until a backend and real circle-forming exist.

confirmed.title: 非街坊出门时，App 会存下对方位置，并用文字和语音告诉你「8 樓出咗門」
confirmed.evidence: neighborWentOut 先给对方写入 residents[i].isOut 和 atLandmarkID，之后才判断是不是街坊。对非街坊会弹出提示并朗读「8 樓出咗門，但佢未係你街坊，所以地圖上唔會見到佢」，等于把非街坊的楼层和「现在不在家」告诉了别人。这段代码的注释却写着「也不会收到佢嘅位置」。如果之后碰一碰成为街坊，createNeighbor→syncScene 会马上把对方画在成为街坊之前收到的地标上。触发：还没碰一碰时，在演示菜单按「陳太出門」。另外 partnerInvites 在还不是街坊时也会提示「要先同陳太碰一碰…」，把非街坊的名字显示了出来。
confirmed.rule: 已定决定：非街坊永远不进场景；同意页「只有碰过一碰的街坊才看得到你在哪」；backend RLS：非街坊收不到 outings；F4：非街坊不显示姓名
confirmed.fix: neighborWentOut 和 neighborWentHome 对非街坊直接 return，不写状态、不提示。createNeighbor 时清掉 isOut 和 atLandmarkID，等下一次真实事件。partnerInvites 的提示去掉名字。如果演示时需要讲解这条规则，放到 -captions 字幕或演示菜单的说明里。

verdict.reason:
问题属实，但只能从演示菜单触发，所以严重程度应降为 low。

已核实的部分：
- 写入顺序：ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Neighbors.swift:92-101 的 neighborWentOut 先写 residents[i].isOut = true 和 atLandmarkID，之后才 guard r.isNeighbor。
- 提示内容：对非街坊会调用 toast("\(r.floorLabel)出咗門，但佢未係你街坊…")。AppStore.swift:160-162 的 toast 会同时显示并朗读这句话。
- 注释与代码不符：紧挨着的注释写着「也不会收到佢嘅位置」，代码却已经存下对方的地标。
- 与同意页冲突：Onboarding.swift:158 写「只有你碰過一碰嘅街坊，先見到你喺邊」，backend_supabase.md:110 的 RLS 规定非街坊根本收不到 outings。演示却让 App 收到这条事件，再在本机过滤，还把「某楼某人现在不在家」讲了出来，和真实设计不一致。
- 碰一碰之后：createNeighbor 调用 syncScene，AppStore+Map.swift:165-167 会用碰之前存下的 atLandmarkID 把陈太画出来。
- 约人提示：partnerInvites（AppStore+Meetup.swift:198）对非街坊会显示并朗读「陳太」的名字。

需要降级的部分：
- 只有演示菜单 UI/Demo.swift:18-19 能触发。三段自动脚本（DemoScript.swift）都是先 createNeighbor 再触发出门或约人，不会走到这条路径。真实后端有 RLS，也不会送来这类事件。
- F4 本来就允许对非街坊显示楼层，而且这句提示没有说出地标。
- 场景层守住了规则：Cards.swift:274 和 Tabs.swift:668 都按 isNeighbor 判断，非街坊从未进过场景。所以和「已定决定」不冲突。
- 碰一碰之后显示位置算不上泄露：真实后端在双方成为街坊后，本来就能读到对方当前的出门状态。这里只是位置是旧的，显得有点不连贯。

所以问题是存在的：界面文案、语音和代码注释，与「只有街坊才知道你的去向」的承诺互相矛盾。但这只出现在主持人手动操作的演示路径上，不是真正的数据外泄。
verdict.fix:
需要改三处，工作量小（S，约 10 行）。

1. AppStore+Neighbors.swift:92 的 neighborWentOut 和 :109 的 neighborWentHome：一进函数就判断，非街坊直接返回，不写任何状态：
   guard let i = residents.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == id }), residents[i].isNeighbor else { return }
   演示时如果需要讲解这条规则，可以把提示改成不带楼层和名字的说法，例如「未係街坊，佢出門你唔會收到。」，或者放进 -captions 字幕。
2. AppStore+Meetup.swift:198：提示改成不带名字的版本：「要先碰一碰做咗街坊，先可以約你。」
3. （可选）在 unlinkNeighbor 里同时把 isOut 设为 false、atLandmarkID 设为 nil，这样以后再次碰一碰时不会带出旧位置。做了第 1 步之后，非街坊不会再存下状态，createNeighbor 就不需要再清理。

confirmed.title: 成为街坊时的提醒询问只说「佢出門會話你知」，但按「開」同时也会把我的出门发给对方
confirmed.evidence: RemindPrompt 的文案是「開唔開出門提醒？佢出門嗰陣會話你知。」，只讲接收。但 createNeighbor(remind:) 会把 sendRemind 和 receiveRemind 同时设成同一个值。用户以为只是收提醒，实际上也同意了把自己的出门地标发给对方。
confirmed.rule: F6：默认双向开启，每次成为街坊时询问双方是否开启；知情同意
confirmed.fix: 文案改成明确双向，例如「開唔開出門提醒？開咗之後，佢出門你會知，你出門佢都會知（只講地標）。」，语音确认同步修改。也可以拆成收、发两个开关，都默认开，让用户分别确认。

verdict.reason:
The problem is real, and it does not conflict with any decision already made. The prompt at ios/StreetWalk/UI/Cards.swift:312 says only "開唔開出門提醒？佢出門嗰陣會話你知。", which describes receiving alerts. But tapping 「開」 calls createNeighbor(id, remind: true), and at ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Neighbors.swift:37-39 that sets both sendRemind and receiveRemind to the same value. It also passes send: true to community.linkNeighbor, the CommunityService interface kept for a future backend. Tapping 「遲啲先」 turns both off the same way.

F6 says reminders are on in both directions by default and that both people are asked whether to turn them on each time they become 街坊. The prompt asks about only one direction while switching on both. The user also agrees to send their own going-out alerts without being told.

Things that make it less serious:
- The onboarding consent screen (UI/Onboarding.swift:158 and the spoken line at 204) already says "只有你碰過一碰嘅街坊，先見到你喺邊".
- The 街坊 tab (UI/Tabs.swift:706-714) shows separate 「佢出門話我知」 and 「我出門話佢知」 switches straight afterwards, so the user can change either one.
- This is a single-device demo, and the CommunityService implementation (Store/Community.swift:95) does nothing, so no data actually leaves the phone.

So this is a mismatch between the consent wording and what the button does, not a real data leak. That is why I rate it low rather than medium.
verdict.fix: This only needs copy changes, about 2 lines (small). Change the text at ios/StreetWalk/UI/Cards.swift:312 so it covers both directions, for example "開唔開出門提醒？開咗之後，佢出門你會知，你出門佢都會知（只講地標）。" Change the spoken line for remind=true at ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Neighbors.swift:45 to match, for example "開咗出門提醒，你哋出門都會互相話知。" Splitting this into two switches at this step is not needed, because the 街坊 tab already has separate send and receive switches.

confirmed.title: 模拟出来的街坊和事件在大部分界面没有标「示範」，与 prototype_status「全部都标了」不符

Its `topCard` and `nearPill` at `ios/StreetWalk/UI/FullScreen.swift:234-290` show the other person's ETA, distance and arrow, all from a simulated route, with no label at all.
(4) `reportFollowedUp` at `ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Places.swift:69-78` already receives `isDemo`. Even so, the banner and the spoken line say 「屋邨管理回覆：…會加兩張櫈」 with no mark. `DemoScript.swift:136` plays this automatically in the scripted demo video. Only the Today follow-up card (`Tabs.swift:268`) carries a DemoBadge.

What makes it less serious than reported:
  - On the main screen, the 「演示」 chip at top right is always visible in demo mode (`MainView.swift:231`).

verdict.reason: I tried to refute this and couldn't. The spec (产品定稿 line 100, F8) says that if the two people still have not met 10 minutes after the agreed time, the AI asks whether to call. In the code, the only line that sets latePrompt = true is lateDemo() at AppStore+Find.swift:104-109, and the only caller of lateDemo is the demo menu's 「遲到」 item at UI/Demo.swift:22-24. Neither checkAppointments (AppStore+Meetup.swift:239-255) nor tickFind (AppStore+Find.swift:71-102) compares now against the appointment's date + 600 seconds. checkAppointments only handles the 30-minute reminder before departure and the expiry after one hour. DemoScript also never calls lateDemo. The only DemoMenu instance sits in topChips (MainView.swift:229-236). When findFullScreen is true, topChips gets opacity 0, allowsHitTesting(false) and accessibilityHidden (MainView.swift:113-116). departForAppointment sets findFullScreen = true straight away (AppStore+Find.swift:62), and nothing in the UI sets it back to false except endFind. So during a find for an appointment, the 「遲到」 item cannot be pressed at all. The only time it can be pressed is the 「問緊」 (.asking) stage of an ad hoc find (goFind), which has no agreed time, yet it then says 「過咗約定時間 10 分鐘」, which is both wrong and dishonest. lateCard lives only in FindOverlay (the full-screen layer), so it does not appear until the user presses 「去」. Meanwhile, docs/prototype_status.md:21 lists 「迟到 10 分钟询问」 under what has been built. This does not conflict with any settled decision. The settled decisions only make the other residents' replies and outings simulated; this check uses only the local clock and the find state, so it needs no backend. Severity is medium, not high: it is one F8 rule plus a doc mismatch, and the late card UI and calling the number already work.
verdict.fix: 1) Add `var lateAsked = false` to Appointment (Domain/Models.swift:46-58). 2) Add a check at the end of tickFind, or call a check from checkAppointments: `if !f.spontaneous, f.stage != .met, !f.latePrompt, let id = findAppointment, let i = appointments.firstIndex(where:{$0.id==id}), appointments[i].status == .accepted, !appointments[i].lateAsked, now.timeIntervalSince(appointments[i].date) > 600 { appointments[i].lateAsked = true; f.latePrompt = true; speaker.speak(...) }`. For an accepted appointment that has passed date + 10 minutes while no find is running, checkAppointments should also show a banner, speak the question, and offer an 「打電話」 action. Same lateAsked guard so it is asked only once. 3) Show the demo menu's 「遲到」 item only when `find?.spontaneous == false`. Make it reachable in full-screen find by placing a DemoMenu in the FindOverlay corner, or by not hiding DemoMenu inside topChips. Better still, have it push the demo clock forward to date + 11 minutes so the automatic check fires, instead of setting latePrompt directly. 4) Change docs/prototype_status.md:21 to describe how it really works: the question fires automatically, and the demo uses the menu to move the clock forward. Effort: S (about 30–40 lines).

confirmed.fix: 在 FindOverlay 的 bottomBar 里加一个 68 pt 的咪（调用 store.micTapped），或者全屏时把 MicButton 保留在底栏上方右侧。确认卡里的播送复述流程不用改（播送内容见 A11）。

verdict.reason:
The report is accurate. I could not find a counter-argument in the code or the spec.
(1) In ios/StreetWalk/UI/MainView.swift:485-490, BottomLayer gives MicButton opacity 0, allowsHitTesting(false) and accessibilityHidden when full. The mic is placed at micCenter.y = sceneH, and in full screen that equals the screen height, so it would be off-screen anyway.
(2) FindOverlay.bottomBar (ios/StreetWalk/UI/FullScreen.swift:335-351) has only two buttons, 「結束」 and 「我喺X / 我就到」. A search for micTapped finds only two callers: MicButton (MainView.swift:364) and the rename card (Cards.swift:164). Neither can be reached during full-screen find.
(3) The voice path for this is fully built but cannot be used. suggestedPhrases returns 「我喺<地標>」 when find != nil (AppStore+Voice.swift:35). handle() maps .broadcast to a voice card that needs confirmation, and confirmVoice() calls broadcastHere(). uiActiveCard keeps the voice card during findFullScreen (MainView.swift:15-18), and ListeningCard has its own 「講完」 button. Nothing in full screen can start listening, though. In the .asking stage the find is not full screen and the mic is visible, but nobody has arrived anywhere yet at that point. From startGoing() / departForAppointment() (findFullScreen = true) until endFind, the user can only press the button.
Rules broken: F8 says 「用户说一句"我在凉亭"，就能播送给对方」. §4 says the app is voice-first and the big button is only a fallback ("大按钮作后备"). Here the fallback is the only way in. prototype_status.md also lists 「我喺涼亭」播送 as working, which overstates what the code does.
This does not conflict with the settled decisions. The rule "每个语音操作都有按钮入口" is satisfied, but it does not allow the reverse, where a voice action has only a button. The find screen in the layout sketch omits the mic, but that is a scaled-down sketch, not a stated decision to remove voice there. The code itself expects voice in full screen (the uiActiveCard comment, the find phrases in suggestedPhrases).
Severity is medium, not high. The broadcast still works through the button and the demo script never uses voice here. But it is an explicit F8 voice requirement, it fails at exactly the moment it is needed, and the fix is small.
verdict.fix: In FindOverlay.bottomBar (ios/StreetWalk/UI/FullScreen.swift:335-351), add a third control to the HStack: a round orange mic button about 68pt across (DS.micSize, DS.accent fill). Its action is store.micTapped(). It shows mic.fill, or waveform while store.listening. Accessibility: label 「講嘢」 and the same hint as MicButton. If the row gets tight at 24pt, make 「結束」 icon-only or put the mic just above the bar on the right. Nothing else needs to change: ListeningCard already has 「講完」, the find phrase 「我喺X」 is already in suggestedPhrases, and the .broadcast intent already goes through the read-back card and 「好」 before broadcastHere(). The broadcast wording mismatch is a separate issue (A11). Effort: S, about 15 lines in one file.

confirmed.title: 找人状态没清干净：partnerAgreed 残留、延时任务不认是哪一次找人，会在还没问对方时就显示「陳太話好」
confirmed.evidence: resetDemo、regenerateHere、beginChangeHome 都直接写 find = nil，没有调用 endFind()，所以 partnerAgreed、findRoute、partnerRoute、findAppointment 和场景高亮都没清。复现：散步中按「過去搵陳太」，2.4 秒后陳太「話好」；问人卡只盖住场景以下，右上演示菜单仍能按，按「重置演示」。之后再找人，FindAskCard 的 agreed = partnerAgreed && … 一开始就为真，立即显示「陳太話好：喺X等你」和「去」，对方还没被问就当她答应了。另外，延时任务 2.4 秒后只检查 self.find?.stage == .asking，不检查是不是同一次找人：取消后马上再找（或改找另一位街坊），旧任务会在新一次开始不到 2.4 秒时，用旧对象的名字和地标宣布对方答应，还会用掉 declineNext；如果用户在 2.4 秒内按了「去」，「唔方便」永远不会出现。goFind 也不清 findAppointment 和 partnerRoute。
confirmed.rule: 诚实（不能伪造对方同意）；状态一致
confirmed.fix: 所有清理的地方都调用 endFind()，并补上 cancelProposal()、select(nil)、cancelBump()。FindSession 加 id，并把 agreed 放进会话里；延时任务捕获这个 id，执行前先比对。goFind 开头清空 findAppointment 和 partnerRoute。

verdict.reason:
Confirmed in the code. Both parts are real, but they only happen in narrow cases.

(1) Leftover agreement. regenerateHere (DemoScript.swift:99), resetDemo (DemoScript.swift:106) and beginChangeHome (Settings.swift:141) set find = nil directly and never reset partnerAgreed. Only endFind (AppStore+Find.swift:125) and startGoing (:44) do that. goFind (:7-16) does not reset it either.

FindAskCard (FullScreen.swift:128, 140) computes agreed = store.partnerAgreed && f.stage != .declined. So a leftover true value makes a brand-new ask show "陳太話好：喺X等你" and the 「去」 button at once, and the spinner is hidden.

How to trigger: the find-ask card has coversScene == false (MainView.swift:11), so the dim layer only covers the area below the scene. The top-right DemoMenu (MainView.swift:231) stays tappable.
- Steps: walk, then 過去搵陳太, wait 2.4 s for 「話好」, then 演示 → 喺而家位置重新生成.
- That path keeps savedNeighbors, so 陳太 is still a 街坊.
- Then 出門 → 陳太出門 → 過去搵佢. The card says she agreed before she has been asked.
- If 陳太唔方便 was armed, the card first shows 「話好」 and then 「唔方便」.
- If the user taps 「去」 within 2.4 s, startGoing changes the stage, the delayed task returns early, and the decline never shows.
- resetDemo leaves the same leftover value. It also clears the demo 街坊, so seeing it there needs a new 街坊 first.

(2) The delayed task is not tied to one ask. The task at AppStore+Find.swift:17-36 only checks self.find?.stage == .asking. If the user cancels and asks again within 2.4 s, the old task fires early against the new session. It announces agreement too soon, can use up declineNext, and speaks the old partner's name if the new ask is to a different 街坊. The same leftover-state pattern lets a second task re-announce: after agreement the stage is set back to .asking (:34).

Parts that are overstated:
- Leftover findAppointment and partnerRoute do no harm in practice. They are only set by departForAppointment, which goes straight to full screen. In full screen the demo menu and settings are hidden and cannot be tapped (MainView.swift:108-110). Also, spontaneous finds never read partnerRoute (:74, :77).
- resetDemo already clears the route and the highlight.

None of this conflicts with the decisions already made. It is a real state bug in F8's 先問對方 flow. Severity is low because it needs demo-menu actions in the middle of an ask, or a cancel and re-ask within 2.4 s, and every other resident is a labelled 示範 simulation.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix, size S, 3 files:

1. In goFind (AppStore+Find.swift:7), add `partnerAgreed = false` before creating the session. This alone removes the immediate fake 「話好」.

2. Tie each ask to its own session.
   - Add `var token = UUID()` to FindSession (Models.swift:79).
   - In goFind, capture `let token = find!.token` after line 13.
   - In the task, change the guard to `guard var f = self.find, f.token == token, f.stage == .asking, !self.partnerAgreed else { return }`.
   - Use the same token check before the delayed endFind at line 26.

3. In regenerateHere, resetDemo and beginChangeHome, call endFind() (or at least set partnerAgreed = false) instead of the bare `find = nil; findFullScreen = false`. This keeps cleanup in one place.

findAppointment and partnerRoute need no change.

confirmed.title: 重建圈成员时不处理进行中的找人：问人卡变空而且关不掉，或者非街坊带着名字留在场景里
confirmed.evidence: populate() 只重建 residents，不检查 find、selection、proposal；关演示模式和清除纪录都会调用它。复现：不在散步时讲「過去搵陳太」（handle(.goFind) 只查对方 isOut，不查自己是否在散步），问人卡只把场景以下变暗，左上齿轮仍能按；在设定里关掉演示模式，residents 只剩你。这时 FindAskCard 因为 resident 为 nil 什么都不画，但 uiActiveCard 仍是 .findAsk（不能关、没有拉手），内容区被暗层挡住，没有任何路径能调用 endFind，只能杀掉 App。如果按的是「清除我嘅紀錄」，陳太变回非街坊，但 syncScene 的找人分支不查 isNeighbor，她仍带着名字出现在场景里，按「去」照样带路。
confirmed.rule: 已定决定：非街坊永远不进场景；不能出现卡死、无法退出的状态
confirmed.fix: populate() 最后统一核对一次：找人对象不存在或不是街坊，就 endFind()；selection、proposal、remindPromptFor 指向不存在的人就清掉。syncScene 的找人分支加 p.isNeighbor 检查。handle(.goFind) 要求 walk != nil。

verdict.reason:
The bug is real. One claim in the report goes too far, so I rate it lower than the reporter did.

How to trigger it:
1. Voice "過去搵陳太" at home works. TemplateAI.swift:47 returns .goFind without checking walking. The guard at AppStore+Voice.swift:60 checks only isNeighbor and isOut. After the user presses 好, goFind() runs with walk == nil. The other entry points only start a find while walking (Cards.swift:240, Tabs.swift:99, and the banner action in AppStore+Neighbors.swift:105), so the voice path is the odd one out.
2. With walk == nil, topChips shows the gear (MainView.swift:339-352). The .findAsk card does not dim the scene (coversScene is false), so the gear can still be tapped. Settings can be opened while a find is running.
3. Both setDemoMode (Settings.swift:129-137) and 清除 (Settings.swift:73) call populate(). populate() (AppStore+Map.swift:112-139) rebuilds residents and never checks find. checkAppointments has `find == nil` only in its reminder check, and nothing else clears find.

Case (a), demo mode turned off: circleMembers returns [] (Community.swift:84), so resident("chan") is nil. FindAskCard (FullScreen.swift:126) is wrapped in `if let p`, so it draws nothing, including its 取消 button. uiActiveCard is still .findAsk, and uiCanDismiss is false for it. BottomCardDim dims and blocks the content area, and tapping it does nothing. The goFind task that fires after 2.4 s still says "陳太話好" for a person who is no longer there.

Case (b), records cleared: clearAllData empties savedNeighbors, so 陳太's isNeighbor becomes false. The find branch of syncScene (AppStore+Map.swift:150-158) does not check isNeighbor, so she is still drawn in the scene, highlighted and labelled with her name. Pressing 去 still works. This breaks the settled rule that non-neighbours never enter the scene.

What the report overstates: "只能杀掉 App" is wrong. Two escapes exist: turning demo mode back on (populate brings 陳太 back from savedNeighbors and the 取消 button returns), or Settings → 揀過座樓 (beginChangeHome sets find = nil). Neither is easy to discover.

Why low: it takes an unusual sequence (start a find by voice at home, open Settings mid-find, then turn off demo mode or clear records), there are escapes, and everyone involved is a simulated 示範 resident. It is still a real gap in the privacy rule and a dead-end state, so it should be fixed.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix (S, about 5 lines):
1. In populate() (AppStore+Map.swift), right after `residents = list`, add `if let f = find, resident(f.partnerID)?.isNeighbor != true { endFind() }`. Also clear selection when it is `.person(id)` and that resident is gone, clear proposal when its partner is gone, and clear remindPromptFor when that person is gone.
2. In the find branch of syncScene (AppStore+Map.swift:150), add `p.isNeighbor` to the condition so a non-neighbour can never be drawn, even by mistake.

Optional:
- In handle(.goFind) (AppStore+Voice.swift:60), require walk != nil, to match the other entry points.
- Hide the gear in topChips while find != nil.
- Give FindAskCard a fallback 取消 button for when resident is nil.

confirmed.title: 存档格式一加字段，旧存档就整份读不回，还会被空状态覆盖（街坊、约会、散步纪录全部丢失）
confirmed.evidence: SavedState、Appointment（reminded、fromPartner）、DayLog（demo）用编译器合成的 Codable：非可选属性即使有默认值，JSON 里缺这个键也会抛 keyNotFound。load() 用 try? 吞掉错误，返回空的 SavedState()；0.5 秒后 scheduleSave 把空状态写回文件，旧数据永久丢失。version 字段从来不检查，只有 Report.followUpDemo 做成了可选。测试「保存格式来回一致」只测当前格式的编码再解码，没有缺字段的旧格式样本。
confirmed.rule: 本机数据保存要可靠
confirmed.fix: 给 SavedState、Appointment、DayLog 手写 init(from:)，缺键时用 decodeIfPresent 加默认值。解码失败时把原文件改名为 state.bad-<时间>.json，不要覆盖。按 version 做迁移。补两个测试：缺 leaveDays、reminded、demo 的旧 JSON 能读回；解码失败时原文件不被覆盖。

verdict.reason: How it fails is real, but no current save triggers it, so it is a latent bug. Checked against the code: (1) SavedState (LocalStore.swift:5-15), DayLog (LocalStore.swift:24-29) and Appointment (Models.swift:46-58) use compiler-generated Codable. In Swift, a `var` with a default value is still decoded with decode(), not decodeIfPresent(), so a missing key throws keyNotFound. The claim is correct. (2) LocalStore.load() (LocalStore.swift:38-41) uses try? to swallow the error and returns an empty SavedState() without keeping the old file. After restoreSaved(), savedMapKey is nil, so adoptMapKey() (AppStore+Map.swift:114 to AppStore+Persist.swift:45-49) calls scheduleSave() once the map loads, and saveNow() overwrites state.json with the empty state 0.5 s later. Neighbor links, appointments, reports, landmark names, real walk records and leave days are all lost for good. The same path runs on any decode failure, including a corrupt file, a renamed ReportKind/Status raw value, or a missing field. (3) The version field is never read, and the only test is CoreTests.swift:153-164, which round-trips the current format. Rebuttal check: git history shows every non-optional field (leaveDays, demo, reminded, fromPartner) arrived in the same commit as persistence (e0e9a43). The later commit 767a877 added only the optional followUpDemo. So no existing old-format save hits this today, and nothing in the spec literally says "本机数据保存要可靠". However, docs/prototype_status.md and README list 本机持久化 as working, the 767a877 commit message names 数据安全 as a goal, and the followUpDemo comment shows the team counts on old saves loading. With the current pattern, the next default-valued field anyone adds silently wipes real walk records on the device (real-device walk detection exists). This does not conflict with any settled decision. It is a latent data-loss defect with no trigger today, so severity is low.
verdict.fix: Minimal fix (S, about 30 lines): (a) In LocalStore.load(), when the file exists but decoding fails, move it to state.bad-<timestamp>.json with FileManager.moveItem before returning SavedState(), so the next save cannot overwrite the only copy. (b) Give SavedState, DayLog and Appointment a hand-written init(from:) that reads every defaulted field with decodeIfPresent(...) ?? default (or adopt a rule that new fields must be optional, as followUpDemo already is), and note in a comment on SavedState that version is for migrations. (c) Add two tests to CoreTests: hand-written old JSON missing leaveDays, demo and reminded decodes, and a decode failure leaves a .bad backup instead of an overwritten state.json.

confirmed.title: 地标 id 按裁切后的数组下标生成：换楼或缓存刷新后，同一个 id 会指向别处；后端文档却说「同一格每部手机一样」
confirmed.evidence: install() 用 full.simplified(around: 我屋企) 裁出 200 m 底座，candidates() 给面状地标的 id 是 park-i、play-ai、pitch-i，其中 i 是裁切后 areas 数组的下标（simplified 只留面积最大的 3 块，再按 drawOrder 重排）。所以住不同座的两个街坊、同一人换楼、或者 30 日缓存过期后重新拉 OSM，park-0 都会指向不同的地方；地标集合本身也不同，因为是按我屋企附近挑 3–4 个。backend_supabase.md:39 却写「由地图格子推导，同一格每部手机一样」，而 outings、meetups、reports 和地标改名都靠这个 id 交换。本机也受影响：landmarkNames 和 appointments.landmarkID 只在换楼时清除，缓存刷新或「重新生成」之后，旧改名会套到另一块地上。
confirmed.rule: 后端文档自己定的不变量；F3：改名同圈生效；F6、F7：只用地标交换位置
confirmed.fix: OSMParser 给 Area 保留 OSM 元素 id，地标 id 改为 park-<osmId>。在整格 fullMap 上挑出全邨共享的地标集合，底座只显示其中一部分。至少要改正文档，并在本机存坐标签名做校验。补测试：两座不同住宅楼的底座里，同一个 id 指向同一个 OSM 要素。

verdict.reason:
The report is correct, but it overstates the severity. The doc-vs-code mismatch is real. The local re-pointing also happens, but only in rare cases.

1. Area landmark ids are positions in the trimmed list. LandmarkDeriver.swift:60-70 builds `park-\(i)`, `play-a\(i)` and `pitch-\(i)` from the index into `map.areas`. That array comes from MapModel.swift:169-185 (`simplified`): it clips around the home building's centroid, keeps the 3 largest by area, then re-sorts by drawOrder. Area (MapModel.swift:21-25) has no OSM id. OSMParser.swift:91 has `e.id` but throws it away. POI, building and bus-stop landmarks already use OSM ids, so only area landmarks are unstable.

2. The landmark set depends on each phone's home. `install()` (AppStore+Map.swift:50-56) runs candidates, pick (at most 4) and settle on the 200 m diorama around that phone's home building. So two people in the same tile with different home blocks get different landmark sets, and `park-0` can be a different park for each.

3. The backend doc says otherwise. docs/backend_supabase.md:39 says the id is "由地图格子推导，同一格每部手机一样". Line 5 says a future SupabaseCommunityService needs no changes to the rest of the app. Both are false: outings, meetups, reports and renames all exchange these ids, so F3 renames reaching the whole circle and F6 location sharing would bind to the wrong places. This is a doc-vs-code mismatch in A's own docs and reserved interface.

4. The local effect is real but rare. `landmarkNames` and `appointments.landmarkID` are only cleared in `homeChanged()` (AppStore+Persist.swift:52-65). `applyLandmarkNames()` (line 67) applies names by id alone. A saved rename or meetup spot keyed `park-N` moves to another park when the area order changes. That can happen in three ways:
   - The 30-day TileCache expires (MapService.swift:117) and the OSM data around home has changed.
   - The app is offline and falls back to the bundled Queen's Hill map while home is in another tile.
   - The demo menu's "重新生成" is used. `regenerateHere` calls `loadMap(home: nil)`, which also switches to `defaultHome`.
   With unchanged data and the same home, the index is deterministic, so normal launches are unaffected.

5. None of the settled decisions are overturned. The fix needs no Supabase work and keeps the 200 m diorama, the 3–4 landmarks and the style simplification.

Severity is low rather than medium. This is a single-device demo, the local trigger is rare, and the cross-device part only matters once a backend exists.
verdict.fix:
Minimum fix (S):

1. Add `var osmID: Int64?` to `Area` in MapModel.swift:21. Set it with `osmID: e.id` at OSMParser.swift:91. At MapModel.swift:184, change `Area(kind:outline:name:)` to keep `a.osmID`.
2. In LandmarkDeriver.swift:65/67/69, change the ids to `park-\(a.osmID.map(String.init) ?? "a\(i)")` (same for play / pitch). Area landmarks then use OSM ids like the other landmarks, and they stay the same across cache refreshes, home changes and clipping.
3. Correct docs/backend_supabase.md:39 and line 5. Say that landmarks are currently picked per phone from the 200 m diorama around each home. Say that before going live the shared landmark set must be derived from the whole-tile fullMap, with the diorama showing a subset, so that "同一格每部手机一样" actually holds. That part is a backend-phase task (M) and does not need doing now.
4. Optional: add a test in StreetWalkTests that builds dioramas around two different residential buildings and checks that the same park id maps to the same OSM area.

confirmed.title: 刚选好的低层屋企在 200 m 底座里消失（尺寸门槛对屋企也生效）
confirmed.evidence: 用古洞北实时资料（-13_-1 格）测试：17座、18座、19座在 pickView 里都可以选，但 simplified(around:home:) 换成底座的转正角度（-13°）后，外接矩形是 13.6×8.0 m，内缩 2.5 m 后只剩 8.6×3.0 m，不满足 x1 - x0 > 4，被丢掉。内置皇后山格里一座可选的住宅 #850862098 也会丢失。后果：没有淡橙色的屋企；没有「你屋企 · 已隱身」标签（DioramaController.swift:718 的 map.building 返回 nil）；me.blockName 为 nil（AppStore+Map.swift:128）；选楼层的上限退回 30。
confirmed.rule: 已定决定：底座是我屋企周围 200 m，屋企是画面主角；选楼画面和底座必须一致
confirmed.fix: simplified 对 b.id == home 跳过面积和尺寸门槛，并保证最小占地（例如以中心扩到至少 10×10 m）。selftest 加一条断言：每座可选的住宅楼经过 simplified 后都保留。

verdict.reason:
The report holds up. I reproduced it by porting OSMParser.parse and MapModel.simplified to a script and running them on real data.

Cause (MapModel.swift:108-113 and :117-119): every building, the home included, must pass the `area >= 60` check and the `x1 - x0 > 4, y1 - y0 > 4` size check. In practice that means its bounding box, after rotation to face the plinth, has to be wider than 9 m in both directions. The home is never exempted here. It only gets special treatment later, in `nearest()` and `rank()`.

The pick screen and the diorama apply different rotations:
- `pickView(near: nil)` calls `simplified(around: .zero, size: 560)`.
- `installDiorama` calls `simplified(around: homeCentroid, size: 200)`.
`dominantAngle` comes out different for each. A building that sits at an angle in the pick view gets a larger bounding box and passes the check. Once the diorama lines it up, the box shrinks below 9 m and the building is dropped.

Results:
- **Cached live tile -13_-1 (from the simulator's tile cache):** the pick view rotation is -3.3° and the diorama's is about -13°. 17座, 18座 and 19座 all measure 13.6×8.0 m, the same numbers as the report. 20 of the 51 residential buildings you can pick from would disappear from the diorama. 17座 is also the `defaultHome` for that tile, so the same thing happens with `-skipOnboarding` and no saved home.
- **Built-in fallback_queenshill.json:** house #850862098 can be picked at -33.6° but is dropped at -29.1° (8.7×9.5 m). The default demo home, 皇順樓, is kept, so the standard demo path is not affected.

Effects confirmed in the code:
- `scene.setHomeBuilding` has no building to colour, so no light-orange home appears.
- The label check at DioramaController.swift:718, `map?.building(id:)`, returns nil, so the 「你屋企 · 已隱身」 label never shows.
- AppStore+Map.swift:128 sets `blockName` to nil.
- The floor step reads `store.map`, which is already the diorama after `confirmHome`, so Onboarding.swift:380 falls back to a maximum of 30 floors. A 3-storey village house should get 3.
- After a restart, `loadMap(home: saved)` goes through `installDiorama` again and loses the home again, so the problem persists.

This goes against existing intent. The plinth is meant to be the area around my own home, and CoreTests.swift:23 already asserts that the home is always kept (「我屋企一定保留」). That test only checks the one building nearest the centre. Dropping the home is not a style decision either: the agreed decisions only allow stylising height, shape and position, not deleting the user's own building. Many elderly users in the New Territories live in village houses of roughly 8×8 to 8×13 m, which is exactly the size range that fails this check.
verdict.fix:
In MapModel.simplified, make the `compactMap` skip both checks for the home:
- Change the first guard to `b.kind != .small, b.kind != .canopy, (b.id == home || Polygon.area(b.outline) >= 60)`.
- In the second guard, use the `x1 - x0 > 4 && y1 - y0 > 4` condition only when `b.id != home`.
- For the home, widen any side shorter than 6 m to 6 m, centred on cx/cy. Do this before the clamp.

Also add one check to tools/selftest/main.swift: every residential id in `allHomes`, put through `map.simplified(around: map.building(id:)!.centroid, home: id)`, must still have that id in `.buildings`. Effort: S (about 6 lines of code plus 2 lines of test).

confirmed.title: 拉不到地图时悄悄换成皇后山邨示例图，当作「你附近、你屋企」：定位失败不说明、过期缓存被跳过、旧约会地点变成空白
confirmed.evidence: (a) 拒绝定位或 8 秒超时后 loc 为 nil，代码用 ?? TileKey(ix:0, iy:0) 去拉皇后山的实时资料。mapSource 是 .live，说明写「實時 · 皇后山邨」，步骤文字仍是「搵緊你附近嘅樓」。用户会在别人的屋邨里选楼，homeTile=0_0 还被永久保存。(b) TileCache.read 对超过 30 日的缓存返回 nil；这时 Overpass 失败（离线或 504），load() 会跳过这份位置正确的旧缓存，直接用内置的皇后山资料。主界面找不到已保存的 home id，defaultHome() 就把皇后山的一座楼当成「你屋企」。主界面没有任何「示例」标记。旧约会、反映用的地标 id 在新图里不存在：今日卡显示「今日下晝 4 點 · 」（地点空白），按「出發」时 landmark(a.landmarkID) 为 nil，没有任何反应。OSM 资料更新导致地标 id 改变时也一样。
confirmed.rule: 诚实：示例数据要标明，不能把示例地点说成用户附近；不显示空白内容
confirmed.fix: loc 为 nil 时明确显示「攞唔到你嘅位置」，提供「再試」和「用示例屋邨」两个选择。load() 拉取失败时，先用任何时间的旧缓存，再退到内置资料。mapSource == .fallback 时主场景加「示例地圖」角标。loadMap 在 map.tile != homeTile 时不替换 home。install 后检查约会的地标还在不在，不在的显示「地點要再揀」并提供改约入口。

verdict.reason:
I checked the code and the main claim holds. One part is overstated and one is a design choice, not a bug.

(a) Real, and the trigger is easier to hit than the report says. Location is first requested in consent() → loadMap → MapService.currentLocation (MapService.swift:27-35). The 8-second timer starts at the same moment requestWhenInUseAuthorization shows the system permission dialog. A user who takes more than 8 seconds to read it gets finishLocation(nil). Tapping Allow later does nothing, because the continuation is already gone. A user who taps Don't Allow also gets nil.

With loc nil, AppStore+Map.swift:21 falls back to TileKey(ix:0, iy:0). That tile is the Queen's Hill sample estate (Geo.swift:48). load() then fetches it from Overpass, so mapSource is .live. The pick-home caption reads「實時 · 皇后山邨」(Onboarding.swift:323-326). Nothing says the location could not be found. The step has no retry or back button. finishOnboarding then saves homeTile as 0_0 (AppStore+Map.swift:97).

What softens it: the caption does show the name 皇后山邨, and Settings → beginChangeHome (Settings.swift:139-144) lets the user pick again. But nothing tells the user they need to. Labelling a stand-in estate「實時」with no "location unavailable" message breaks the honesty rule that sample data must be marked. None of the settled decisions cover this; they are about the backend and residents, not map fallback.

(b) Partly real. Expiring the cache after 30 days is documented (prototype_status.md:13「缓存 30 日」), so on its own it is not a bug. The real problem comes when the cache is gone (expired, or cleared by iOS) and Overpass fails, for example offline or a 504. Then load() returns the bundled Queen's Hill map (MapService.swift:65-74). The saved home id is not in it, so defaultHome() (AppStore+Map.swift:26) quietly makes a Queen's Hill block "your home". mapSource is only shown during onboarding, so the main screen has no「示例」mark. Saved data is not wiped (adoptMapKey and homeChanged guard it), and the next online launch recovers. But for that session:
- The appointment card shows「…下晝 4 點 · 」with the place blank (Tabs.swift:191).
- departForAppointment returns silently when landmark(a.landmarkID) is nil (AppStore+Find.swift:53).

Impact on the Queen's Hill demo is zero, because the simulator location is set there. Real-device first runs, which are still on the to-do list, hit (a) easily. So I agree with medium.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix, about M effort:
1. MapService.currentLocation: when the status is .notDetermined, start the 8-second timer only after locationManagerDidChangeAuthorization reports the user's choice, or give the permission prompt its own much longer timeout.
2. loadMap: when homeTile and loc are both nil, set a flag such as store.locationFailed and treat the source as the sample. In OnbPickHomeStep, show and speak「攞唔到你嘅位置，而家係示例屋邨：皇后山邨」with a「再試」button that calls beginChangeHome().
3. MapService.load: when the fetch fails, read the tile's cache at any age before falling back to the bundled map. Add a maxAge parameter to TileCache.read.
4. In the main phase, when fullMap.tile differs from the saved homeTile (fallback in use), do not call defaultHome. Show a「示例地圖 · 暫時攞唔到你屋企」badge or banner on the main scene.
5. Appointment card: if landmark(a.landmarkID) is nil, show「地點要再揀」instead of a blank. departForAppointment should show a toast and speak instead of returning silently.

confirmed.title: Overpass 备用服务器已失效，超时与重试设置不当，最坏要等两分多钟，期间只有转圈
confirmed.evidence: 2026-10-08 用同一个查询和 UA 实测：overpass.private.coffee 对任何查询（包括最小的）都回 HTTP 500；maps.mail.ru 不带 UA 回 504，带 UA 要 18–22 秒；overpass-api.de 首次请求 5 次里有 4 次回 504（8–14 秒）。代码方面：每个请求的 timeoutInterval 是 20 秒，这是闲置超时，而 Overpass 算完之前不会发回任何数据，查询本身却设了 [timeout:60]；每台服务器试 2 次，最后一次失败后仍然 sleep 2 或 4 秒；if i == 0 { continue } 没有作用。最坏大约要等 3×(20+2+20+4) ≈ 140 秒，再加 8 秒定位，才退到兜底。这期间画面只有「搵緊你附近嘅樓…」转圈，不能取消或跳过。实测成功的情况也要 16–28 秒。
confirmed.rule: §4 包容性：不应让长者面对长时间没有回应的等待
confirmed.fix: 移除 private.coffee。overpass-api.de 和 mail.ru 用 withTaskGroup 同时请求，谁先回就用谁，总时限约 30 秒；单个请求 timeout 设 30 秒；最后一次失败后不再 sleep。等待超过 10 秒就显示「仲搵緊…」和「用示例屋邨」按钮。

verdict.reason: The report holds up against the code. In ios/StreetWalk/Map/MapService.swift:87-101, fetch() goes through 3 endpoints and tries each one twice. Each try is URLRequest(timeoutInterval: 20) (line 89), which is an idle timeout, while the query file estate.overpassql asks the server for [timeout:60]. Overpass sends nothing until the query finishes, so any answer that takes more than 20 s gets cut off, even though it would have come back. Line 98 sleeps 2 s or 4 s after every failed try, including the last one. Line 100, `if i == 0 { continue }`, sits at the end of the loop body and does nothing. Worst case before falling back: 3×(20+2+20+4) = 138 s, plus up to 8 s from currentLocation(timeout: 8). AppStore+Map.swift:12-36 shows the onboarding locate step waiting on that whole chain. OnbLocateStep (Onboarding.swift:236-270) shows only 「搵緊你附近嘅樓…」 and a ProgressView, with no cancel, skip or "use the example estate" button, and the top bar has no back button on this step. I sent a tiny query to each server today: overpass.private.coffee returned HTTP 500 in 0.8 s, so that endpoint is dead; maps.mail.ru took 15.8 s; overpass-api.de answered 200 in 1.6 s. This hits the first run on a real device with no cached tile, and the device run is the project's next step. Nothing in the agreed decisions conflicts with this: standalone demo mode still uses the live map with a built-in fallback. One correction to the report: §4 of the spec has no rule saying "don't make older users wait"; that is the reporter's paraphrase. So this counts as a performance and wrong-behaviour problem with a real accessibility impact, not a breach of a written rule. The cache keeps tiles for 30 days, and the built-in Queen's Hill estate is used as the eventual fallback, so the damage is limited to the first load. That makes it medium, not high.
verdict.fix:
Changes, about S effort:
1. MapService.swift:13-17: delete the overpass.private.coffee endpoint.
2. Line 89: change timeoutInterval from 20 to 30.
3. Line 98: sleep only when another try follows (attempt == 0), not after the last one. Delete the dead `if i == 0 { continue }` on line 100.
