4. Put a total time limit on fetch(), about 35 s. Either record a start Date and return nil once it passes, or send overpass-api.de and maps.mail.ru at the same time with withTaskGroup and use whichever answers first.
5. OnbLocateStep (Onboarding.swift:240-268): after about 10 s, add a line 「仲搵緊…」 and a large button 「用示例屋邨」. The button cancels the loading Task (keep a handle to it in AppStore.consent()) and goes straight to MapService.fallback() and the pick-home step.

confirmed.title: 地标常常不足 3 个，还会出现两个同名的「公園櫈仔」；地标不足时约人、找人、出门都静静失败
confirmed.evidence: 实时资料测试：古洞北每个底座都只有 2 个候选，两个都是没有名字的公园；东涌默认屋企的底座是 2 个公园加 1 个楼下大堂。公园候选一律 hasSeat=true，模板都命名为「公園櫈仔」，于是出现两个同名地标（主界面显示「今朝 15 人經過公園櫈仔」），语音「改去公園櫈仔」、约会和出门提醒都会有歧义。楼下大堂候选要求 levels ≥10 而且有名字，低层屋邨一个都没有。地标为 0 个时：pickMeetupSpot 返回 nil，proposeMeetup 直接 return，按「約佢行」没反应，语音「約陳太…」既没有复述卡也没有语音回应，goFind 和 neighborGoesOut 同样不作声；startWalk 的路线只有起点，第一次 tick 就 finishWalk，记下一笔 1 分钟散步并计入连续天数；「揀一句」还建议「涼亭改名做大樹底」，按了只得到「未聽明白」。只有 1 个时，「換個地方」因为要求 ranked.count > 1 而没反应；有 2 个时，散步路线会把第一个地标走两次。prototype_status 写的是「自动挑 3–4 个地标」。
confirmed.rule: 已定决定：地标 3–4 个；F3：所有位置都用地标名显示，必须能区分；§4：所有提示同时有语音和图像
confirmed.fix: 候选不足 3 个时补充：任何高度的有名住宅楼「X座樓下」、路口、底座外最近的巴士站（夹到边上）。公园、凉亭、櫈、球场这类泛称每类最多 1 个，或者命名后去重并加上最近的楼名（例如「17座旁公園櫈仔」）。selftest 加入三个屋邨的断言。地标不足时，约人和找人入口用语音加文字说明「附近未有合適嘅地標」；landmarks 为空时 startWalk 不出发、不记纪录，也不出改名短句；只有一个地标时禁用「換個地方」并说明原因。

verdict.reason:
The main problem is real. I checked it by compiling the current Map/ and Domain/ code into a scratch harness and running it on the bundled demo map (fallback_queenshill.json) and on the OSM tiles saved earlier in the audit. I changed no repo files.

1) Too few landmarks. LandmarkDeriver.pick (LandmarkDeriver.swift:96) returns whatever it has once the spacing is relaxed to 30 m, even if that is fewer than 3. settle() can drop more. Nothing in install() (AppStore+Map.swift:55) fills the gap.
- Demo estate 皇后山: 21 of the 30 residential homes end up with only 2 landmarks. The default home 皇順樓 gets 3, which is why the scripted demo looks fine.
- 古洞 tile (kt.json): 7 homes get 0 landmarks, 25 get 1 and 36 get 2.
- 東涌 tile: mostly 2.
- prototype_status.md says 「自动挑 3–4 个地标」. selftest only checks 3...4 on the full map, never per home, so the docs do not match the code.

2) Duplicate names. Every park candidate gets hasSeat=true (LandmarkDeriver.swift:65). TemplateAI.nameLandmark then returns 「公園櫈仔」 and ignores osmName (TemplateAI.swift:94). pick allows 2 of each kind (:91), so two 「公園櫈仔」 appear.
- In the demo estate this happens for the named blocks 皇溢樓, 皇盛樓 and 皇澄樓, and for most unnamed blocks.
- The 東涌 default home gets park + park + food, so it also has two 「公園櫈仔」. The reporter listed this home as 2 parks + lobby; the kinds differ, but the duplicate is the same.
- parseVoice picks a landmark by name match (TemplateAI.swift:22/34), so 「改去公園櫈仔」 or a rename cannot tell the two apart. This works against F3: a location shown only as a landmark name has to tell places apart.

3) Silent failures with 0 landmarks, all confirmed in code:
- proposeMeetup has `guard !options.isEmpty else { return }` (Meetup:16) and shows no toast. The voice invite then gets no card, because handle() only builds the card if a proposal exists.
- goFind (Find:8) and neighborGoesOut (Neighbors:86) return silently.
- startWalk builds a route with only the start point, finishes on the first tick and records a 1-minute walk. This is the demo-only simulated walk.
- The suggested phrase falls back to 「涼亭改名做大樹底」, which parses to 未聽明白.
- With 1 landmark, 「換個地方」 returns silently because of the ranked.count > 1 check (Meetup:56).

Overstated:
- 「把第一个地标走两次」: with 2 stops the route is [s0, s0, s1]. The s0→s0 leg has zero length, so nothing visible happens.
- The 0- and 1-landmark failures need live map data from sparse areas such as 古洞. The bundled demo map always gives at least 2.

None of this conflicts with the decided rules: stylisation covers building height, position and shade, not how many landmarks there are or whether their names are unique.

Severity is medium. The duplicate names are visible in the bundled demo whenever onboarding picks one of the common blocks. The silent failures go against §4 (every prompt has voice and image), but only with live map data.
verdict.fix:
Effort M. All changes are in A-owned files.

(1) LandmarkDeriver.pick: allow at most 1 each of the generic kinds park, playground, shelter, bench and pitch.

(2) LandmarkDeriver.candidates: add a low-priority fallback for when fewer than 3 are picked. Accept residential buildings of any height, named or not, as 「X座樓下」 or 「樓下大堂」.

(3) AppStore.install, after naming: make names unique. Prefix the nearest named block (「17座旁公園櫈仔」), or add an ordinal if there is none. This also fixes the voice matching ambiguity without touching B's TemplateAI.

(4) Handle empty or too few landmarks:
- proposeMeetup and goFind: when there is no landmark or no option, toast plus speak 「附近未有合適嘅地標」.
- handle(.invite): show a voice card in the same case.
- startWalk: add `guard !landmarks.isEmpty`.
- suggestedPhrases: leave out the rename phrase when there are no landmarks.
- nextProposalPlace: when there is only 1 landmark, toast 「附近只有一個地標」.

(5) selftest: for every home in fallback_queenshill, assert that the diorama has at least 3 landmarks and that the names are unique.

confirmed.title: 渲染线程和主线程不加锁共用场景状态（homeLabel、reportMarks、map、landmarkNodes、followID、target），可能偶发闪退
confirmed.evidence: sample 证实 renderer(_:updateAtTime:) 跑在 com.apple.scenekit.renderingQueue。它在 lock 内读 map、reportMarks、homeLabel、homeBuildingID、landmarkNodes，但主线程写这些值时不加锁（只有读的一方加锁，等于没锁）：load() 第 109 行 self.map = map；setLandmarks 第 272、279 行直接改 landmarkNodes；syncScene 每次都写 scene.reportMarks 和 scene.homeLabel（超过 15 字节，是堆上的字符串）。followStep 在渲染线程读 followID、写 target 并调用 applyCamera，主线程的 setCamera 和 moveTarget 也在写 target；SCNAction 的 customAction 同样在主线程以外写 target 和 distance。Swift 的 Array、Dictionary、String 同时读写属于未定义行为，可能因引用计数出错而崩溃；散步演示（频繁调用 syncScene）和切换深浅色时最容易出事。
confirmed.rule: 线程安全，不得闪退
confirmed.fix: 所有共享状态改成私有存储，加上带锁的 setter（或在 lock 内读写的计算属性）。或者把标签投影和镜头跟随都移到主线程的 CADisplayLink，读 presentation 节点；相机状态只由一个线程修改。用 Thread Sanitizer 跑一遍 -script。

verdict.reason:
The data race is real, but it is narrower and much less likely to crash than the report says.

What holds up:
- DioramaView.swift:16-21 makes the controller the SCNView delegate, with isPlaying and rendersContinuously on. So renderer(_:updateAtTime:) (DioramaController.swift:691) runs on SceneKit's render thread at 60 fps and builds labels at 30 Hz.
- At lines 697-700 it copies personState, personNodes, landmarkInfo, landmarkNodes, reportMarks, homeBuildingID, homeLabel and map inside lock.
- Only personNodes, personState, landmarkInfo, towerNodes and pickableNodes are also written inside lock (lines 112, 135, 273, 284, 566, 580, 584). That shows the authors meant every shared value to go through the lock.
- The following writes skip the lock:
  - load() line 109: self.map = map. MapModel is a struct holding heap arrays.
  - setLandmarks() lines 272 and 279: landmarkNodes = [:] and landmarkNodes[l.id] = n. These run on load and on every light/dark switch (setDark, line 140).
  - syncScene() in AppStore+Map.swift:169-171: scene.homeLabel and scene.reportMarks are written on every call. reportMarks is an array of tuples holding heap uuidString values.
- In Swift, if the render thread loads the buffer pointer and the main thread releases the old buffer before the render thread retains it, the result is use-after-free. That is undefined behaviour, so the bug is real.

What is overstated:
- syncScene is not called often during the demo walk. tickWalk runs every 250 ms (AppStore+Walk.swift:68-81) and only calls setTrail; it never calls syncScene. syncScene runs only on events: starting or ending a walk, finding a neighbour, bump, adding a report, and so on. Light/dark switching is also a one-off event. The window for a crash is a few instructions wide, so the chance of a crash during the demo is extremely low.
- The camera part (followID, target, distance) cannot crash:
  - target and distance are Vec2 (two Doubles) and Float, which are not reference-counted. At worst a frame reads a torn value and the camera jumps for one frame.
  - followID only ever holds "me" (a small string stored inline) or nil.
  - followStep also checks fly == nil, panAnchor == nil and displayLink == nil. Pan and pinch both remove the fly action first, so these paths hardly ever overlap in practice.
- homeLabel only ever holds one string literal ("你屋企 · 已隱身"). Literals are never reference-counted, so the realistic crash sources are reportMarks, landmarkNodes and map.

None of this conflicts with the settled decisions. Given how unlikely a crash is, I rate it low, not medium.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix (effort S, about 15 lines), all in DioramaController.swift:
1. Rename homeLabel and reportMarks to private storage (_homeLabel, _reportMarks). Keep the old names as computed properties whose get and set both take the lock, e.g. `var reportMarks: [...] { get { lock.lock(); defer { lock.unlock() }; return _reportMarks } set { lock.lock(); _reportMarks = newValue; lock.unlock() } }`. Do the same for homeLabel and homeBuildingID. No change is needed in AppStore+Map.swift.
2. At line 109 in load(), wrap the write: `lock.lock(); self.map = map; lock.unlock()`.
3. In setLandmarks(), build a local dictionary `var nodes: [String: SCNNode] = [:]` inside the loop. After the loop, assign it once with `lock.lock(); landmarkNodes = nodes; lock.unlock()`, and remove the unlocked writes at lines 272 and 279.
The camera fields (target, distance, followID) can stay as they are, because they cannot crash. If you want to tidy them anyway, move followStep to the main thread's CADisplayLink so that only one thread writes the camera.

confirmed.title: 3D 场景一直以 60fps、4×MSAA、16 次采样软阴影重画，标签每秒发布 30 次，画面静止时也一样
confirmed.evidence: 设置是 rendersContinuously=true、60fps、4×MSAA、2048 阴影贴图、shadowSampleCount 16、shadowRadius 4，场景完全不动也每帧重画。实测：iPhone Air 模拟器停在「今日」页不动，用 sample 抓 4 秒，渲染队列一直在 _drawAtTime（约 33 ms/秒），整个进程占 4–8% CPU。晚上 setSun 只把光强设为 0，阴影 pass 仍然在跑。renderer 每 1/30 秒无条件执行 DispatchQueue.main.async { overlay.items = items }，@Observable 不会去掉相同的值，所以 SceneLabelsLayer 每秒重算 30 次，这也可能加剧 A10 的刷新丢失。散步途中（F8 全屏找人）屏幕长时间亮着，目标机型 iPhone 11 的耗电和发热风险大。
confirmed.rule: 性能与耗电；F5 目标机型 iPhone 11 及之后
confirmed.fix: rendersContinuously 平时设为 false（SCNAction 执行期间 SceneKit 会自动重画），只在有人移动或镜头动画时打开。没有移动时 preferredFramesPerSecond 降到 30。shadowSampleCount 改为 4–8。太阳在地平线以下时 castsShadow = false。overlay 只在条目变化或位置移动超过 0.5–1 pt 时才发布。删除无人使用的 onOverlay。

verdict.reason:
Partly confirmed. The idle-rendering part is real. The label part is wrong.

Confirmed:
- DioramaView.swift:18-21 sets multisampling4X, preferredFramesPerSecond = 60, isPlaying = true and rendersContinuously = true. SCNView's default for rendersContinuously is false.
- DioramaController.swift:291-297 sets shadowSampleCount 16, shadowRadius 4 and a 2048x2048 shadow map.
- setSun (lines 316-330) only sets the sun's intensity to 0 when the sun is down. castsShadow stays true, so the shadow pass still runs at night.
- On the 今日 tab with no walk, no find, no bump and no neighbour out, syncScene (AppStore+Map.swift:145-172) puts no people in the scene, so nothing moves. The view still redraws the whole scene 60 times a second.
- onOverlay (line 83, called at line 729) is never assigned anywhere, so it is dead code.

Wrong or overstated:
1. "@Observable does not skip equal values, so SceneLabelsLayer recomputes 30 times a second" is false on this project's toolchain (Xcode 26.6, Swift 6.3.3). The macro plugin libObservationMacros contains shouldNotifyObservers, and for Equatable types it is `lhs != rhs`. OverlayItem is Equatable (line 21), so an identical [OverlayItem] array sends no notification and SceneLabelsLayer does not recompute. All that is left is one cheap main-queue hop every 1/30 s. This also does not support the claimed link to A10.
2. The walk / F8 find battery argument does not support the main fix. Every person node runs bob (line 600, repeatForever) and a move action (line 619, repeatForever for wander). SceneKit redraws every frame while actions run, so turning off rendersContinuously saves nothing during a walk, a find, or while a neighbour is out. Only a lower frame rate or cheaper shadows would help there.
3. No spec rule is broken. The spec has no performance or battery requirement. "iPhone 11" in the spec (line 75) is the device limit for bump (碰一碰), not a rendering target. prototype_status.md:36 already lists "iPhone 11 性能" as a pending real-device test.
4. Changing shadowSampleCount affects how soft the paper-cut (纸雕) shadows look. Under the decided rule that style comes before realism, that should not be changed for this issue.
5. The suggested fix has a regression risk the report missed. Labels are computed only inside renderer(_:updateAtTime:). Some changes are plain properties, not scene-graph changes: homeLabel and reportMarks (AppStore+Map.swift:170-171) and renameLandmark (DioramaController.swift:283-285). With rendersContinuously = false and a static scene, these changes would not reach the labels until something else causes a redraw.

Conclusion: a real performance risk at idle, and a small one. It wastes some power on the home tab and keeps the night shadow pass running. It breaks no spec rule and affects no behaviour, so severity is low.
verdict.fix:
Effort is small (S).

1. DioramaView.swift:21: change rendersContinuously to false. SCNActions, SCNTransaction animations and camera node changes all trigger redraws on their own.
2. Add a method to DioramaController, for example `func labelsChanged() { lastOverlayPush = 0; view?.setNeedsDisplay() }`. Call it after renameLandmark, setHomeBuilding, and the homeLabel/reportMarks assignments in AppStore+Map.swift:170-171. Otherwise those label changes will not appear while the scene is static. Check this on the simulator: rename a landmark, file a report, and start and end a walk; the labels must update right away.
3. setSun (DioramaController.swift:326): add `sunNode.light?.castsShadow = day` so the shadow pass is skipped at night.
4. Optional: drop preferredFramesPerSecond to 30. This is the only change in this list that also saves power during walks and finds.
5. Delete the unused onOverlay (lines 83 and 729).

Do not change shadowSampleCount or shadowRadius, because they set the paper-cut look. Do not add value dedup to the overlay: Observation already skips equal Equatable values.

confirmed.title: 太阳落山后遮荫按 100% 算：卡片写「100% 有樓遮」，约人理由和天气提示说「有樓遮住」不属实
confirmed.evidence: 太阳高度 ≤2° 时一律返回 1.0，所以所有地标在 19:00 都是 100%，12 月 21 日 7:00 也是 100%。结果：晚上点地标会看到「而家大約 100% 有樓遮」和楼宇图标。约人的候选时段包括 18:00（10 月太阳高度只有 0.3°，12 月 21 日是 -4.2°），还有 hour+1 和改约产生的 19–21 点，理由却写「嗰陣有樓遮住」，其实是天黑了。shadedFromHour 因为太阳下山返回 18，F9 提示变成「X 下晝六點後有樓遮住，嗰陣行最舒服」。
confirmed.rule: 文案准确、诚实；F7：选点理由要真实；F9
confirmed.fix: 把「没有太阳」和「有楼遮」分开：排序时 elevation ≤2 当作 0，另外提供 isSunUp(at:)（或者 ShadeProviding 在夜间返回 nil）。信息卡显示「太陽落咗山」，理由写「嗰陣已經日落」。shadedFromHour 只计太阳高度 >5° 的钟点。

verdict.reason:
The issue is real, and I confirmed it against the code. ShadeCalculator.swift:35 returns 1.0 whenever the sun is at 2° or lower (`guard sun.elevation > 2 else { return 1 }`). I compiled SolarPosition.swift for the Queen's Hill coordinates: on Oct 8 (today) the elevation is 0.31° at 18:00 and -13.5° at 19:00, and on Dec 21 it is -0.51° at 07:00 and -4.17° at 18:00. All of those count as 100% shade.

How it shows up:
(1) The demo time slider (UI/Demo.swift:106, range 6...19) and the landmark card (Cards.swift:135/205) still show every landmark as "遮蔭 100%" / "而家大約 100% 有樓遮" with the building icon after about 18:00, even while the slider caption at Demo.swift:204 already says "太陽已經落山". The two messages contradict each other. The card says the same thing in real-time use every night.
(2) When no time is given, candidateTimes (AppStore+Meetup.swift:35) offers 18:00 today. A user-chosen hour plus 1 can reach 21:00 (line 28). All of these get the reason "嗰陣有樓遮住" from AppStore+Meetup.swift:68 or TemplateAI.swift:135. This breaks F7's requirement that the reason be true.
(3) If no hour from 14 to 17 reaches 0.6, shadedFromHour returns 18. F9 then shows "…夜晚 6 點後有樓遮住，嗰陣行最舒服", which calls darkness building shade.

This does not fall under the decision that shade only needs to be roughly accurate. That decision covers calculation precision. Here the app says buildings block the sun when the sun has set, which is a factual wording error.

**More serious problem in the same lines:** ShadeService.swift:37 uses `for h in hour...18`. AppStore+Places.swift:129 passes `max(hour, 14)`. When the HK hour is 19 or later, this builds the range `19...18`, which crashes the app. I reproduced this with swiftc -O: exit 133, SIGTRAP. It can be triggered three ways:
- Drag the demo time slider to its right end (19:00). setDemoHour calls refreshWeatherTip, which crashes.
- Launch with `-hour 19` or later.
- Open or return to the app on a real device after 19:00 without -hour. refreshLiveWeather calls applyLiveWeather, then refreshWeatherTip, and it crashes.

The copy problem alone is medium. I rated this high because the cited shadedFromHour crashes.
verdict.fix:
Effort is S, and every change is in A's code.

1. **Crash first.** At the top of ShadeService.shadedFromHour, add `guard hour <= 18 else { return nil }`. In the loop, skip hours where the sun is too low: compute `SolarPosition.at(t, lat: center.lat, lon: center.lon).elevation` and only count hours above 5°, so the function no longer returns 18 just because it is dark.

2. **Sun-up check.** Add `func isSunUp(at date: Date) -> Bool` to ShadeService (elevation > 2). It does not need to go into ShadeProviding, because store.shade is already the concrete ShadeService. Keep ranking unchanged: treating no sun as 1.0 is fine for picking spots.

3. **Copy.**
   - Cards.swift:205: when `!isSunUp(store.now)`, show "太陽落咗山，冇得曬" with a moon icon.
   - Demo.swift shadeRow: at night show "遮蔭 —".
   - AppStore+Meetup.swift:68 reason(for:): at night return "嗰陣已經日落".
   - TemplateAI.swift:135 is B's file. Either have A replace the reason prefix after pickMeetupSpot returns (proposeMeetup, startEditing, partnerInvites), or ask B to apply the same check.

confirmed.title: 关掉演示模式后，演示用的时间和天气仍然生效，而且改不回来
confirmed.evidence: setDemoMode(false) 不重置 demoHour 和 hko.demoOverride。用过时间滑杆或演示菜单的「酷熱」后再关演示模式：now 停在滑杆的钟点，约会提醒、过期判断、候选时间、太阳位置、天气建议都按假时间算；天气一直是手选的「今日好熱…」，也没有示範标记。能改回来的时间滑杆和「重置演示」都在已经隐藏的演示菜单里，只能重开 App；如果启动时带了 -hour，就永远改不回。
confirmed.rule: 诚实（非演示模式不显示模拟数据）；状态一致
confirmed.fix: setDemoMode(false) 时设 demoHour = nil（启动参数另行处理）、hko.demoOverride = false，再依次调用 applyLiveWeather()、updateSun 和 checkAppointments。

verdict.reason:
问题确实存在，但"改不回来"这一点说过头了。

代码事实：
- setDemoMode(_:)（ios/StreetWalk/UI/Settings.swift:129-137）只改 demoMode、demo 街坊、散步检测和 populate()。它不碰 demoHour，也不碰 hko.demoOverride。
- now（Store/AppStore.swift:103-106）只要 demoHour 不是 nil，就固定在今天的那个钟点。
- setWeather（Store/AppStore+Places.swift:92-100）把 hko.demoOverride 设成 true。之后 applyLiveWeather 一开头就因为这个标志直接返回（:113）。回到前台时 refreshLiveWeather 也绕不过它。
- refreshWeatherTip 在 demoOverride 时会删掉"天文台話"前缀（:132-135）。所以关掉演示模式后，今日页（UI/Tabs.swift:25）照样显示手选的"今日好熱/落雨…"，没有示範标记。
- 唯一能清掉这个标志的是 useLiveWeather，只在 resetDemo 里调用（Store/DemoScript.swift:104-115）。「跟返而家時間」按钮在时间滑杆里。滑杆和重置都在 DemoMenu 里，而 DemoMenu 只在 demoMode 为真时显示（UI/MainView.swift:231）。

触发步骤：演示菜单选「酷熱」或拖时间滑杆 → 去设置关掉演示模式。结果是非演示模式下：
- 天气建议仍是模拟的，没有标「示範」，这违反 docs/prototype_status.md:7"界面上所有模拟的数据都标了「示範」"；
- now 停在假钟点：出发前提醒、「過咗期」判断（checkAppointments 每 30 秒用 now 算）、太阳位置、遮荫建议都错，真实约会的提醒可能一直不响。

和已定的决定不冲突。"单机演示 + 示範标记"正好要求非演示模式不出现模拟数据。

说过头的地方：
- 还能恢复：重新打开演示模式，用「跟返而家時間」或「重置演示」（只清示範数据）再关掉，或者重开 App。demoHour 和 demoOverride 都没有存盘。
- "-hour 永远改不回"只影响开发者启动参数，普通用户碰不到。

严重程度定为 medium 的理由：
- 往上：属于诚实问题，而且非演示模式下的约会提醒和过期判断会失效。
- 往下：要先用演示控件再手动关演示模式才会出现，重开 App 就恢复，也没有数据损失。
verdict.fix:
在 ios/StreetWalk/UI/Settings.swift 的 setDemoMode 里，populate() 之前加一行：

```swift
if !on { showTimeSlider = false; hko.demoOverride = false; setDemoHour(nil); applyLiveWeather() }
```

setDemoHour(nil) 已经包含 updateSun、refreshWeatherTip、checkAppointments。applyLiveWeather 在 demoOverride 清掉后把天气改回实时，没有实时数据时改回 .normal。关演示模式时连 -hour 启动参数一起放弃也合理：非演示模式就该用真实时间。

工作量：S，改一行，可以顺便补一个单元测试：setWeather(.hot) 和 setDemoHour(15) 之后调用 setDemoMode(false)，断言 demoHour == nil 且 hko.demoOverride == false。

confirmed.title: 场景里的太阳和楼影只在装地图时算一次，不跟真实时间；跨日后「今日」状态也不刷新
confirmed.evidence: updateSun 只在 install()、setDemoHour、resetDemo 里调用。早上 9 点打开 App、下午 4 点回到前台，场景里仍是早上的影子，而地标卡的「而家大約 X% 有樓遮」按 store.now 现算，两者对不上。跨日时也不调用 refreshMe()，「今日已請假」、今日一句和连续天数会停在昨天。
confirmed.rule: F9：遮荫要跟时间；状态一致
confirmed.fix: 在 30 秒的时钟里，demoHour 为 nil 时每 5–15 分钟调用一次 updateSun(animated:true)。appActive(true) 时调用 updateSun 和 refreshMe。发现 dayKey 变了就调用 refreshMe()。

verdict.reason:
The report holds up in the code. updateSun (AppStore+Map.swift:176-179) is only called from install() (:63), setDemoHour (:183) and resetDemo (DemoScript.swift:111). The 30-second clock (AppStore+Meetup.swift:257-265) only calls checkAppointments(), and appActive(true) (AppStore+Services.swift:6-15) only refreshes weather and walk detection.

When demoHour == nil, `now` is the live Date(). This happens on a real phone without -hour, or after pressing 「跟返而家時間」 in the time slider (Demo.swift:116-123). The scene keeps the sun angle from whenever it was last set. Meanwhile the landmark card (Cards.swift:135, 205) and the time-slider shade rows recompute from store.now on each render, so the shadows and 「而家大約 X% 有樓遮」 drift apart over hours.

The cross-day part is also real. refreshMe() (AppStore+Persist.swift:166-175) runs only from populate, recordWalk, toggleLeave and the Settings floor change. If the app stays in memory past midnight, me.onLeave, streakDays and todayLine keep yesterday's values while todayMinutes (log(for: now)) is live. That is worse than a stale label. Yesterday's 「今日已請假」 still shows, and pressing 「撤回」 makes toggleLeave (AppStore+Walk.swift:193-199) insert today's key instead. The result is the opposite of what the user pressed, and it says 「收到，今日請假」.

This does not conflict with the agreed decisions. "遮荫大致准确" is about geometric precision, not freezing the time. The weak part is the rule cited: F9 has no explicit "shadows follow time" clause. The real problem is the state mismatch and the inverted leave toggle.

I am lowering severity to low. The demo always runs with -hour 10 (fixed demoHour), so the scripted demo is unaffected. A few minutes of drift after 「跟返而家時間」 is not visible. The bug needs real-time use over hours, or across midnight with the app kept alive, which is mostly a real-device scenario and real-device testing is still on the to-do list.
verdict.fix:
Effort S, about 10 lines in AppStore+Meetup.swift startClock and AppStore+Services.swift appActive.
(1) In appActive(true), call updateSun(animated: false), refreshMe() and checkAppointments(), so returning to the foreground resyncs.
(2) In the startClock loop, keep a lastDay = LocalStore.dayKey(now) and a tick counter. Every 10 ticks (5 min) while demoHour == nil, call updateSun(animated: true). Whenever LocalStore.dayKey(now) != lastDay, update lastDay and call refreshMe() and refreshWeatherTip().
updateSun already returns early when map is nil and refreshMe returns early when residents is empty, so no extra guards are needed.

confirmed.title: 演示菜单「喺而家位置重新生成」用的不是现在的位置，还会悄悄把我住的楼换成默认楼
confirmed.evidence: regenerateHere 调用 loadMap(home: nil)。在主界面阶段，只要 UserDefaults 里有 homeTile 就不取定位，所以只是重拉屋企那一格，不是「而家位置」。home 传 nil，代码就用 defaultHome(in:) 选离格子中心最近的住宅楼，忽略已保存的 homeBuilding：场景高亮、「住喺」、出门起点、homeTarget 都变了，重启后又变回来。savedMapKey 不更新，homeChanged 也不调用，约会和改名仍按旧楼的地标 id。
confirmed.rule: 菜单文字要和实际行为一致；状态一致
confirmed.fix: 把已保存的 homeBuilding 传进去。如果真要按当前位置重建，就绕过 homeTile，走「改我住嘅樓」的流程；否则把菜单改名为「重新下載地圖」。

verdict.reason:
I checked the code and the report is accurate. `regenerateHere()` at ios/StreetWalk/Store/DemoScript.swift:98-102 calls `loadMap(home: nil, animated: true)`. In AppStore+Map.swift:15-21, once the app is on the main screen and UserDefaults has a saved `homeTile` (`finishOnboarding` writes it at :97), the code skips `currentLocation()` and reloads that saved tile. So after a real onboarding, the menu item「喺而家位置重新生成」(UI/Demo.swift:41) does not use the current location, and the label is wrong.

Because `home` is nil, :25 falls back to `defaultHome(in:)`, the residential building nearest the tile centre, and never reads the saved "homeBuilding". The startup path does pass it (AppStore.swift:131). If the user picked any building other than the default one, this call silently swaps the home for the rest of the session. That changes the highlighted building, the `homeTarget` used for walk start and arrival, the 「住喺」 row in settings, and the 「我」 resident's `blockName`/`homeLandmarkID`. `savedMapKey` stays the same, because `adoptMapKey` only writes it when nil, and `homeChanged` is never called. Saved landmark names and appointments now refer to landmark ids from the old diorama. Nothing crashes, since `landmark(_:)` returns an optional. Restarting the app restores the right building.

The demo menu shows whenever demo mode is on, and demo mode defaults to true (AppStore.swift:121). So a real user who has onboarded can reach this.

This does not touch any of the already-settled decisions. In the default demo launch (`-demo -skipOnboarding` with no earlier onboarding), there is no `homeTile` and no `homeBuilding`, so the item really does reload at the current location and picks the same default building. The bug only shows after someone has done onboarding. It is limited to a demo tool, the effect lasts one session, and no data is lost, so I rate it low rather than medium.
verdict.fix: Smallest fix (S): in DemoScript.swift:101, pass the saved building, `Task { await loadMap(home: (UserDefaults.standard.object(forKey: "homeBuilding") as? NSNumber)?.int64Value, animated: true) }`. Also rename the label at UI/Demo.swift:41 to 「重新載入地圖」, since with a saved homeTile it reloads the home tile. If a real "rebuild at my current location" is wanted, the menu item should call the existing `beginChangeHome()` (Settings.swift:139) instead. That path goes through choosing the building and `homeChanged()`, so the map key and the appointment and landmark data stay consistent.

confirmed.title: 启动时对方的回覆比地图先到，横幅和语音出现空名字、空地点
confirmed.evidence: init 里的 community.resume(appointments) 在地图装好、populate 之前就排定了 3 秒后回覆。没有缓存时（例如用过「重新生成」清了 TileCache，或缓存过期），地图要几秒到几十秒才装好。3 秒时 residents 和 landmarks 都还是空的，partnerAnswered 用空字符串兜底，横幅和语音就变成「應承咗：今日下晝 4 點，喺附近見。」，名字和地点都是空的。
confirmed.rule: 不显示空名字；语音和图像提示都要完整
confirmed.fix: 第一次 populate() 完成后才调用 community.resume；或者 partnerAnswered 遇到 resident 为 nil 时延后处理。

verdict.reason: The race is real, but it only happens in a rare case. AppStore.swift:122 calls community.resume(appointments) in init. That schedules an answer 3 s later (Community.swift:110-112, answerLater) for every saved appointment that is still .waiting. The map loads separately: loadMap runs in its own Task, and residents and landmarks are only filled in at the end of it (AppStore+Map.swift:42 install, then populate). When TileCache has a copy (MapService.swift:67, kept 30 days), the map is usually ready within 3 s and nothing goes wrong. When there is no cache, fetch() tries 3 endpoints, 2 times each, with a 20 s timeout and 2 s / 4 s pauses between tries. With no network or Overpass down that is at least about 18 s before the built-in sample map is used; on a slow network it is several seconds. The sample map is never cached, so a first launch that fell back leaves every later launch without a cache. Meanwhile partnerAnswered (AppStore+Meetup.swift:177-186) falls back to an empty string when resident or landmark is nil, so both the banner and the voice say "應承咗：今日下晝4點，喺附近見。" with no name and no place. That breaks §4 "所有提示同时有语音和图像": the prompt carries no information. It does not conflict with any decided point (single-device demo plus the reserved CommunityService). The trigger is narrower than the report says. First, a .waiting appointment of your own has to be saved, which means the app was quit or killed by the system within 3-4 s of sending or changing an invite. Second, the next launch must have no cache and a slow or missing network. The report's 「重新生成」 example is not quite right: regenerateHere writes the cache again after a successful fetch, so the next launch is fast. The demo scripts are not affected either: -script, -script2 and -script3 clear LocalStore first, and -offline uses the sample map directly. Because the trigger is rare and nothing crashes, severity is low.
verdict.fix: Delete community.resume(appointments) from init (AppStore.swift:122). Add a stored property to AppStore, var communityResumed = false. At the end of populate() (AppStore+Map.swift, after closeOrphanAppointments/checkAppointments), add: if !communityResumed { communityResumed = true; community.resume(appointments) }. Resuming then waits until residents and landmarks exist. As a bonus, appointments already cancelled by closeOrphanAppointments are not scheduled at all. Optional extra safeguard: in partnerAnswered, use guard let p = resident(a.partnerID) else { return } in place of ?? "". Effort S (about 5 lines).

confirmed.title: 请假当天连续天数会加 1，天天请假就能刷排行榜
confirmed.evidence: streak() 遇到 leaves.contains(k) 就当作那天行过。例如昨日已连续 9 日、今日还没行：请假前显示 9，请假后变成 10，语音却说「連續 10 日會保留」。请假没有次数限制，天天请假、不用行，连续天数也一直上升，而排行榜正是按连续天数排名。
confirmed.rule: F4：请假期间连续天数「保留」，不是增加；排名依据连续散步天数
confirmed.fix: 请假日只用来防止断开：数连续天数时跳过请假日，但不计数。单元测试「请假唔会断」的期望值相应调整。考虑设每月请假上限。

verdict.reason: The reported problem is real. In ios/StreetWalk/Store/LocalStore.swift:51-56, `counts()` returns true for a leave day without checking whether the user walked, and the loop at line 61 adds 1 for every day `counts()` accepts. So each leave day adds a day to the streak. Example: the user walked 9 days in a row up to yesterday and hasn't walked today, so `me.streakDays` shows 9. They tap 請假 (AppStore+Walk.swift:193-200), `refreshMe()` → `myStreak()` (AppStore+Persist.swift:129, 168) recomputes it as 10, and the number animates from 9 to 10. Meanwhile the leave row (UI/Tabs.swift:168) says 「今日已請假，連續日數保留」 and the voice line says 「連續 10 日會保留」. Leave has no limit, and the ranking sorts by streakDays (AppStore.swift:99). So a user who taps leave every day without walking climbs exactly as fast as one who walks every day. Spec F4 says 「请假期间连续天数保留」: leave keeps the streak from breaking, it doesn't add to it. The ranking is also meant to measure 「连续散步天数」. This does not conflict with any of the settled decisions. Two things to soften it. The unit test at CoreTests.swift:137 (「请假唔会断」 expects 5) shows A counted leave days on purpose; the code comment also says 「今日算进连续天数」. And in demo mode, seedDemoHistory (AppStore+Persist.swift:183) already puts a walk on today's record. So the 9→10 jump does not show in the demo or the scripted run. It only happens in non-demo mode, on a day the user hasn't walked yet. The other residents are 示範 data, so nobody's real ranking is affected. That makes this a low-severity spec mismatch with a copy inconsistency, not medium.
verdict.fix:
Effort S. In LocalStore.streak, a leave day should keep the streak from breaking without adding to it.
1. Have counts(d) return one of three results: walked, leave (on leave and no walk), or none.
2. Start day: if today is none, start from yesterday. If today is leave, start from today but don't add anything for it.
3. Loop: walked → n += 1; leave → skip the day; none → stop. Put the 3650 cap on the number of days looked at, not on n, so the loop can't run forever when it skips days.
4. Change the expected value of 「请假唔会断」 at CoreTests.swift:137 from 5 to 4. Add a test: 9 days walked up to yesterday, plus leave today → still 9.
The voice line and the leave row then match the shown number without any other change. A monthly leave cap is not in the spec and is not part of this fix.

confirmed.title: 关掉演示模式后按「碰一碰加街坊」，提示「圈入面嘅人都已經係你街坊」；碰一碰也只认得圈里的人
confirmed.evidence: residents 只剩你时，allSatisfy({ isMe || isNeighbor }) 为真，于是提示「圈入面嘅人都已經係你街坊」，实际上圈里一个别人都没有。更根本的问题是：startBump 把候选人限定为 residents（圈成员），圈里的人都已是街坊时就直接中止；将来换成真机超宽带，也碰不到圈外的人。
confirmed.rule: F5：碰一碰是加街坊的唯一方式，对象不限于同一个圈；文案要如实
confirmed.fix: 提示分两种：「圈入面暫時只有你」和「圈入面都係你街坊」。不再用圈成员决定能否开始碰一碰，真机实现时由对方手机提供身份（与 B 对接 BumpService）。

verdict.reason:
The toast problem is real, but the larger claim about bumping people outside the circle does not hold up.

What is real: ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Neighbors.swift lines 21-24 show 「圈入面嘅人都已經係你街坊」 whenever `residents.allSatisfy({ $0.isMe || $0.isNeighbor })` is true. Turning demo mode off in settings (setDemoMode in UI/Settings.swift lines 129-137, which calls populate) makes LocalCommunityService.circleMembers return []. Store/Community.swift line 85 does this (`guard demoEnabled else { return [] }`), and prototype_status.md line 7 says the same. So `residents` becomes just [me], the check passes on an empty set, and pressing 「碰一碰加街坊」 tells the user everyone in the circle is already a neighbour. In fact the circle has nobody else and the user has no neighbours at all. With demo off, `isSimulated` is false, so the DemoNote explaining the simulation is hidden too (UI/Tabs.swift line 538). The user gets a false statement and nothing explains it. That is a copy accuracy problem in A's code.

What does not hold up:
1. The cited rule says bumping is "not limited to the same circle", but the F5 text in the spec never says that. F2 also says the prototype uses preset groups.
2. "A real UWB build couldn't reach people outside the circle" is speculation about future code. `candidates` and the decision to stop when nobody is left are part of the shared BumpService contract in Domain/Contracts.swift and B's SimulatedBumpService (it picks the first non-neighbour candidate), which matches the agreed simulated bump. Redesigning that is outside this bug.

Severity is low: it only happens when demo mode is off, which is not the default, nothing crashes, and no data is wrong. It is just a misleading message.
verdict.fix: In AppStore+Neighbors.swift startBump, check the empty-circle case before the "all neighbours" case. If `!residents.contains(where: { !$0.isMe })`, set bumpStage back to .idle and show an honest message, for example toast(community.isSimulated ? "圈入面暫時只有你" : "單機版碰唔到其他手機；真機要兩部 iPhone 11 或之後"). Only when other people exist and all of them are neighbours should it show 「圈入面嘅人都已經係你街坊」. Doing the check before calling bump.startSearching would also avoid the pointless call. Effort S, about 5 lines. The BumpService contract and candidate logic should stay as they are; that is a separate interface discussion with B.

confirmed.title: 语音和图像提示不同步：需确认的复述、约人提议、开提醒的提问只有画面；十多处确认只有语音
confirmed.evidence: 只有画面没有语音：handle() 处理 invite、goFind、broadcast、changeMeetup、cancelMeetup 时只设置 voiceCard，不调用 speaker.speak；按钮路径的 proposeMeetup 也不播报 AI 选的时间、地点和理由；RemindPrompt 只播「你同X而家係街坊」，「開唔開出門提醒？」这个问题只显示不播；真实天文台数据经 applyLiveWeather → refreshWeatherTip 只更新今日卡，不播报。只有语音没有文字（只调用 speaker.speak，没有 toast）：完成首次使用的「搞掂…」、开或不开出门提醒、解除街坊的「佢唔會收到通知」、约成功或改约的「幫你約咗…等緊確認」（约到明天时，会话只出现在「街坊」页，当前页什么都看不到）、「冇改到，照舊」、取消约会、接受或拒绝邀请、散步结束总结「返到屋企喇…已經隱身」、听不明白（揀一句卡没有「未聽明白」）。步频下降的 paceTip 只显示在今日页的卡里。
confirmed.rule: §4：所有提示同时有语音和图像；F7：一句话说明理由；F9
confirmed.fix: 设置需确认的 voiceCard 时，播报 card.title 加「啱唔啱？撳『好』確認」。proposeMeetup 播报「时间、地点、理由」。RemindPrompt 出现时播报提问。天气提示每天每档第一次变化时播一次。只有语音的地方改用 toast(_:)（它本身会播报并显示 3.5 秒）。paceTip 改用 showBanner 加语音。PhrasePickerCard 在来源为 unknown 时加一行「我未聽明白」。

verdict.reason:
The core of this report holds up against the code. §4 says "所有提示同时有语音和图像", and the following are picture-only:
(1) AppStore+Voice.swift:51-85. For invite, goFind, broadcast, changeMeetup and cancelMeetup, handle() only sets voiceCard with needsConfirm=true. Neither handle() nor HeardCard (Overlays.swift:493-540) calls speaker.speak. So an elderly user who speaks a request that affects someone else gets a silent restatement card. The three cards that skip confirmation (leave, rename, report) do speak, through toggleLeave, rename and report. That makes the gap affect exactly the cards that matter most.
(2) AppStore+Meetup.swift:7-20. When a meetup is started by button (the Today tab's 約佢, the banner's 約佢, InfoCard), proposeMeetup does not speak. The AI-picked time, place and reason (F7 "一句话说明理由") are only shown on ProposalCard.
(3) The RemindPrompt question 「開唔開出門提醒？」 (Cards.swift:312) is only displayed. startBump (Neighbors.swift:13) only says 「你同X而家係街坊」, so F6's "询问是否开启" has no voice.
(4) paceTip (Walk.swift:77-80) is spoken, but its picture only sits in the Today tab's myCard. On another tab you only hear it.
(5) The live HKO weather path (applyLiveWeather → refreshWeatherTip, Places.swift:112-145) only updates the Today card and is never spoken. Only the demo setWeather path adds a banner and speech.
(6) When an appointment is confirmed for tomorrow, the speech "幫你約咗…等緊確認" (Meetup.swift:99, also :94 and :140) has no picture on the Today tab, because todaysAppointments only includes today's appointments.
None of this conflicts with the settled decisions. Those require a restatement plus 「好」 before actions that affect others; they don't say the restatement must be silent.
Parts of the report are overstated and should be dropped. "解除街坊 only has voice" is wrong: the confirmation dialog already says "佢唔會收到通知" (Tabs.swift:584). Cancelling, accepting or declining an invitation, and finishing a walk, all change visible state (cards disappear or change status), so those count as having a picture. For "unknown" there is the 揀一句 picker, which is enough. So this is an S-sized fix for a real, demo-visible gap in a top-level rule for an elderly, voice-first product. It is not a crash or a privacy problem, so medium.
verdict.fix:
Smallest fix (S, about 6 places):
(a) In AppStore+Voice.swift handle(), after setting each needsConfirm voiceCard, add speaker.speak("\(card.title)。啱就撳「好」。"). For the invite case include the place and prop.reason, e.g. "約X聽日下晝三點喺涼亭，嗰陣有樓遮住、有櫈。啱就撳「好」。".
(b) At the end of proposeMeetup (Meetup.swift:19), speak "\(dayTimeLabel) 喺\(place)，\(reason)。撳「好」就約。". To avoid speaking twice, have the voice invite path in handle() rely on this single speech, or pass a silent flag.
(c) Change Neighbors.swift:13 to "你同X而家係街坊。開唔開出門提醒？", or speak the question in RemindPrompt.onAppear.
(d) Also call showBanner for paceTip (Walk.swift:78) so it can be seen on any tab.
(e) In applyLiveWeather, speak weatherTip once when it first appears or changes tier each day; store the day and tier to honour F9's "不回应不重复".
(f) Change Meetup.swift:94/99/140 from speaker.speak to toast(...), which speaks and shows text, so tomorrow's appointment also gets visible feedback.
Leave the unlink, accept/decline/cancel, finishWalk and unknown cases as they are.

confirmed.title: 字号低于规范：「示範」15pt、AI 标签 16pt、设置页约 17pt，对比度不足；系统字号调小时正文 24pt 会缩到约 20pt
confirmed.evidence: DemoBadge 基准 15 pt，次要色压在 tertiarySystemFill 上，对比约 2.98:1。CardAITag 和 TabAITag 16 pt，橙 #D85A30 压在 accentSoft #FAEBE6 上，对比 3.34:1。这两个标签是诚实性标记，老人最需要看清。OSM 署名固定 11 pt、tertiary 色，对比约 1.73:1。在 3 倍截图上量，设置页的分组标题（「我」「街坊出門話我知」）、页脚说明、Picker 的值、导航标题「設定」和「完成」只有约 17–18 pt，Form 上的 .ds(.body) 没有作用到这些位置。横幅的 minimumScaleFactor(0.8) 会把字缩到 19 pt。RootView 只限制了上限（...accessibility2），系统字号设为最小时正文 24 pt 会缩到约 19.8 pt，与 Design 注释「只放大」不符。prototype_status 写「字号 24pt 起」，而已定的辅助字号是 20 pt。
confirmed.rule: 已定字号：正文 24、辅助 20；§4：最小字号可调；对比度 AA（小字 4.5:1）
confirmed.fix: RootView 改为 .dynamicTypeSize(.large ... .accessibility2)。DemoBadge 和 AI 标签改用 .ds(.captionBold)（20 pt）；AI 标签文字改用 #B84D29 或 #AD4826，DemoBadge 文字用 .primary。设置页的行改用 Text.ds，Section 的 header 和 footer 也加 .ds，Picker 自定义 label。去掉横幅的缩放。署名改用 @ScaledMetric。文档改为「正文 24pt、辅助 20pt」。

verdict.reason:
问题大体属实，但其中一部分说法被推翻。

属实（已对照代码和截图）：
1) 「示範」标签在 Design.swift:160 写死为 @ScaledMetric 15pt。两个 AI 标签也写死为 16pt：CardAITag 在 Cards.swift:367，TabAITag 在 Tabs.swift:784。它们出现在 Tabs.swift:72/120/123/268/403/601 和 Cards.swift:37/234，紧挨着 24pt 正文。这不仅低于规格 §4「最小字號 24pt」，也低于已定的辅助字号 20pt，所以不受已定决定保护。这两个标签负责标明哪些是示範数据、哪些是 AI 写的，老人看不清，就削弱了诚实提示。另外按我的计算，颜色对比约为：AI 标签 3.3:1，示範标签 3.2:1。
2) RootView.swift:27 只写了 `.dynamicTypeSize(...accessibility2)`，没有下限。系统字号调小时，ScaledMetric 会把 24pt 缩到约 20pt，与 Design.swift:4 注释的「只放大」和 §4「最小 24pt」都不符。
3) Overlays.swift:282 的横幅用了 `.minimumScaleFactor(0.8)`，正文最多会缩到 19.2pt。
4) 设置页里 Picker 的当前值（「拐杖」「朝早 7 點」）实测字身只有约 15.3pt，对应字号约 17pt。导航标题「設定」和「完成」也约 17pt，是系统控件，不受 Form 上 `.ds(.body)` 影响。
5) MainView.swift:206 的地图署名写死 11pt，而且是 tertiary 色。
6) prototype_status.md:24 写的是「字號 24pt 起」，但代码实际有 20pt 的辅助字和 15/16/11pt 的字，文档与代码不符。

被推翻的部分：
- 报告说设置页的分组标题「我」「街坊出門話我知」和页脚说明只有 17–18pt，这不对。我在 full_settings.png 上量了字形高度：标题和页脚约 17pt，正文行约 21pt，比值 0.81，接近 20/24。所以 Settings.swift:29/44/46 等处的 `.ds(.caption)` 是生效的，实际就是 20pt。报告者是把字形高度当成了字号。
- AA 4.5:1 对比度不是规格原文的要求。§4 只要求「色弱安全检查」，所以对比度只作为附带的无障碍缺陷，不单列为违规。
- MainView 的演示字幕（19pt 和 13pt）只在 -captions 录屏时出现。其余写死字号的地方是图标，都不算问题。
verdict.fix:
最小修法（总共约 S，半小时以内）：

1) RootView.swift:27 改成 `.dynamicTypeSize(.large ... .accessibility2)`，让字号只放大不缩小。

2) Design.swift:160-162 的 DemoBadge：删掉 @ScaledMetric 15，改用 `.ds(.captionBold)`，文字颜色改为 `.primary`。Tabs.swift:784-786 和 Cards.swift:367-369 的两个 AI 标签：删掉 @ScaledMetric 16，改用 `.ds(.captionBold)`。改成 20pt 半粗体后，橙字在浅橙底上约 3.3:1。这是否算大字、能否达到大字 3:1 的要求，要看半粗体算不算粗体，属于边界情况，所以不必改橙色。顺便检查 HStack 能不能放下。

3) Overlays.swift:282 删掉 `.minimumScaleFactor(0.8)`。必要时把 lineLimit 放宽到 nil 或 4。

4) Settings.swift:21-25 和 36-41 的 Picker：改用 `.pickerStyle(.navigationLink)`，或者换成 `Menu`，label 自己写成 `Text(...).ds(.body)`。导航标题和「完成」可以选做：用 `ToolbarItem(.principal) { Text("設定").ds(.bodyBold) }`，「完成」的 label 用 `Text("完成").ds(.bodyBold)`。

5) MainView.swift:206 的 OSM 署名属于协议要求的小字，优先级最低。可以改成 `.ds(.caption)`，或者至少用 @ScaledMetric，并把颜色改为 `.secondary`。

6) docs/prototype_status.md:24 改为「正文 24pt、辅助 20pt 起」。

设置页的分组标题和页脚不用改。

confirmed.title: 放大字号后关键文字被截断：横幅、左上「行緊」、形象选项、找人底栏按钮
confirmed.evidence: 把系统字号调到无障碍档（App 最多放大到无障碍第 2 档，正文 24 pt 约变 46.6 pt，callout 20 pt 变 40 pt）：天气横幅被 lineLimit(3) 加 minimumScaleFactor(0.8) 截成「…嗰陣先出門…」，每行约 8 字、最多约 24 字，而反映回覆约 32 字、天气约 27 字。演示模式默认开着，左上胶囊只剩「行緊 3…」，看不到分钟数，加上右侧「演示」胶囊超出 370 pt。首次使用的形象格「推BB車」变成「推…」。找人底栏「我喺皇樂樓樓下」限一行、最小缩放 0.7，在「結束」旁只有约 209 pt，从无障碍第 1 档起就截断。选楼页的来源说明也限一行。
confirmed.rule: §4：字号可调，放大后不能丢信息；RootView 声称支持到无障碍第 2 档
confirmed.fix: 横幅取消 lineLimit（或放宽到 6 行并可滚动），去掉缩放。HomeChip 在大字号下只显示「N 分鐘」或允许两行。形象网格在大字号下改成单列。找人底栏按钮去掉 lineLimit，用 ViewThatFits 提供横排和竖排两种布局。来源说明允许换行。

verdict.reason:
This one holds up, both in the code and in the screenshots. The app scales text with the system size setting: Design.swift:51-57 builds its fonts with ScaledMetric(relativeTo: .body/.callout). RootView.swift:24-26 caps that at accessibility size 2 (AX2), and its comment says the cap exists because anything bigger would not fit. That implies everything up to AX2 should fit. At AX2, body text is 24*33/17 ≈ 46.6pt and caption text is 20*2 ≈ 40pt.

(1) Banner, Overlays.swift:278-283. The text is limited to 3 lines (lineLimit(3)) and may only shrink to 80% (minimumScaleFactor(0.8)). The text area is about 300pt wide, so that is about 8 characters per line and about 24 in total. The weather tip from TemplateAI.swift:145 is about 27 characters, and the reply to a resident report built at AppStore+Places.swift:75 is about 33. sx_84.png shows it cut off at 「嗰陣先出門…」.

(2) HomeChip, MainView.swift:320-332. It is limited to one line and shares the top row with the "演示" (demo) menu chip, which shows whenever demo mode is on (MainView.swift:227-231). AppStore.swift:89 turns demo mode on by default. Adding up the widths, the row needs about 440pt but the screen is only 402pt. crop_sx33.png shows 「行緊 3…」 with the minutes missing.

(3) Avatar tiles, Onboarding.swift:556-561. The two-column grid with lineLimit(1) and minimumScaleFactor(0.7) cuts 「推BB車」 down to 「推…」 (sox_19.png).

(4) Find bottom bar, FullScreen.swift:339-345. The 「我喺{place}」 button sits next to 「結束」 and is limited to one line, so the place name gets cut off.

(5) Map source caption, Onboarding.swift:322-336. Also limited to one line with shrinking allowed.

Mitigations, which lower the severity but do not cancel the finding: banner text is also spoken aloud (speaker.speak), and the weather tip and report replies also appear on the Today tab (Tabs.swift:25). None of the settled decisions cover this. The settled decision only fixes the base sizes at 24/20/34pt, and §4 requires「最小字號 24pt，可調」(minimum 24pt, adjustable). The target users are elderly, which is exactly who turns on large text. This is not a style preference.
verdict.fix:
Effort is S: five small edits, all in A's own files.

(1) Overlays.swift:281-282: remove lineLimit(3) and minimumScaleFactor(0.8). The island already uses fixedSize(vertical: true), so it will grow taller. If it then gets too tall, put the text in a ScrollView with a maximum height of about 40% of the screen.

(2) MainView.swift HomeChip: wrap the label in ViewThatFits(in: .horizontal). Try 「行緊 N 分鐘」 first and fall back to 「N 分鐘」. Alternatively, at accessibility sizes (dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize) show only the sparkles icon in DemoMenu and drop its text.

(3) Onboarding.swift tiles: when dynamicTypeSize.isAccessibilitySize, give the LazyVGrid one column instead of two, and remove lineLimit(1) and minimumScaleFactor on the label.

(4) FullScreen.swift:335-346: use ViewThatFits to try the existing HStack first and fall back to a VStack with the 「我喺…」 button full width on top and 「結束」 below it. Remove lineLimit(1) and minimumScaleFactor(0.7).

(5) Onboarding.swift:333-334 sourceCaption: change lineLimit(1) to lineLimit(2...3), or drop the limit, and remove minimumScaleFactor.

Then check each screen at accessibility size 2 (AX2) using -dynamicTypeSize or Xcode's Environment Overrides.

confirmed.title: 人物配色在色弱下有几对分不清，其中一对和「我」的颜色相同；深色模式下灰色小人看不清
confirmed.evidence: 用 Machado 2009 矩阵（严重度 1.0）模拟色弱，再算 CIEDE2000 色差（脚本在 scratchpad/audit/cvd.py）。紫 #7F77DD 对蓝 #378ADD：绿色盲 ΔE 0.3、红色盲 3.3（黃太对李伯）。绿 #1D9E75 对粉 #D4537E：绿色盲 1.0（陳太对梁太）。琥珀 #BA7517 对橙 #D85A30（「我」和 DS.accent）：绿色盲 1.8、红色盲 6.9（何生对我，两人都是「行路」造型）。场景里的小人只靠颜色区分，标签重叠时 placed() 会丢掉低优先级的标签。深色模式下灰 #5F5E5A（張伯）对深色路面的对比只有 2.05:1，对绿地 1.80:1，低于非文字元素 3:1 的要求。
confirmed.rule: §4：配色要通过色弱安全检查；不能只靠颜色区分信息
confirmed.fix: 以 Okabe-Ito 为基础换一套色弱安全的 7 色，按两两最小色差 ≥15 检验。「我」不要只靠橙色：小人头顶加白圈或光环，标签「你」优先级最高、永不被挤掉。深色模式下灰色提亮到 #9A9994 左右。把 cvd.py 放进 ios/tools，改配色时跑一次。

verdict.reason:
属实，但要打折扣。

1) 规格写明要做色弱检查。§4 原文是"配色要通过色弱安全检查"（docs/产品定稿_康乐社交App_v1.0.md:121）。仓库里没有任何色弱处理：搜不到"色弱"、CVD、differentiateWithoutColor。我用自己的脚本复算了 Machado 矩阵和 CIEDE2000，数字和报告一致：紫对蓝（黃太对李伯）绿色盲下 ΔE 0.3、红色盲下 3.3；绿对粉（陳太对梁太）绿色盲下 1.0；琥珀对橙（何生对「我」）绿色盲下 1.8、红色盲下 7.0。正常色觉下紫对蓝也只有 16.2，琥珀对橙只有 17.5。这套配色确实过不了色弱检查。这和"已定的决定"不冲突：已定的只有纸雕风格、排版和字号，没有锁定人物配色；"画风优先于真实"讲的是写实程度，不涉及无障碍。

2) "只靠颜色区分"这一点说过头了。所有列表和卡片里，AvatarBadge 都和名字或楼层文字一起出现（Tabs.swift、Cards.swift、FullScreen.swift）。场景里每个小人也都带名字标签，标签上有色点（AppStore+Map.swift:148-167）。前两对还靠造型区分：黃太走路、李伯坐轮椅；陳太走路、梁太推婴儿车（Community.swift:79-80）。真正会撞的只有何生对「我」：两人都是 .walk，色弱下几乎同色。而且 placed() 的排序有个具体缺陷：「你」的标签 priority 是 2（DioramaController.swift:710），和街坊一样。同级时按 a.id < b.id 排（Overlays.swift:52），"p:me" 排在 p:chan、p:cheung、p:ho、p:lee、p:leung 之后。所以散步经过何生所在的地标、标签重叠时，丢掉的是「你」。镜头会跟着「我」（followID="me"），算是部分缓解。另外，设置和引导里用户可以挑任意一个色板颜色作自己的颜色（Settings.swift:119-122、Onboarding.swift:590），甚至能和示範街坊完全同色。这进一步说明"我"不能只靠颜色认。

3) 深色模式的数字是对的：Palette.people 没有深色版本，灰 #5F5E5A 对深色路面只有 1.69:1，对深色铺地 2.05:1。但小人的头是浅肤色 #F5C4B3，在深色下很显眼，身上还有名字标签，所以"看不清小人"言过其实，只算次要问题。
verdict.fix:
最小修法，工作量 S。

(a) 改 ios/StreetWalk/Domain/Models.swift:32-40 里撞色的三个颜色，主要拉开明度，「我」的橙 #D85A30 和绿 #1D9E75 保持不变：
- 紫改 #4B3F9E（加深）
- 蓝改 #6CB8EE（提亮）
- 粉改 #E890B5（提亮）
- 琥珀改 #E3B21C（偏黄、提亮）

我复算过：绿色盲和红色盲下两两最小 ΔE 约 11.7，蓝色盲下约 8.8，原来是 0.3 和 1.0。改后要在浅色铺地上目测一次，因为提亮的颜色对浅底的对比会下降，必要时给小人身体加一圈细描边。

(b) 改 ios/StreetWalk/UI/Overlays.swift:50 的 rank()，让「你」的标签永远排第一，例如 x.id == "p:me" ? 6 : …。这样「你」不会被街坊标签挤掉。

(c) 可选：灰色做成深浅两套的动态色（深色约 #9A9994）。注意 MeshBuilder.material 只在创建时用 .current 解析一次颜色，切换深浅模式后 setPeople 不会重建小人，所以要连带处理。

报告里建议的整套 Okabe-Ito 换色和把 cvd.py 放进 ios/tools，可以做，但不是必须。

confirmed.title: 卡片和横幅出现时读屏焦点不跟过去；横幅 8 秒、复述卡的「撤回」4 秒后自动消失
confirmed.evidence: 整个 UI 没有用 AccessibilityFocusState，也没有 UIAccessibility.post(.screenChanged/.layoutChanged)。例如在 InfoCard 按「約佢行」，会先 select(nil) 把 InfoCard 移除，再弹出 ProposalCard，读屏焦点随之丢失。横幅（含「過去搵佢」「出發」「再約」等操作按钮）8 秒后由 bannerTask 自动关掉，HeardCard 的「撤回」4 秒后消失。读屏用户和动作慢的长者来不及找到按钮，时限也不能调整。
confirmed.rule: 无障碍：模态出现时把焦点移进去；有时限的内容要能延长或关闭（WCAG 2.2.1）
confirmed.fix: BottomCardSlot 和 BannerView 出现时，用 @AccessibilityFocusState 把焦点放到卡片标题，或 post(.screenChanged)。UIAccessibility.isVoiceOverRunning 为真时，横幅和 HeardCard 不自动消失（或延长到 30 秒以上），并保留「關閉」操作。

verdict.reason:
我核对了代码，报告里的事实都成立，但实际影响比报告说的小，所以严重程度从 medium 降为 low。

一、已确认的事实
1. 整个 ios/StreetWalk 里都没有 AccessibilityFocusState、accessibilityFocused，也没有 UIAccessibility.post。用 grep 查 UIAccessibility，只找到 isReduceMotionEnabled 这一处。
2. Cards.swift:241-252：按「約佢行」或「過去搵佢」时，先执行 store.select(nil)，再执行 proposeMeetup 或 goFind。uiActiveCard（MainView.swift:16-24）会从 .info 直接换成 .proposal 或 .findAsk。BottomCardSlot 用 container(visible).id(visible) 换掉整张卡，原来获得焦点的按钮被移除了。另外 coversScene 只对 .voice 和 .remind 为真（MainView.swift:11），所以约人卡、找人卡、信息卡都没有 .isModal，读屏焦点不会落到新卡上。
3. AppStore.swift:142-144：showBanner 固定 8 秒后清掉横幅。横幅上有「過去搵佢」「約佢」「再約」「睇吓」「出發」这些操作按钮，读屏开着时也不会延长或暂停。
4. Overlays.swift:533-537：HeardCard 不需要确认的那几种（請假、改名、記低反映）固定 4 秒后消失。读屏用户要先听完「我聽到…」、标题和说明，才能找到「撤回」，4 秒来不及；动作慢的长者也来不及。

二、降级的理由
1. 横幅文字已经用 speaker.speak 读出来了。横幅上的操作在别处也能做，没有时限：Tabs.swift:99 有過去搵佢和約佢，Tabs.swift:215 有出發，Tabs.swift:701 有約佢。
2. 横幅有名为「關閉」的读屏操作，卡片有 escape 操作。.voice 和 .remind 这两种卡有 .isModal。
3. 规格 §4 没有明文要求支持 VoiceOver。docs/prototype_status.md:24 已写明"读屏顺序未逐屏人工检查"。

三、仍然算真问题的理由
1. 目标用户是长者，规格 §4 本身就以无障碍为核心。
2. 「記低反映」只能用这个 4 秒的「撤回」取消，undoLastReport 在 UI 里没有别的调用点。错过这 4 秒就撤不回了。
3. 约人卡和找人卡出现时焦点不跟过去，读屏用户要盲扫才能找到新卡。

这些都不和「已定的决定」冲突。

另外发现一个不在本条范围内的问题：rejectVoice（AppStore+Voice.swift:109-118）没有处理 .rename，所以改名后按「撤回」只会关掉卡片，名字并没有改回去。
verdict.fix:
最小修法，工作量 S，大约 30 行。

1. HeardCard（Overlays.swift:533-537）：读取 @Environment(\.accessibilityVoiceOverEnabled)。读屏开着时不自动消失；读屏关着时，把 4 秒延长到 10 秒左右。

2. showBanner（AppStore.swift:142-144）：读屏开着（UIAccessibility.isVoiceOverRunning）时，不启动 8 秒的 bannerTask，只靠「關閉」操作、点按或上滑来关；或者把时限放宽到 30 秒以上。

3. BottomCardSlot（MainView.swift:545-556 和 581-584）：
   - 加上 @AccessibilityFocusState private var focus: MainBottomCard?。
   - 在 container 上加 .accessibilityFocused($focus, equals: card)。
   - 在 .onChange(of: card) 里，拿到新卡后稍等约 0.35 秒再设 focus = new。这样从信息卡换到约人卡、找人卡、提醒卡时，读屏焦点都会进到新卡里。

4. 可选：横幅出现时，如果读屏开着，用 AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(b.text).post() 代替 speaker.speak，免得读屏和 App 自己的朗读同时出声。

confirmed.title: 地标信息卡和「改名」按钮只能靠点约 19×10 pt 的 3D 地标打开，读屏到不了，也和「场景只看不操作」矛盾
confirmed.evidence: placed() 会过滤掉非焦点地标，所以平时场景里不显示任何地标名牌。要打开 InfoCard（有冇櫈、遮荫几成、「改名」按钮），唯一的途径是点中地标模型。按底座总览约 0.79 pt/m 计算，光晕直径约 19 pt，在 33° 俯角下竖向只有约 10 pt，远小于 44 pt。主界面的 DioramaView 没有任何无障碍元素，读屏用户完全打不开这张卡，改名就只剩语音一条路。DioramaView 的注释写着「单击只用于首次使用时选楼」，与实际不符，也和已定的「场景只看不操作」矛盾。
confirmed.rule: 已定决定：每个语音操作都有按钮入口，场景只看不操作；HIG 最小 44 pt；读屏可达
confirmed.fix: 在今日页加「附近地標」卡：每个地标一行（名字、有冇櫈、遮荫），用大按钮调用 select(.landmark)，作为查看、改名的按钮入口和读屏入口，主场景不再依赖点按。同时改正 DioramaView 的注释。

verdict.reason:
The report holds up. I checked every place that sets `select(.landmark)`. The landmark card (InfoCard in Cards.swift:131-198, which shows seats, shade % and the 改名 button) can only be opened in two ways:
(1) Tapping the 3D scene: MainView.swift:196 calls handleSceneTap, then MainView.swift:220, then DioramaController.hit(at:) at :481-496.
(2) Tapping a SceneLabel button (Overlays.swift:84). placed() at Overlays.swift:47 drops every landmark that is not already in focus. Focus means already selected, the proposal's place, or the find destination. During a proposal or a find, uiSceneTapsEnabled (MainView.swift:27-31) is false, so this path never opens a new landmark card. In practice it only re-selects a landmark that is already selected.
DemoScript.swift:62 calls it too, but only in demo mode.

People are handled differently: NeighborsTab has its own button path (Tabs.swift:464, `store.select(.person)`). Landmarks have no such entry outside the scene.

VoiceOver: the SCNView in DioramaView.swift exposes no accessibility elements. Unfocused landmarks have no label, so a VoiceOver user cannot focus a landmark, and the UITapGestureRecognizer never fires. That leaves them with voice as the only way to rename. The phrase picker (AppStore+Voice.swift:41) is not a real fallback: it shows one sample phrase that renames only the first landmark, always to 大樹底.

Spec §4 requires "每个语音操作都要有一个大按钮作后备", and rename is a voice command (§6). docs/prototype_status.md:24 says this requirement is met. The 改名 button itself is large, but getting to it requires a small 3D target that VoiceOver cannot reach.

The size is under 44 pt, but the report's numbers are a bit low. The halo has a radius of 12 m (Figures.swift:84). The overview distance for a 200 m base is 0.88, which gives orthographicScale ≈ 0.155, so the scene shows about 310 m of height in roughly 358 pt (42%). That is about 1.15 pt/m. The halo is then about 28 pt wide and 15 pt tall on the ground; adding the pavilion height gives about 20-22 pt. That is still well under the HIG minimum of 44 pt. The users are elderly, so small targets matter more.

The comment at DioramaView.swift:4 and :28 says a single tap is only used to pick your building during first use. That does not match the code: MainView.swift:217-225 uses the tap to select landmarks and people.

This does not conflict with any decided rule. The report does not ask to overturn 「场景只看不操作」; its fix reduces reliance on scene taps. It also does not touch the art style or layout.
verdict.fix:
Smallest fix (S), with no visual change: in SceneLabelsLayer (Overlays.swift), add a transparent target for each landmark that placed() did not show. Use the landmark item's `item.point` to place a 44×44 `Button { if store.uiSceneTapsEnabled { store.select(.landmark(id)) } }` built from `Color.clear.contentShape(Rectangle())`. Give it `.accessibilityLabel(item.text)`, `.accessibilityHint("撳一下睇詳情")` and the `.isButton` trait. Order them after the visible labels so they never cover a person label. This gives both a large tap target and a VoiceOver entry.

Also correct the comments at DioramaView.swift:4 and :28 to say the single tap is used during first use to pick your building, and in the main screen to select landmarks and people.

To avoid relying on scene taps at all, as 「只看不操作」 suggests, the alternative is the reporter's fix. Add one row per landmark (name, seats, shade) on the 今日 page, each calling `select(.landmark)`. That is M effort.

confirmed.title: 「减少动态效果」没有覆盖 3D 镜头飞行、楼宇升起、光晕脉冲和多处滑入、缩放转场
confirmed.evidence: setCamera(animated:) 的平移和缩放飞行在每次选地标、开始散步、碰一碰、找人时都会触发，没有判断「减少动态效果」。楼宇用带回弹的 rise() 升起，地标光晕做 repeatForever 缩放脉冲；只有小人上下晃动（第 597 行）做了判断。SwiftUI 这边 DS.motion 只是把时长缩短，.tabsInsert（move(edge: .top)）、.move(edge: .bottom)、.scale(0.6) 等转场仍然有位移和缩放。DS.reduceMotion 直接读 UIAccessibility，不是 @Environment，用户中途切换设置后界面不会刷新。
confirmed.rule: iOS 减少动态效果：把位移和缩放换成淡入淡出，不做镜头推拉
confirmed.fix: setCamera 在 isReduceMotionEnabled 时直接跳到目标（或淡出再淡入）。rise 和光晕脉冲在开启「减少动态效果」时跳过，光晕改成静态加亮。加一个 DS.transition(_:) 帮助函数，开启时返回 .opacity，全局替换 .tabsInsert、move、scale。DS.reduceMotion 改用 @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion)。

verdict.reason:
The main claim is confirmed in the code. The app does try to support 減少動態效果: Design.swift:20-22 says "减少动态效果时改成淡入淡出", and RootView:18/21, MainView:261/272/366/544, Overlays:206/220/320/427, Onboarding:40/166/188/535, FullScreen:57/105, Demo:286, Tabs:805 and the figure bob at DioramaController:597 all check it. But the biggest motion in the app does not:
(1) DioramaController.swift:367-384 setCamera(animated:) only looks at the `animated` argument and never at UIAccessibility.isReduceMotionEnabled. It runs a 0.75-1.0 s pan-and-zoom flight from AppStore+Places:17 (selecting a landmark), +Walk:34/107, +Find:48/67/142, +Neighbors:15/44, +Map:80/106 and DemoScript:112. Apple names camera pan and zoom as typical triggers that Reduce Motion should remove.
(2) Lines 223-242: every launch (AppStore.swift:131 calls loadMap(animated:true)) and every move of home makes all buildings spring up with an overshoot, staggered over about 1-2 s.
(3) Lines 530-535: the selected landmark's halo pulses between scale 1.0 and 1.5 with repeatForever, and nothing checks the setting.
The UI is meant for older people, the scene takes about 42% of the screen and the user cannot control it, so this is a real accessibility gap. It is not one of the settled decisions: "場景只看不操作" means the camera moves on its own, and those automatic moves are exactly what Reduce Motion should calm. The SwiftUI part is real but secondary. `.tabsInsert` (Tabs.swift:749) and `.move(edge: .bottom/.top)` (Cards:187, Onboarding:287/293, FullScreen:155/162/203/208/259) are slide transitions with no Reduce Motion branch, unlike MainView:261, which has one. The small 0.9-0.96 scale-plus-opacity pops (Tabs:221, MainView:335, FullScreen:173) are acceptable under Apple's guidance and are not defects. One part of the report is overstated: reading DS.reduceMotion statically "won't refresh". Transitions and animations read the value each time the body re-evaluates when a view is inserted or state changes, so a change to the setting takes effect on the next interaction. Only TimelineView(paused:) at FullScreen:105 would stay stale until something re-renders, which is minor. §4 of the spec does not mention Reduce Motion explicitly, so this falls under the general accessibility-defect category rather than a spec clause. Severity is medium: there is no crash or privacy impact, but users who are sensitive to motion see full-screen camera zooms on every landmark, walk and find action.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix (effort S, about 15 lines):
(a) DioramaController.swift:370: change the guard to `guard animated && !UIAccessibility.isReduceMotionEnabled else { ...jump... }`. Optionally keep a 0.25 s SCNTransaction opacity dip on the scene instead of the flight.
(b) Line 223: `guard animated && !UIAccessibility.isReduceMotionEnabled else { return }` so the buildings appear at full height straight away.
(c) In highlightLandmark (line 531): when Reduce Motion is on, do not run the repeatForever pulse. Set `halo.scale = SCNVector3(1.3,1,1.3)`, or raise its opacity, as a static highlight.
(d) Tabs.swift:749: make tabsInsert return `DS.reduceMotion ? .opacity : .move(edge: .top).combined(with: .opacity)`. Add the same ternary to the `.move(edge:)` transitions in Cards:187, Onboarding:287/293 and FullScreen:155/162/203/208/259, or add one helper, `DS.slide(_ edge:)`, that returns .opacity when Reduce Motion is on.
Leave the small scale-plus-opacity pops as they are. Switching to @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) is optional; it is only needed if TimelineView(paused:) at FullScreen:105 must react live.

confirmed.title: 第一次按咪不等授权就开始录音，失败后也不说明原因
confirmed.evidence: micTapped 调用 listener.requestAuth()（异步弹出授权框）后，马上调用 listener.start()。语音识别授权还没决定时，recognitionTask 拿不到结果，用户第一次说的话被丢掉，按「講完」后转写为空，App 默默弹出「揀一句」。listener.available 从来没被读过。用户拒绝过权限时同样只弹出揀一句卡，不提示「未開麥克風／語音識別權限」，用户会以为 App 听不懂。
confirmed.rule: §4：每个语音操作要可靠，有清楚的后备；所有提示都要有语音和图像
confirmed.fix: micTapped 先查 SFSpeechRecognizer.authorizationStatus 和录音权限：还没决定，就等授权回调后再 start；拒绝过，就用 toast 说明「未開權限，可以揀一句，或者去設定開」，同时显示揀一句卡。Listener 归 B，可以在 A 侧包一层 async 授权函数。

verdict.reason:
属实，而且不和任何已定决定冲突。决定只要求"每个语音操作都有按钮入口"，揀一句卡确实有；这条问题讲的是语音这条路在第一次用和权限被拒时会出错，而且不说原因。

1. 第一次用会丢掉第一句。ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Voice.swift:9-18：第一次按咪时，askedSpeechAuth 为 false，代码调用 listener.requestAuth()。ios/StreetWalk/Voice/Speech.swift:36-43 里的 SFSpeechRecognizer.requestAuthorization 和 AVAudioApplication.requestRecordPermission 都是异步的，而且回调被丢弃（`{ _ in }`）。紧接着第 17 行就调用 listener.start()。这时语音识别授权还是 notDetermined，Speech.swift:65 的 recognitionTask 会在回调里报错退出。回调写的是 `guard let result else { return }`，错误被直接吞掉，transcript 一直是空的。画面上 ListeningCard 照常显示「聽緊…」，跳动的声波条也照跳（Overlays.swift:378-394）。用户授权后对着咪讲完，按「講完」，stopListening（AppStore+Voice.swift:26-29）因为 text 为空，直接弹出揀一句卡。

2. 权限被拒时也一样。代码没有任何地方读 authorizationStatus 或 recordPermission。我用 grep 查过，listener.available 只在 Speech.swift 里写，从来没人读。所以拒绝过权限的用户每次按咪都会看到假的「聽緊…」，讲完只弹出揀一句卡。卡上的说明只有「撳一句，等於講咗嗰句」（Overlays.swift:470），没有语音，也不讲原因。

违反的规则：§4「所有提示同時有語音和圖像」。这里失败了却没有任何语音或文字说明原因，用户会以为 App 听不懂粤语。代码归属：micTapped 和整个语音界面流程都在 A 的 Store/UI；Listener 归 B，但修法可以全部放在 A 这边。

严重程度定为 medium，理由有两点：一是后备入口还在，不会卡死；二是真机演示的第一次按咪必然丢话，而真机测试正是现在剩下的待办。
verdict.fix:
只改 A 侧的 AppStore+Voice.swift，工作量小（S）。
1. 在 AppStore 里加 `func ensureVoiceAuth() async -> Bool`：
   - SFSpeechRecognizer.authorizationStatus() 为 .notDetermined 时，用 withCheckedContinuation 包住 SFSpeechRecognizer.requestAuthorization，等结果回来。
   - AVAudioApplication.shared.recordPermission 为 .undetermined 时，用 `await AVAudioApplication.requestRecordPermission()` 等结果。
   - 两项都是 authorized/granted 才返回 true。
2. micTapped 改成 `Task { @MainActor in guard await ensureVoiceAuth() else { toast("未開咪或者語音識別權限，可以揀一句，或者去設定開。"); phrasePicker = true; return }; try listener.start() ... }`。toast 本身会调用 speaker.speak，所以同时有语音和文字，满足 §4。
3. 加了第 1 步之后，askedSpeechAuth 和 listener.requestAuth() 这段可以删掉。
4. 可选：在 stopListening 里，如果 text 为空，也先 toast「聽唔清楚，揀一句啦」，再弹出揀一句卡。
Listener（B 的代码）不用改。

confirmed.title: 排行榜首屏几乎看不到一个完整的名次；大字号下「我那行」也不会固定在底部
confirmed.evidence: 默认字号下，两行示範说明加圈对圈卡把名次挤到首屏最底，第 1 名那一行被固定的「我那行」盖住一半，首屏看不到一个完整的名次。大字号下，名次所在的 Section 在屏幕外，LazyVStack 的 pinned footer 不显示，「我那行」也看不到。
confirmed.rule: 排版草图：排行榜首屏能看到 1–3 名，你那行固定在底部
confirmed.fix: 示範说明并进圈对圈卡（或只保留卡里的 DemoBadge），并压缩圈对圈卡的高度。「我那行」改用 ScrollView 的 safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom) 固定，不依赖 Section footer。

verdict.reason: This one holds up. I checked the code and the screenshots, and both parts of the report are real. In ios/StreetWalk/UI/Tabs.swift:368-386, BoardTab is a LazyVStack(pinnedViews: [.sectionFooters]). Above the ranking Section it puts the two-line 「單機演示」 DemoNote (line 370) and circleCard, and myRow is that Section's footer (line 384). A LazyVStack only pins a footer while some of its Section is on screen. (1) At default text size (s1b_8.png, s3_45.png), the notice plus the circle card push the ranks to the very bottom of the first screen. The pinned 「12 樓 · 你」 row then covers the lower half of rank 1, so no full rank is visible. (2) At large text size (sx_9.png), the Section is entirely below the screen, so the pinned footer doesn't show and 「我那行」 can't be seen at all. The layout sketch (docs/design/layout_sketch.html:55-61, the version the user chose) shows ranks 1–3 above the user's row and says in its caption 「你那行固定在底」. BoardTab's own doc comment also promises 「我那行固定在底部」. This is a visible defect on F4, a core demo screen. It doesn't conflict with the decided layout (42% scene, 24pt body). One limit: under those decided sizes, three full rows (about 72pt each) plus the fixed row probably won't all fit on the first screen. The part of the sketch that can't be met is "ranks 1–3 visible". What must be met is "your row fixed at the bottom, no rank cut off on the first screen".
verdict.fix: Two parts. (a) Fix the bottom row: delete the Section/footer and pinnedViews in BoardTab. Give scrollPage in MainView.swift:285-298 an optional bottom-accessory parameter. Inside the existing .safeAreaInset(edge: .bottom), use VStack(spacing: 0) { accessory; Color.clear.frame(height: tabH) }, and pass myRow in for the .board tab. That row then stays at the bottom whatever the text size, and the list can still scroll up past it. (b) Shrink the space above the ranks: remove the separate DemoNote and fold its 「連續日數係模擬嘅」 wording into the existing DemoBadge row in circleCard (or move the note below the ranking list). Also put the 「本月…領先…」 line and the DemoBadge on one line to make the card shorter. Then rank 1 fits completely on the first screen at default text size. Effort: S (about 30 lines across Tabs.swift and MainView.swift).

confirmed.title: 不支持普通话：识别、播报、界面和语言设置都没有，文档只说「普通话界面还没做」
confirmed.evidence: 识别写死 SFSpeechRecognizer(locale: zh-HK)，播报写死 AVSpeechSynthesisVoice(language: zh-HK)。界面文字全是写死的粤语字面量，工程没有 Localizable 或 String Catalog，developmentRegion 只有 zh-HK。首次使用和设置里都没有语言选项。Resident 没有 §7 users 表要求的「语言」字段（backend_supabase.md:34 倒有 lang 列）。prototype_status 只写「普通话界面还没做」，实际上普通话的识别和播报也都没做。
confirmed.rule: §4：支持粤语和普通话；§5：语音识别 zh-HK、zh-CN；§7：users 表的语言字段
confirmed.fix: 首次使用和设置里加语言选项，存到 UserDefaults 和 Resident.language。Speaker 和 Listener 按语言切换 zh-HK 和 zh-CN（Speech 归 B，要和 B 对接口）。界面文字迁到 String Catalog，加 zh-Hans。来不及做完，就先把 prototype_status 改成如实描述：识别、播报、界面都只有粤语。

verdict.reason:
The report is accurate, and none of the settled decisions cover language, so it does not conflict with them.

What the spec requires:
- §4 says the app must support both Cantonese and Mandarin.
- §5 sets speech recognition as iOS Speech with zh-HK and zh-CN.
- §7 gives the users table a language field.

What the code does:
- Speech is Cantonese only. ios/StreetWalk/Voice/Speech.swift:10 fixes the voice to AVSpeechSynthesisVoice(language: "zh-HK"), and line 31 fixes the recogniser to SFSpeechRecognizer(locale: zh-HK).
- The project is set up for one language. project.pbxproj:141-145 lists only zh-HK as developmentRegion and in knownRegions, and there is no Localizable file or String Catalog.
- All screen text is typed directly into the code, for example every label in UI/Settings.swift.
- Settings has no language option.
- Resident in Domain/Models.swift:4-23 has no language field. backend_supabase.md:34 does have `lang text default 'zh-HK'`.

How honest the docs are:
- Most docs already say clearly that only Cantonese works: README.md:13 and :45, and prototype_status.md:20 ("粤语语音识别（iOS Speech zh-HK）").
- Only prototype_status.md:24 understates the gap. It says only that the Mandarin interface is not done ("普通话界面还没做"). It does not say Mandarin recognition and speech playback are also missing.
- So the docs are not seriously dishonest. The spec gap is still real.

Why the severity is low, not medium:
- This is a single-phone hackathon demo, and the team has partly acknowledged the gap already.
- Full Mandarin support would also need the template AI to understand Mandarin phrasing. That belongs to member B.
- Adding a language picker that does nothing would be worse than having no picker.
verdict.fix:
Smallest fix (S, a few minutes): in docs/prototype_status.md:24, replace "普通话界面还没做" with "目前只有粤语：语音识别（zh-HK）、播报和界面文字都还没有普通话版本；普通话要等语言设置、zh-CN 识别和播报（组员 B）、界面迁到 String Catalog 后才有". Optionally add a line under 未做 / 需要真机 too.

Fuller fix (L, after the demo):
- Add `var language: String = "zh-HK"` to Resident.
- Add a language Picker to Settings and to first-time setup, and save the choice to UserDefaults.
- Agree a locale parameter for Speaker and Listener with B, since Speech.swift is B's code.
- Move the screen text to a String Catalog and add zh-Hans.
- Have TemplateAI recognise Mandarin phrases.

Do not add the picker before the backend support exists.

confirmed.title: 卡通形象只有一种肤色，也没有年龄差异
confirmed.evidence: 3D 小人的头全部用同一个 SceneStyle.skin (0.961,0.769,0.702)。2D 的 AvatarBadge 只是给 SF Symbol 剪影（figure.walk、figure.roll、stroller.fill）上色，没有肤色和年龄；stroller.fill 只画出 BB 车，图里没有人。首次使用的「揀你嘅小人」只能选行动方式 4 种和衣服颜色 7 种。示範街坊叫李伯、張伯、陳太，外形却一模一样。
confirmed.rule: §4：卡通形象要覆盖轮椅、拐杖、婴儿车、不同年龄和肤色
confirmed.fix: Resident 加 skinTone（4–6 档）和 ageGroup（长者、成人、后生）。Figures.person 按 skinTone 给头上色，长者加白发或驼背的低多边形变体。AvatarBadge 改成自绘头像（头部肤色加发型）。首次使用和设置里各加一行肤色、一行年龄选择，每个选项配 VoiceOver 名称。

verdict.reason:
This is a real gap. Spec §4 (docs/产品定稿_康乐社交App_v1.0.md:122) says, word for word, that the cartoon figures must cover wheelchairs, canes, strollers, different ages and different skin tones. The code covers only the mobility part (Mobility enum in Figures.swift:4-5).
- Skin tone and age are missing everywhere. Searching the A-owned code for skin/膚色/年齡/age/hair finds only the one constant SceneStyle.skin = rgb(0.961,0.769,0.702) at SceneStyle.swift:66. Every 3D head uses it (Figures.swift:36).
- Resident (Models.swift:4-24) has no tone or age field.
- AvatarBadge (Design.swift:105-138) is an SF Symbol tinted with the clothing color, so it shows no skin. Its stroller.fill symbol draws only the stroller, with no person in it.
- The onboarding picker 「揀你嘅小人」 (Onboarding.swift:495-618) and the Settings Picker (Settings.swift:22) offer only mobility and clothing color.
- The demo roster (Community.swift:78-80) has 李伯 and 張伯 next to 陳太 and 黃太, and they differ only by mobility and clothing color.

This does not conflict with any settled decision. "Style over realism" covers building height, shape, position and shade accuracy, not who the figures represent. The paper-cut style also doesn't explain it away: the code hard-codes one light, realistic skin color rather than a neutral paper tone. No doc lists this as deferred. It isn't a crash or a privacy issue, but it is an explicit inclusive-design requirement in a project aimed at the SDGs, and judges are likely to notice. So medium.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix, effort M (about half a day):
1. In SceneStyle, replace `skin` with `skinTones: [UIColor]` holding 4 tones, light to dark.
2. Add `skinTone: Int` and `isElder: Bool` to Resident. In AppStore, add `skinChoice` and `elderChoice` and persist them the same way as colorChoice.
3. Change Figures.person to `person(color:mobility:skinTone:elder:)`. The head material uses `skinTones[i]`. When elder is true, add a white SCNSphere cap on top of the head as white hair. Update every call site.
4. In AvatarBadge, add `skinTone` and `elder` parameters and draw a small skin-colored head circle (white hair arc for elders) next to or above the symbol. For .stroller, also draw a person beside the stroller so the badge isn't just the stroller.
5. In onboarding 「揀你嘅小人」 and in Settings, add one row of 4 skin swatches and one 長者/後生 toggle. Give each a VoiceOver label (e.g. 「膚色 1，淺」) and have the speaker read the choice aloud.
6. Give the demo roster different tones, and set elder = true for 李伯 and 張伯.

confirmed.title: F4 排行榜只显示楼层不显示座数；圈对圈没有月末公布胜出圈，也没有给胜出成员的卡通标记；文档也没列为未做
confirmed.evidence: listName 只拼「N 樓」（街坊再加名字）。Resident.blockName 已经有值（Community.swift:87），但只在设置页用到；backend 的 circle_board 也只输出 floor。CircleRace 只有本月双方步数，没有上个月结果和胜负字段，Resident 也没有 badge。界面只有进度条和「領先／落後」，示範数据下永远领先（rival = ours × 0.93）。全仓库找不到月末结算、胜出公告或成员标记的代码。prototype_status 的 F4 行没注明这两项未做。
confirmed.rule: F4：每个成员显示为「卡通小人 + 座数和楼层 + 一句」；月末公布胜出的圈，胜出圈的成员获得一个卡通标记
confirmed.fix: listName 改成「皇滙樓 8 樓」这样的格式，blockName 为空时省略；非街坊也显示座数，但不显示门牌；circle_board 加 block 字段。CircleRace 加 lastMonthWinner，每月 1 日首次打开时用横幅加语音公布结果；胜出成员的 AvatarBadge、排行行和场景头像加小奖章角标，示範数据标「示範」。如果暂时不做，就在 prototype_status 里列为未做。

verdict.reason:
I checked the code and the spec, and the report holds. The spec, docs/产品定稿_康乐社交App_v1.0.md:63, says each member is shown as "卡通小人 + 座数和楼层 + 一句". The users table at line 173 also has a 座数 (block) field.

1. **Block is never shown on the board.** Models.swift:26 `listName` builds only "N 樓", "N 樓 名" or "N 樓 · 你". `listName` is used only in the board (Tabs.swift:443/467/472), and `myRow` at Tabs.swift:487 uses `floorLabel`. The data is already there: Community.swift:87 fills `blockName` from OSM names (fallback_queenshill.json has 皇滙樓/皇樂樓 and so on), and AppStore+Map.swift:128 fills mine. `blockName` is read only in Settings.swift:16. docs/backend_supabase.md:126 also says `circle_board` outputs only `floor, avatar, streak, daily_line`, even though users has a `block` column at line 30.

2. **No month-end result or winner mark.** The spec at line 66 says "月末公布胜出的圈，胜出圈的成员获得一个卡通标记". `CircleRace` (Community.swift:55-61) holds only this month's two step totals and the demo flag. The board card (Tabs.swift:392-427) shows only a "領先/落後" bar. I searched for winner, 勝出, medal and last-month code and found nothing. In the demo, `rival = ours × 0.93`, so we always lead. F4 比拼 is assigned to A (§6, line 151).

3. **The status doc doesn't say this is missing.** The F4 row in docs/prototype_status.md:17 lists only the demo data under "模拟 / 未做". It doesn't mention the missing result or mark, which is an honesty gap in the "what works vs simulated" doc.

**Doesn't break a decided point.** The decided points cover layout proportions, font sizes, the visual style, single-device demo and privacy rules. None of them drops block number or the month-end result. Showing block for non-neighbours is allowed: the spec hides only name, photo and door number.

**Why low.** The user's layout sketch (layout_sketch.html:57-60) shows floor-only rows, which weakens the block part a little. Neither gap shows up in the 95-second demo. Nothing crashes and no data leaks.
verdict.fix:
Smallest fix (S, about 30 minutes):
1. **Show the block.** In Models.swift add `var blockShort: String? { blockName?.split(separator: " ").first.map(String.init) }`. This keeps only the Chinese part, so "皇滙樓 Wong Wui House" becomes "皇滙樓". Then have `listName` put it in front: "皇滙樓 8 樓", "皇滙樓 8 樓 陳太", "皇滙樓 8 樓 · 你". Leave it out when `blockName` is nil. In Tabs.swift:487 change `"\(me.floorLabel) · 你"` to `me.listName`.
2. **Backend doc.** In backend_supabase.md:126 add `block` to the `circle_board` output.
3. **Status doc.** In the F4 row of prototype_status.md, add to the 模拟/未做 column: "月末公布勝出圈、勝出成員嘅卡通標記未做（只有本月進度）". Add the same item under "未做".

Optional, to build the feature (M): add `lastMonthWinner: String?` to `CircleRace`. On the first launch of each month, show a banner on the board and speak the result. Give winning members a small medal mark on `AvatarBadge`. Label it 「示範」 in demo mode.

confirmed.title: 轮椅用户的散步检测不到（只认 walking 和 running）
confirmed.evidence: 出门只靠 CMMotionActivity 的 walking 或 running 触发，iPhone 不会把推轮椅识别成 walking。电动轮椅可能被判成 automotive 或 cycling，这时走 .riding 分支，直接 finishLiveWalk 并关掉定位。App 在首次使用时让用户选「輪椅」小人，但这类用户的 F1 记录和 F4 连续天数实际无法累积。
confirmed.rule: §1：老年人也能用；§4：卡通形象覆盖轮椅；F1 自动记录
confirmed.fix: mobilityChoice == .wheelchair 时不依赖 walking 判定：用定位速度（0.3–2.5 m/s 持续 1 分钟）开始记录，riding 只在速度超过 4 m/s 时才结束；另外提供「出门」按钮手动开始，作为后备。

verdict.reason:
I tried to refute this and could not. The code path checks out. In WalkDetector.swift:55-61 the only event that turns location on is `.walking(true)`, and it fires only when `a.walking || a.running`. AppStore+Walk.swift:142 calls `setLocating(on || d.recording)`. A walk can only begin from a `.location` event (AppStore+Walk.swift:163-166, more than 55 m from home), and that event needs location to be on already. No other code calls setLocating(true) apart from the recording-resume case.

When demo mode is off, the main UI has no manual start. DemoMenu, which holds the 「出門」 button, only appears when demoMode is on (MainView.swift:231). On an iPhone, Core Motion has no wheelchair state, and walking is inferred from the step rhythm. Apple turns off iPhone step counting when Health is set to wheelchair, and wheelchair push detection exists only on Apple Watch. So a manual wheelchair user will almost always show as stationary or unknown. Location never turns on and F1 never records. As a result their F4 streak and the 「我出門話佢知」 outing alerts never fire either.

The claim that a powered wheelchair is read as automotive or cycling and so takes the `.riding` branch is a guess. The main gap stands without it.

On the rules: F1 literally says "用 Core Motion 检测步行状态", and the code follows that wording. But §1 says "所有功能遵循包容性设计", and §4 requires the avatars to cover wheelchairs. Onboarding (Onboarding.swift:502) and Settings (Settings.swift:22) both offer 「輪椅」. So the app invites wheelchair users, and its core auto-record then fails for them without telling them. It also fails F1's acceptance test for that group: 「用户全程不碰手机，一次散步被完整记录」.

This does not conflict with any decided item. The single-device demo decision does not exclude real detection. README.md:13 and prototype_status.md:5/14 present 「真机步行检测」 as something that really runs.

I rate it low rather than medium. demoMode defaults to true (AppStore.swift:89), the demo and on-stage flow never take this path, and nothing crashes or loses data. The problem is limited to real devices with demo mode turned off.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix, effort S: add a `seated` flag in WalkDetector, set from `mobilityChoice == .wheelchair` in startWalkDetection and in setAvatar (Settings.swift:117).

When seated, the handler at WalkDetector.swift:55-61 should treat "not confidently stationary" (`!a.stationary`, including `a.unknown`) as moving and send `.walking(true)`, so location turns on.

When seated, do not send `.riding` from `automotive || cycling`, unless the last CLLocation `speed` is above about 4 m/s. That needs a speed field added to lastFix.

The existing rules then start and finish the walk with no further change: start beyond 55 m from home, finish within 40 m of home, or after 5 minutes stationary near home.

Optionally, when demo mode is off, show a large 「出門 / 返屋企」 button as a manual fallback for every user. Also add one line to prototype_status.md F1 saying that wheelchair users are detected by location instead of the step classifier.

confirmed.title: 在外面停下来时（不在家附近）散步不会结束，坐着的时间也被算成散步分钟
confirmed.evidence: .still 只在离家 80 m 以内才收尾。在街市或朋友家坐两小时，walk 一直不结束，出门状态也一直挂着；之后走回家，liveMinutes = 最后定位时间 − 开始时间，这两小时全算作散步，按「分钟 × 100」估算的月步数也跟着虚高。
confirmed.rule: F1：停止步行后自动结束
confirmed.fix: 不论在哪里，still 超过一定时间（例如 10 分钟）就结束本次散步，或者把这段记成落脚点并暂停计时。分钟数只累计 walking 状态的时间，或者改用 CMPedometer 的步数。

verdict.reason: The bug is real, but it happens in fewer cases than the report says. The `.still` handler (ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Walk.swift:147-150) only ends a walk when the last location fix is within 80 m of home. Anywhere else it does nothing. `liveMinutes()` (lines 186-189) and `finishLiveWalk()` (lines 131-134) both count minutes as last fix time minus start time. They never subtract time spent sitting still. So if the user sits at the market with the app in the foreground, or reopens it at least every 15 minutes, the walk keeps going. When they walk home, the first new fix makes `minutes = now - start`, and the whole sit is counted as walking. That inflates 「今日行咗 X 分鐘」 (UI/Tabs.swift:116) and `myMonthSteps`, which is estimated as minutes × 100 (AppStore+Persist.swift:143-146) and feeds the F4 monthly circle race (Community.swift:150-153). The streak ranking is not affected. This breaks F1 「停止步行後自動結束」. The 落腳點 definition (a stop of ≥2 min) does make short stops part of a walk, but it does not make an hour-long sit count as walking minutes. None of the settled decisions cover this: real-device step detection is advertised as working in README and prototype_status, and those docs only describe the home-based end condition. Two things limit it. First, location is foreground-only (When-In-Use, no background mode), and going to the background calls `walkDetector.stop()` (AppStore+Services.swift:6-14). Second, on returning to the foreground, if the last fix is more than 15 minutes old, `startWalkDetection` ends the walk using the last fix time (lines 120-128). So the common case, sitting two hours with the phone locked in a pocket, is cut off correctly when the app is next opened. The report's "walk never ends for two hours" only applies when the app stays in the foreground or is reopened within 15 minutes. Showing the user as out while they really are out is not a privacy problem. It only affects real-device mode, and the main demo runs on the simulated route, so I rate it low.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix, size S, about 15 lines.
(1) In WalkDetector.watchStill (Services/WalkDetector.swift:66-75), store `stillSince = Date()` when the still timer is created. Clear it when the user is no longer still. Expose it read-only.
(2) Change the `.still` handler (AppStore+Walk.swift:147-150) to: `guard d.recording, let w = walk else { return }`. If near home, keep the current behaviour. Otherwise set `walk?.minutes = max(0, Int((d.stillSince ?? d.lastFixAt ?? Date()).timeIntervalSince(w.start) / 60))` and finish the walk.
