In both branches, use the time the user stopped as the end time, not the latest fix.
(3) After ending the walk, call `d.setLocating(false)`. Then add `d.isWalking` (the last `.walking(true)`) to the walk-start condition at line 165. Without this, the next fix while still sitting at the market (more than 55 m from home) would start a new walk straight away.
(4) Have finishWalk take a reason parameter. When the walk ends outside, don't say 「返到屋企喇…而家已經隱身」; say something like 「停低咗一陣，今次散步記好咗」. Optionally raise stillAfter to about 10 minutes so stops of 2-10 minutes still count as 落腳點 inside the walk.

confirmed.title: 只能请「今日」的假：没有起止日期，说「聽日請假」会把今天设成请假
confirmed.evidence: leaveDays 是一组日期键，toggleLeave 只切换今天。VoiceIntent.leave 不带参数，所以「聽日請假」「下星期去旅行請三日假」都会被当成今天请假，卡片也显示「今日請假」。§7 的 leaves 表要求有开始日期和结束日期。
confirmed.rule: F4：用户可以用语音请假，请假期间连续天数保留；§7：leaves(用户 id, 开始日期, 结束日期)
confirmed.fix: 和 B 商定把 VoiceIntent 改成 .leave(from: Int, days: Int)；本机存 [LeaveRange]；请假卡显示日期范围并要求确认；按钮后备做成「今日 / 聽日 / 揀日子」。

verdict.reason:
I tried to refute this and couldn't. The report is accurate and doesn't conflict with any of the settled decisions. The spec's F4 (docs/产品定稿_康乐社交App_v1.0.md:65) says the user can ask for leave by voice and the streak is kept "during the leave period". §7 (line 179) defines leaves as (user id, start date, end date). The code can only record leave for today.
(1) ios/StreetWalk/Domain/Contracts.swift:9 declares `case leave` with no parameters, unlike `.invite`, which carries `day`.
(2) B's parser, ios/StreetWalk/AI/TemplateAI.swift:13, returns `.leave` as soon as the text contains 請假, 告假 or 请假. Date words are thrown away, so 「聽日請假」 and 「下星期請三日假」 both become `.leave`.
(3) A's handler at ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Voice.swift:62-64 hard-codes the card title 「今日請假」 and calls `toggleLeave()`. ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Walk.swift:194-200 then inserts only `LocalStore.dayKey(now)`.
(4) The fallback button (ios/StreetWalk/UI/Tabs.swift:165-182) and the example phrases (AppStore+Voice.swift:39/41) are also today-only.
So when a user says 「聽日請假」, today gets marked as leave and tomorrow is left uncovered. If they don't walk tomorrow, the streak breaks, which is exactly what F4 is meant to prevent. A multi-day trip needs a separate request every day.
Two things limit the impact. The card and the spoken reply both say 「今日」, so the result isn't hidden from the user. The reject action `rejectVoice` (line 114) undoes it.
One correction to the suggested fix: a new `[LeaveRange]` store isn't needed. `leaveDays: Set<String>` (AppStore.swift:70) already holds any set of days. `LocalStore.streak` (LocalStore.swift:51-63) works with future day keys, and CoreTests:161 already saves and restores a non-today key. docs/backend_supabase.md:75 also stores leave as one row per day, which is equivalent to a date range.
The change touches the shared Contracts.swift and B's TemplateAI, so it needs B's agreement.
verdict.fix:
Smallest fix (S to M; the Contracts.swift change needs B's agreement):
(1) Contracts.swift:9 becomes `case leave(fromDay: Int = 0, days: Int = 1)`, where 0 means today, 1 tomorrow, 2 the day after.
(2) B updates TemplateAI.swift:13 to read 聽日/明日 (1) and 後日 (2) the same way the change-meetup branch does, plus 「N日」 for the number of days. Anything it can't read keeps the default of today, one day.
(3) A adds `applyLeave(fromDay:days:)` to AppStore+Walk.swift. It inserts each day key into the existing `leaveDays` set, so the storage model stays as it is. The voice card at AppStore+Voice.swift:63 gets a title built from the range, e.g. 「聽日起請 3 日假（至 10 月 12 號）」, and the spoken reply in toggleLeave changes to match. `rejectVoice` (line 114) removes those same keys.
(4) The leave row in Tabs.swift:167 shows 「已請假到 X 號」, and next to 「請假」 add a second button 「聽日都請」, so every voice action still has a button.
(5) Add parser and streak tests for 「聽日請假」 and 「請三日假」.

confirmed.title: 完全没有本地或推送通知：出发前提醒、街坊出门提醒等都只在 App 开着时出现
confirmed.evidence: 全代码没有 UNUserNotificationCenter。街坊出门提醒、约会应承、出发前 30 分钟提醒、F9「前一晚」的天气建议、反映回覆，都只是横幅加朗读，8 秒后自动消失。checkAppointments 依赖前台的 30 秒时钟，App 在后台或锁屏时，约好的「30 分鐘後出發」提醒永远不会出现，之后打开只看到「過咗時間」。prototype_status 却把「出发前 30 分钟提醒」列为真的。
confirmed.rule: F6：街坊出门后 2 分钟内收到提醒；F9：前一晚或当天出门前提示；§4
confirmed.fix: 同意之后申请通知权限。约会变为已接受时用 UNCalendarNotificationTrigger 排一个本地通知，改约或取消时撤销；前一晚的天气建议也用本地排程。CommunityEvent 在后台时转成本地通知，上线后接 APNs。文档注明街坊出门提醒要等后端推送。

verdict.reason:
This is real only as a documentation and honesty gap. The code-level spec gap mostly falls under the settled decisions.

What I checked:
- There is no UserNotifications import or UNUserNotificationCenter anywhere in ios/StreetWalk, and no UIBackgroundModes in project.pbxproj.
- showBanner (AppStore.swift:138-146) hides itself after 8 s.
- checkAppointments only runs from the in-process 30 s clock (AppStore+Meetup.swift:239-265) or from in-app triggers.
- appActive(false) (AppStore+Services.swift:6-15) stops background work.
So every reminder appears only while the app is open.

Why most of the report is rejected:
1. F6 neighbour-outing alerts and F8 "对方出门" come from LocalCommunityService. That simulator runs in-process and is driven by the demo menu (prototype_status.md:19 already says so). Reaching a backgrounded phone needs a real backend plus APNs. That conflicts with the settled "单机演示 + CommunityService 预留，不做 Supabase" decision, so the proposed APNs or background CommunityEvent work is out of scope.
2. The spec has no "出发前 30 分钟提醒". F7 only requires both sides to hear the spoken agreement on acceptance. The reminder is a prototype extra, not a gap.
3. F9 is B's feature. Its wording is "在前一晚**或**当天出门前", so in-app advice before going out already meets it.
4. The evidence overstates the reopen behaviour. If the user reopens before the appointment time, the reminder still fires on the next check. Between the appointment time and 60 min after it, nothing shows. Only after 60 min does the "過咗時間" toast appear.

What remains true:
- prototype_status.md:5 and :20 list "约会全流程…出发前 30 分钟提醒" as real, with no note that it only works while the app is open. For a reminder, that is the main use case, so the "what works vs simulated" page slightly overclaims.
- backend_supabase.md:146 and :153 plan to deliver CommunityEvent (街坊出门 / 约会变化 / 反映回覆) through Supabase Realtime only. Realtime only works while the app is running, so this future plan cannot meet F6's acceptance test ("街坊出门后 2 分钟内收到提醒"). There is no APNs step and no estimate for it.

Severity is low: the code is in demo scope, and the gap is that the docs don't say so and the backend estimate is missing a step.
verdict.fix:
Documentation only, small effort.
(1) prototype_status.md: in the 模拟 / 未做 column of the F6 row (line 19) and the F7 row (line 20), add "提醒（街坊出门、约会应承、出发前 30 分钟、反映回覆）只在 App 开着时以横幅加朗读出现，未接系统通知；锁屏或后台收不到". Add the same caveat to the summary sentence on line 5 or to the "未做 / 需要真机" list.
(2) backend_supabase.md: change the onEvent row (line 146) and step 3 (line 153) to say Realtime only works while the app is running. To meet F6's "2 分钟内" when the app is in the background, add a step: an Edge Function or database webhook on outings and meetups inserts sends APNs to receivers whose receive_remind setting is on and who are inside their chosen time window, plus a step to request notification permission after consent. Add about 1 day to the estimate.
Optional, not required by spec: when an appointment becomes accepted, schedule a UNCalendarNotificationTrigger local notification 30 minutes before, and remove it on reschedule, cancel or expiry. Do not build APNs or background CommunityEvent handling in this prototype.

confirmed.title: 后端草案的 RLS 有漏洞：街坊永远看不到出门状态；users、walks 等表没开 RLS；meetups 和 neighbors 可以单方面插入
confirmed.evidence: 只有 neighbors、outings、meetups、reports 开了 RLS。users、walks（每天经过的 landmark_ids 和 daily_line）、leaves、landmarks、circles、circle_members 都没有 enable row level security，而 Supabase 默认通过 PostgREST 暴露这些表，开了匿名登录后，任何人都能查到全部昵称、座数、楼层和每天经过的地标。第 126 行说 users 不直接开放，但没有对应的 policy。neighbors can see outing 的子查询要读对方的 neighbors 行，但 neighbors 自己的 RLS 是 owner = auth.uid()，子查询同样受限，读不到，所以街坊永远收不到出门状态，Realtime 也一样。meetups 的 parties 策略 for all 只检查 auth.uid() in (inviter, invitee)，任何人都能给任意非街坊插入邀请。neighbors 的 own rows 策略 for all 允许客户端直接插入 (owner=我, other=任何人)，绕过第 140 行的配对码校验。§5 写 renameLandmark「RLS 限同圈成员」，但文中没有这条策略。
confirmed.rule: F4：非街坊不显示姓名；F5：只能碰一碰添加街坊，不提供远程邀请；F7：只能约街坊；backend §1 自身的约定
confirmed.fix: 所有表都开 RLS，默认拒绝。出门可见性改用 security definer 函数 is_mutual_neighbor(a,b)。walks、leaves 只允许本人读写，排行榜走 security definer 视图。neighbors 的插入只能经过校验配对码的 RPC，客户端 with check (false)。meetups 插入时 with check (inviter = auth.uid() and 双方互为街坊)，update 限定可改的字段。circle_board 只对双方都是街坊的输出 nickname。landmarks 补上「同圈成员可以改 name」的策略。

verdict.reason:
读了 docs/backend_supabase.md 全文，报告里的五点都成立。这份草案是成员 A「后端和全部数据表」（§6）的交付物，而且 §6 第 1 步明确写着「建 Supabase 项目，执行上面的 SQL」，所以 SQL 的漏洞会直接带到上线。指出它不等于推翻「单机演示、不做 Supabase」这个决定，问题只在文档写错了。
1) 第 104-123 行只给 neighbors、outings、meetups、reports 开了 RLS。users、landmarks、circles、circle_members、walks、leaves 都没开。Supabase 默认把 public 表通过 PostgREST 授权给 anon 和 authenticated 角色，开了匿名登录后，任何人都能读到全部的昵称、座数、楼层，以及 walks 里的 landmark_ids 和 daily_line。这和 §1 的隐私表（同圈只看到「今日行到 X」）不符，也和第 126 行「users 不直接开放」不符。
2) 第 110-114 行 outings 的策略在子查询里要读对方的 neighbors 行（a.owner = outings.user_id）。Postgres 对策略子查询里引用的表同样执行 RLS，而 neighbors 的策略是 owner = auth.uid()（第 106 行），所以 a 行永远读不到，EXISTS 永远为假。结果是街坊永远看不到对方的出门状态，Realtime 也一样，F6 在后端层面不能用。
3) 第 119 行 meetups 用的是 for all 加 USING，没有写 WITH CHECK，这时 USING 会同时当作 WITH CHECK。这样任何人都能插入 inviter=我、invitee=任意人的邀请，违反 F7「只能约街坊」和 F5「不提供远程邀请」。另外任一方都能在 UPDATE 时改掉 inviter、invitee 等字段。
4) 第 106 行 neighbors 也是 for all，客户端可以直接插入 (owner=我, other=任何人)，绕过第 139 行写的「服务器校验同一个配对码」，违反 F5「只能碰一碰添加」。如果 circle_board 只按单向关系判断「已是街坊」，还会泄露昵称，违反 F4。
5) 第 144 行写「RLS 限同圈成员」，但 landmarks 没开 RLS，也没有对应策略，任何人都能改任何地标的名字。
以上都是文档里的设计错误。原型不调用 Supabase，所以对当前的演示没有影响，严重程度定为 medium（隐私设计文档错误，上线前必须改）。
verdict.fix:
只改 docs/backend_supabase.md 第 3 节，工作量 S–M，约 1 小时。
(a) 所有表都 enable row level security，默认拒绝：
- users 只允许本人 select/update，别人只能通过 security definer 视图 circle_board 看到。
- walks、leaves 只允许本人：using (user_id = auth.uid())。
- circles、circle_members 只允许本圈成员 select。
- landmarks 允许同屋邨 select。另加 update 策略：using (exists (select 1 from circle_members m where m.circle_id = landmarks.circle_id and m.user_id = auth.uid()))，并且只 grant update (name)。
(b) 新增 security definer stable 函数：
- is_mutual_neighbor(a uuid, b uuid)
- can_see_outing(owner uuid, viewer uuid)：判断 owner 那行 send_remind、viewer 那行 receive_remind。
outings 的 select 策略改用 user_id = auth.uid() or can_see_outing(user_id, auth.uid())。
(c) neighbors 拆开写：select/update/delete 用 owner = auth.uid()；insert 用 with check (false)。建立关系只能走 security definer RPC link_neighbor(pair_code)，由它校验双方提交了同一个配对码，再一次写入两行。
(d) meetups：
- insert 用 with check (inviter = auth.uid() and is_mutual_neighbor(inviter, invitee))。
- update 用 using/with check (auth.uid() in (inviter, invitee))，只 grant update (at, landmark_id, reason, status, updated_by)，或者加触发器禁止改 inviter、invitee。
(e) circle_board 只有 is_mutual_neighbor(viewer, member) 为真时才输出 nickname。
(f) 在 §6 第 1 步注明 SQL 要按上面改完才能执行。

confirmed.title: prototype_status 把演示菜单触发或写死的功能列为「真的」：迟到询问、播送、打电话、步频提示

verdict.reason:
This is real for two of the four items. The other two are overstated or wrong.

Confirmed:
(1) docs/prototype_status.md:21 lists 「迟到 10 分钟询问」 under 「真的」. In the code, latePrompt is only ever set to true by lateDemo() (ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Find.swift:104-109). Nothing else calls lateDemo() except the demo menu button 「遲到」 (ios/StreetWalk/UI/Demo.swift:23), and DemoScript does not call it either. Nothing checks the appointment time plus 10 minutes. The F6 row of the same doc does say 「由演示菜单触发」, but F8 leaves that out, so the doc is inconsistent with itself.
(2) 「『我喺涼亭』播送」 is also listed as 「真的」. broadcastHere() (AppStore+Find.swift:111-117) only sets find.broadcast on this phone and speaks 「已經話俾…知」. The CommunityService protocol (ios/StreetWalk/Store/Community.swift:8-44) has no broadcast method, so the message is not even sent to the reserved interface. Calling this 「真的」 overclaims.

Partly true:
(3) Calls. PhoneBook.numbers is an empty dictionary, so the tel: line in call() can never run. However, the 「模拟/未做」 column of the same row already says 「示範街坊没有电话号码，所以会显示说明」, so this is disclosed. Only the wording 「真拨号」 goes too far. The misleading toast text belongs to issue A53, not this one.

Wrong:
(4) The doc's F9 row never mentions the pace-drop tip, so the doc does not list it as 「真的」. Leaving it out is a gap, not an overclaim. The behaviour itself is as reported: in tickWalk (AppStore+Walk.swift:77) the tip appears at minute 18 of the simulated walk every time, and a real-device walk never shows it.

This does not conflict with the agreed decisions. 「单机演示 + CommunityService 预留」 decides how things are built. This issue is only about whether the doc describes them honestly. The doc's whole job is to answer the judging question "what works vs. what's simulated", so these overclaims count as an honesty problem. It only needs a wording change and does not affect users, so severity is low.
verdict.fix: Change only docs/prototype_status.md, in the F8 row. Leave 「寻路、距离、箭头方向」 in the 「真的」 column, plus 「打电话：有号码时用 tel: 拨号」. Add to the 「模拟/未做」 column: 「迟到 10 分钟询问由演示菜单「遲到」触发，未按约定时间自动计时」, 「『我喺涼亭』只在本机显示和播报，未经 CommunityService 发给对方」, and 「现时没有任何电话号码来源，所以拨不出去」. Optionally add to the 「模拟/未做」 column of the F9 row: 「散步中步频提示：演示散步第 18 分钟固定出现，真机未做」. Effort is S, about 5 minutes. The code fixes are tracked in A19, A20 and A53 and do not need to be done together with this.

confirmed.title: test.sh 不论测试成败都返回 0
confirmed.evidence: xcodebuild test 的输出经过两个 grep 管道，最后接 || true。管道的退出码取最后一个命令，所以编译失败或测试失败时脚本照样 exit 0，脚本、CI 和录制前的检查都无法据此判断成败。grep -vE 还会吞掉通过的测试行。
confirmed.rule: 测试结果要可信
confirmed.fix: 加 set -o pipefail；或者 xcodebuild ... | tee log，之后取 PIPESTATUS[0]，最后 exit 这个状态码。

verdict.reason:
The bug is real. In /Users/nmgb/Desktop/HACK/HACK4SDG/ios/tools/test.sh lines 6-7, the command is `xcodebuild test ... 2>&1 | grep -E ... | grep -vE ... || true`. `||` binds more loosely than the pipe, so it applies to the whole pipeline. The script has `set -e` but no pipefail, so the pipeline's status comes only from the last grep, and `|| true` then turns that into 0. Result: the script exits 0 even when the build fails or a test fails. It is a genuine defect: a test script that reports success on failure.

The impact is smaller than the report says, so I'm downgrading it from medium to low:
1. Nothing calls test.sh automatically. There is no CI config, and record_demo.sh and selftest.sh don't call it. README.md:22 and docs/prototype_status.md:28 only list it as a command you run by hand.
2. The grep -E filter still prints `error:`, `✘`, and the `Test run with ... failed after` summary line, so someone reading the terminal does see a failure. Only the exit code is wrong.
3. The report also says `grep -vE "^✔ Test [^r]"` "swallows the passed test lines". That's intentional noise filtering: the `[^r]` keeps the `✔ Test run with N tests passed` summary line. That part is not a bug.

None of the settled decisions cover this.
verdict.fix:
Small fix (S). Change the shebang to `#!/bin/bash` (the script currently uses /bin/sh, so it's safer not to rely on how sh handles pipefail). Add `set -o pipefail` after `set -e`. Replace the trailing `|| true` with a brace group so a grep that matches nothing can't fail the script:
`xcodebuild test ... 2>&1 | { grep -E "error:|✘|Test run with|passed after|failed after" | grep -vE "^✔ Test [^r]"; true; }`
With pipefail, the pipeline now takes xcodebuild's non-zero exit code, and `set -e` exits the script with it. A successful run still prints the filtered output and exits 0.

confirmed.title: 日期标签把昨天和三天后都叫「後日」
confirmed.evidence: dayTimeLabel 只分今日、聽日，其余一律返回「後日」。隔一天再打开 App，过期提示会说「同陳太後日下晝4點嘅約過咗時間」，其实那是昨天的约。讲「約陳太後日三點」时，candidateTimes 给出的第三个候选 (day+1, 8) 是三天后，也显示成「後日朝早 8 點」。upcomingAppointments 列表也一样。
confirmed.rule: F7：双方各收到一句完整的口头约定；文案要准确
confirmed.fix: 按日差显示：琴日／今日／聽日／後日，更远的显示「X月X日（星期X）」。补单元测试。

verdict.reason:
The bug is real. In ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Meetup.swift:281-285, dayTimeLabel only checks two cases: same day as `now` gives 今日, `now`+86400 gives 聽日. Every other date, past or future, gets 後日.

Path 1, proposal: TemplateAI.swift:49 parses "約陳太後日三點" as invite(day: 2, hour: 15). The test at CoreTests.swift:84 covers the day:2 parse. candidateTimes (Meetup.swift:26-28) then returns [(2,15), (2,16), (3,8)]. The third option is three days out, but it is labelled 後日朝早8點. That label shows on the proposal card (Cards.swift:29) and in the spoken confirmation (Meetup.swift:99) once the user taps 換時間 (nextProposalTime). Once saved, the same label appears in the appointment list (Tabs.swift:197/649).

Path 2, expiry: appointments are saved and reloaded (AppStore.swift:55, AppStore+Persist.swift:16). If the user reopens the app the next day, checkAppointments (Meetup.swift:247-252) finds left < -3600. The toast then says 「同陳太後日…嘅約過咗時間」 about yesterday's meetup, where it should say 琴日. The cancel confirmation (Tabs.swift:848) and the voice cards (AppStore+Voice.swift:56/79/85) use the same function.

Telling an older user the wrong day breaks F7's requirement that each side gets a complete spoken agreement (规格:91). This is a wording error, not a decided design choice, so it does not conflict with the settled decisions. It does not crash and has no privacy impact. Path 1 only shows after a user says 後日 and cycles to the third option, and path 2 only after the app is reopened the next day, so severity is low.
verdict.fix: In dayTimeLabel, compute the day difference with `let diff = cal.dateComponents([.day], from: cal.startOfDay(for: now), to: cal.startOfDay(for: d)).day ?? 0` and map it: -1→琴日, 0→今日, 1→聽日, 2→後日. Show any other date as "M月d日（星期X）", using cal.component(.month/.day/.weekday) and an array of 日一二三四五六. Optionally, in candidateTimes, cap the third option at day 2 so the user is not offered a date they never asked for, e.g. `(day >= 2 ? day : day + 1, 8)`, or use the next hour instead. Add one test in CoreTests that checks the -1, 0, 1, 2 and 3 cases. Effort: S, about 15 lines.

confirmed.title: 把编出来的数字当成真实的显示：地图装好前显示「連續 9 日」；真实散步没经过地标也写「今日行到X」
confirmed.evidence: residents 为空时，me 的后备值写死 streakDays: 9。地图加载期间（没有缓存时要几秒到几十秒）或加载失败时，今日卡和排行榜「我」那一行都显示「連續 9 日」，关掉演示模式也一样。refreshMe 的注释说只针对示範纪录，但条件只是 passed.isEmpty && walks > 0：真实散步走出底座、没经过任何地标时，也会把离家最近的地标塞进去，生成「12 樓今日行到涼亭」并显示在全圈的排行榜上。
confirmed.rule: 诚实：不显示编造的数字；模拟数据必须标「示範」
confirmed.fix: 后备值改用 myStreak()，或者加载期间不显示连续天数。只在 today.demo 为真时才用常去地点补。

verdict.reason:
核心问题属实，但原报告有两处说过头了。
(1) AppStore.swift:95：residents 为空时，me 的后备值写死了 streakDays: 9。App 启动时 init 先把 phase 设成 .main，loadMap 是异步跑的；residents 要等 populate()（AppStore+Map.swift:132）才有值。在这之前，MainView 已经画出 TodayTab，myCard（Tabs.swift:116）就显示「連續 9 日」，跟 demoMode 无关。有地图缓存时，这个 9 只闪一下，再用 numericText 动画跳到真实值。没有缓存时（缓存超过 30 天，或 iOS 清了 Caches），MapService.fetch 最多要试 2 个端点 × 2 次，每次超时 20 s，所以「連續 9 日」可能挂几十秒。这时 streakHasDemo 为 false，没有「示範」标记。关掉演示模式时，真实连续天数可能是 0，用户却先看到一个编出来的 9。
说过头的地方：其一，"加载失败时"不成立。load 失败会用打包在 App 里的 fallback 地图，照样会走 populate。其二，"排行榜「我」那一行显示連續 9 日"不成立。myRow（Tabs.swift:474-509）只显示名次和 todayLine，不显示连续天数；residents 为空时 todayLine 是空的。
(2) AppStore+Persist.swift:173：补地标的条件只有 passed.isEmpty && today.walks > 0，没有检查 today.demo。真机散步时，finishWalk 调 recordWalk(simulated: false)，传入的 w.passed 来自 markPassed（距地标 26 m 以内才算经过）。如果一路都没进过任何地标 26 m 以内，比如走出底座去别处，refreshMe 就把离家最近的地标塞进去，生成「12樓今日行到涼亭」或「喺櫈仔坐咗陣」。这句话带着 AI 标签显示在今日卡上，也显示在排行榜「我」那行，但是不真实，也没有「示範」标记。注释写明这个补法只针对示範纪录，代码却没有这样限制，所以是代码跟注释不符。
小更正：原报告说"全圈的排行榜"，其实目前是单机，todayLine 不会经过 CommunityService 发给别人，只在自己手机的排行榜「我」那行出现。
这些都不涉及"已定的决定"：模拟数据要标「示範」本来就是既定规则，这里是真实数据被编造。只是文案和数字失真，不会崩溃，也不泄露隐私，所以严重程度定为 low。
verdict.fix:
两处一行改动，工作量 S。
1. AppStore.swift:95：后备 Resident 的 `streakDays: 9` 改成 `streakDays: myStreak()`（走 walkLog 和 demoMode 的同一套规则；演示模式下首次启动种下的纪录本来就是 9 日，演示效果不变）。
2. AppStore+Persist.swift:173：条件加上 today.demo，改成 `if passed.isEmpty, today.walks > 0, today.demo, let home = landmark(residents[i].homeLandmarkID) { passed = [home] }`。真实散步没经过任何地标时，就按 dailyLine 的空列表处理。不过空列表现在会返回「今日仲未出門」，同样跟实际不符。所以 dailyLine 需要另外一句真实文案，比如「今日行咗 N 分鐘」，或者 walks > 0 时直接把 todayLine 留空。

confirmed.title: 街坊状态显示和后端规则不一致：没有出门事件就断言「喺屋企」；关掉「佢出門話我知」后仍显示对方在外面
confirmed.evidence: 没有出门事件的街坊，街坊卡和信息卡一律显示「喺屋企」。但对方可能关了「發送」、人在外地，或回家后已隱身（规格要求不再显示位置），所以这句话既可能是错的，也等于告诉别人对方在家。另外，syncScene、outNeighbors 和街坊卡只看 isOut，不看 receiveRemind：我关掉「佢出門話我知」后只是不弹横幅，场景、今日页「而家喺外面」和街坊页仍显示对方所在的地标。而 backend RLS 规定对方开了发送、我开了接收才看得到 outings，接上后端后行为会突然改变。
confirmed.rule: F1：回家后不再对外显示位置；backend_supabase.md §3；F6
confirmed.fix: 文案改成中性的「冇出門消息」，或者不显示状态。二选一统一规则并写进文档：要么本地按 receiveRemind 过滤 syncScene 和 outNeighbors（与 RLS 一致）；要么修改 RLS，让出门状态只受对方「发送」控制，「接收」只管通知。

verdict.reason:
This is real, and it does not conflict with any decision already made. It has two parts.

1) Code and docs disagree. docs/backend_supabase.md:13 (§1 privacy table) says outing status is visible "只有开了'接收'的街坊". The RLS at :108-114 also requires b.receive_remind. The local code ignores receiveRemind:
- AppStore.swift:97 is `outNeighbors = neighbors.filter(\.isOut)`.
- AppStore+Neighbors.swift:92-100 neighborWentOut sets isOut and calls syncScene() before the receiveRemind guard at :103, which only blocks the banner and the spoken alert.
- AppStore+Map.swift:165 puts every outNeighbor into the scene.
- Tabs.swift:44-50 (今日 tab) and :667-668 (街坊 card) show the landmark.
setRemind (:49-54) changes only the flags. So after I turn off 「佢出門話我知」, or decline reminders at the bump (createNeighbor with remind=false sets both flags false), the scene, the 「而家喺外面」 card and the 街坊 page still show the other person's landmark. Under the documented RLS they would disappear once the backend is connected. The README lists Store/Community.swift as the backend swap-in point, so behaviour would change silently at that moment. The audit brief explicitly counts code/doc mismatch as a real problem.

2) The status text overstates what the app knows. Tabs.swift:669 and Cards.swift:276 show 「喺屋企」 whenever isOut is false. The docs define going home as deleting the outing row (backend_supabase.md:59 「回家时删除（= 隐身）」), and the app tells the user 「你屋企 · 已隱身」 (AppStore+Map.swift:170, Cards.swift:273). So "no outing row" gets shown to others as a definite "at home". With a real backend that row is also missing when the person turned off sending, when RLS filters it out, or when they are away. The text can be wrong, and it undercuts the 隱身 promise.

The rejected parts:
- In the single-device demo the simulated neighbours really are at home, so nothing is shown to anyone today. This is a latent problem, not an active leak.
- Spec F6 only talks about reminders. Showing a neighbour's landmark after receive is off does not by itself break the spec. The spec-level problem is the mismatch with the backend doc.
- It does not conflict with the decided rule 「街坊只在出门时、只以地标级位置出现」; it is consistent with it.

Hence severity low.
verdict.fix:
Effort S. Two changes.

(a) Copy: in Tabs.swift:669 and Cards.swift:276, change 「喺屋企」 to a neutral wording such as 「冇出門消息」, so the app no longer claims the person is at home.

(b) Pick one visibility rule. Smallest option: change docs/backend_supabase.md to match the code and spec F6.
- Line 13: who can see outings becomes "neighbours who have 发送 turned on for me".
- RLS at :108-114: keep only a.send_remind and the two-way neighbour relationship; drop b.receive_remind.
- Add a note that 接收 only controls the banner and the spoken alert.
If the stricter documented rule is preferred instead, change AppStore.swift:97 to `neighbors.filter { $0.isOut && $0.receiveRemind }`, and use the same condition in Tabs.swift:667-668 and Cards.swift:275. When receive is turned off, setRemind should also call syncScene().

confirmed.title: 出门提醒时段的「由」和「到」选同一个钟点时，会静默地永远收不到提醒
confirmed.evidence: 「由」（5–23 点）和「到」（6–23 点）各自独立选择。两者相同时，(remindFrom..<remindTo) 是空区间，inRemindWindow 永远为 false，所有出门提醒都静默不发，而「出門提醒」总开关仍显示开着。「到」最早只能选 6 点，也设不了跨午夜到清晨的时段。
confirmed.rule: F6：可以只在指定时段接收（设置要有效、可预期）
confirmed.fix: 「到」的选项排除「由」已选的钟点，或者两者相同时当作全天。「到」加入 0–5 点以支持跨午夜，页脚显示实际生效的时段，例如「夜晚 9 點 → 朝早 7 點」。

verdict.reason:
The main point is real. In ios/StreetWalk/UI/Settings.swift:35-40, the 「由」 picker offers 5..<24 and the 「到」 picker offers 6..<24. Nothing stops both from landing on the same hour. In ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Neighbors.swift:81, inRemindWindow then takes the `remindFrom <= remindTo` branch, and `(h..<h).contains(x)` is always false. That makes the check at line 103 return early every time. No banner and no speech are produced, while the 「出門提醒」 toggle still shows on and the footer still says 「只喺呢段時間通知你」. The values are saved to UserDefaults (AppStore.swift:92-93), so the silent state survives restarts. One realistic way in: the defaults are 7→21, and a user moves 「由」 to 21 (or 「到」 to 7). Neither picker warns about the clash. F6 says reminders can be limited to a chosen time window, so a valid-looking setting that turns reminders off entirely is wrong behavior, not a style choice. It does not conflict with any of the agreed decisions.

Part of the report is overstated. Overnight windows already work. When from > to, line 81 uses `h >= remindFrom || h < remindTo`, so 21→6 or 22→8 behave correctly. The real limit is narrower: a window can't end between 0 and 5 am (e.g. 21→2). That alone doesn't break the spec. The only clear failure is the equal-hour case, and it takes an unusual setting to reach, so severity is low.
verdict.fix: Smallest fix, under 5 lines. In AppStore+Neighbors.swift:79-82, start the computed property with `if remindFrom == remindTo { return true }`, so equal hours mean all day. In the Settings.swift footer, when they are equal, show something like 「由同到一樣，即係全日都會通知你。」. Do not remove the clashing hour from the 「到」 picker. If 「由」 later changes to match the current 「到」, the picker's selected tag would no longer exist and the row would go blank. Optional: when remindFrom > remindTo, add 「（跨夜）」 to the footer so overnight windows are easier to read.

confirmed.title: F8 到达估计算错：显示「大約 N 分鐘到涼亭」，用的却是我和对方之间的直线距离；一按「出發」就宣布对方出了门
confirmed.evidence: etaMinutes = 我和对方的直线距离 / 70，顶卡写「陳太出咗門 · 大約 N 分鐘到<地点>」。对方已经在约定地点等、我还在 300 m 外时，仍显示约 5 分钟到。departForAppointment 一按「出發」就宣布「陳太出咗門」，不管对方是否真的出门。neighborWentOut 也不检查当天的约会，不给到达估计。
confirmed.rule: F8：对方出门时通知用户，并估算对方的到达时间
confirmed.fix: ETA 用对方剩余的路线长度（真机上由对方手机计算后经 CommunityService 传过来）。当天有约的街坊出门时，在 neighborWentOut 里提示「陳太出咗門，大約 N 分鐘到涼亭」。「出咗門」只在收到事件后才说（与 A19 一起做）。

verdict.reason:
Only the ETA part holds up. The other two parts don't.

Confirmed: in an appointment trip (non-spontaneous), the top card at ios/StreetWalk/UI/FullScreen.swift:246 says 「陳太出咗門 · 大約 N 分鐘到<地點>」, which tells the user how long the partner needs to reach the meeting place. But N comes from AppStore+Find.swift:80-82, which takes the straight-line distance between me and the partner and divides it by 70. That is not the partner's remaining walk. Two things show it:
(1) Wrong right at the start. When 出發 is pressed, the voice at line 68 says "大約 X 分鐘到" using the partner's full route length / 70, which is the correct quantity. On the next tick, the card switches to the me-to-partner distance / 70, so the voice and the card disagree at the same moment.
(2) Wrong after the partner arrives. partnerTravelled stops at the end of the partner's route (line 74). If the partner's route is shorter, she reaches the landmark and stands there, but the card keeps saying 「出咗門 · 大約 N 分鐘到涼亭」 with N equal to my distance to her. topCard forces at least 1 minute with max(1, …) and has no "already arrived" state.
F8 asks for an estimate of the partner's arrival time, so this is a real number and wording error. It is low impact: distances are within about 200 m, so N is only 1–5 minutes, and departForAppointment is not in the main demo script.

Rejected:
(a) The voice saying 「陳太出咗門」 as soon as 出發 is pressed. In the single-device demo, the partner is a simulated character and her route starts animating at that moment (partnerRoute starts moving), so the statement is true inside the simulation. This follows the agreed single-device demo with simulated residents. Real event-driven behaviour is already tracked as A19.
(b) neighborWentOut not checking today's appointment and not giving an ETA. This only matters once a real backend sends events. In the demo, F8's "notify and estimate" is already done in the 出發 flow, so this is a design step for the reserved CommunityService interface, not a bug in the current build.
verdict.fix:
Effort S. In tickFind (AppStore+Find.swift:82), for non-spontaneous trips, compute the partner's remaining route, remaining = max(0, pathLength(pr) - partnerTravelled), and set f.etaMinutes = Int((remaining / 70).rounded(.up)). This uses the same quantity as the voice line at line 68. For spontaneous trips, keep the current number (my ETA to her) or switch to my remaining route, pathLength(route) - findTravelled.
In FullScreen.swift:236-246: when it is not spontaneous and etaMinutes == 0, show 「\(p.name)喺\(place)等你」 instead of 「出咗門 · 大約 N 分鐘到」. Only apply max(1, …) while the partner is still walking.
Leave the rest of the reported fix out of this item: the neighborWentOut appointment check and moving 「出咗門」 to an event. Those belong to A19 / the real CommunityService work.

confirmed.title: 月报的示範说明写「你自己嘅散步係真嘅」，其实含示範纪录；散步人次和一齊行也没有 ≥10 人门槛
confirmed.evidence: 这条 DemoNote 只在 monthlyStats.isDemo（即演示模式）时显示，而这时 myMonthWalks 包含 seedDemoHistory 生成的 9 天示範纪录，以及 1 秒算 1 分钟的模拟散步（都标 demo:true），所以这句话在它唯一会出现的场景里是假的。非演示模式下 monthlyStats 返回 walkers=1，月报就是一个人的数据。backend 的 monthly_report 只对「地标×反映」设了 ≥10，散步人次和一齊行没有门槛。
confirmed.rule: F10：只输出地标级、人数 ≥10 的汇总；诚实标注
confirmed.fix: 说明改为「你嘅反映係真嘅；散步紀錄包括示範紀錄」，或者月报只计非示範纪录。walkers < 10 时不显示人次和一齊行（显示「人數未夠，唔顯示」），并写进 backend 文档和 CommunityService 注释。

verdict.reason:
Half of this report holds up: the copy problem is real. The missing threshold is not.

1. The sentence is wrong. The note at ios/StreetWalk/UI/Demo.swift:264-266 only shows when monthlyStats.isDemo is true. The report itself can only be opened from DemoMenu, which only appears when `store.demoMode` is on (MainView.swift:231, Demo.swift:39). In demo mode, myMonthWalks (AppStore+Persist.swift:148-151) counts every record marked demo:true. That includes the 9 days that seedDemoHistory fills in (Persist.swift:178-184). It also includes simulated walks: AppStore+Walk.swift:103 records them as `simulated: !live`. On top of that, setDemoMode stops real walk detection in demo mode (Settings.swift:135). So when the note appears, almost all of "your own walks" are sample records. The code labels these as sample data elsewhere (streakHasDemo), so telling the viewer "你自己嘅散步…係真嘅" is an inaccurate honesty label. Your own reports really are entered by you, so that half of the sentence is fine. The impact is limited, because the whole 散步人次 figure is already marked as sample data. That makes this low severity.

2. The missing ≥10 threshold is not a real problem in the app. The report can only be opened in demo mode, and there walkers = max(12, …), which is always at least 10 (Community.swift:160). The non-demo branch that returns walkers=1 (Community.swift:158) is a local placeholder that no screen can reach. The rule in F10 is about landmark-level aggregates, and the backend doc applies ≥10 to 地标×反映, which matches it. Walk counts and 一齊行 counts are totals for the whole estate. That is coarser than landmark level, not individual tracks, and in a real estate the number of walkers would be far above 10. At most, the backend doc could add one sentence about this. It does not violate the spec.
verdict.fix: Change only the note text at ios/StreetWalk/UI/Demo.swift:265 to: "單機演示：全邨人次、你嘅散步紀錄同其他居民嘅反映係示範數據；你自己嘅反映係真嘅。" No change is needed for the threshold. Optionally, add one sentence to docs/backend_supabase.md §4 saying the estate-wide 散步人次 and 一齊行 counts are also only output when walkers ≥ 10. Effort XS.

confirmed.title: 单机版改名和反映的文案说「同圈街坊都會見到」「月尾交俾屋邨管理」，实际只存在本机
confirmed.evidence: LocalCommunityService 的 renameLandmark 和 submitReport 都是空操作（设置页脚也说「只存喺你部手機」，prototype_status 也写了同圈生效要等后端），但界面和语音说改名「同圈嘅街坊都會見到」、反映「月尾會同其他街坊嘅反映一齊交俾屋邨管理」。关掉演示模式（isSimulated=false、未接后端）时，这些话就不成立。
confirmed.rule: 诚实：不把还没上线的同步说成已经发生
confirmed.fix: 按 community.isSimulated 或「是否已接服务器」切换文案。演示时在旁边加 DemoBadge，或改为「接咗伺服器之後，同圈街坊都會見到」。未接服务器时改为「改咗（暫時只喺你部手機）」「記低咗，接咗伺服器之後會一齊交俾屋邨管理」。

verdict.reason:
I tried to refute this and couldn't. The report is real, but only when demo mode is off.

What the code does:
- `LocalCommunityService.renameLandmark` and `submitReport` are empty stubs that do nothing (`Store/Community.swift:100-101`).
- `isSimulated` just returns `demoEnabled`.
- Demo mode can be switched off in Settings (`Settings.swift:49`) as long as the app was not started with `-demo`. Once off, the Settings footer says the circle is only you because no server is connected (`Settings.swift:54`). It also says renamed landmarks and reports are stored only on your phone (`Settings.swift:60`).

What the copy says, regardless of mode:
- Rename picker (`Cards.swift:154`) and the rename voice card (`AppStore+Voice.swift:67`) say people in the same circle will see the new name.
- Rename speech (`AppStore+Places.swift:29`) says the same.
- Report voice card (`AppStore+Voice.swift:70`) says it goes anonymously to estate management at month end.
- Report speech (`AppStore+Places.swift:42`) says it will be sent to estate management with other residents' reports at month end.

With demo mode off, both claims are false. No other circle members exist, nothing gets sent, and the monthly report can only be opened from the demo menu (`Demo.swift:39`, which is only shown when `demoMode` is on, `MainView.swift:231`). So the app says data is only on the phone in Settings and says it has been shared on the card and in speech.

The rest of the app already switches its copy on `isSimulated` and says "after we connect to a server…" when demo is off (`Tabs.swift:369-372`, `Tabs.swift:538`). These two flows are the only places that don't. `docs/prototype_status.md:16` also says circle-wide renaming has to wait for the backend.

This does not conflict with the agreed decisions. The single-device demo, `CommunityService` stub and simulated residents stay as they are. In demo mode the current copy fits the simulated story and the spec (F3: a rename applies to everyone in the circle; F10: the monthly report goes to estate management), so demo mode is not the problem.

Severity is low. Demo mode is on by default, so it only shows up after someone turns demo mode off. The text is a false statement, not a crash or a privacy leak.
verdict.fix:
Keep the current demo-mode copy. Add a non-demo branch in all five places, keyed on `store.community.isSimulated` (on `AppStore` this is `community.isSimulated`):

1. `Cards.swift:154`: `isSimulated ? "揀個新名，同圈街坊都會見到" : "揀個新名（暫時只喺你部手機，接咗伺服器之後同圈街坊先見到）"`
2. `AppStore+Voice.swift:67`, `detail`: `community.isSimulated ? "同圈街坊都會見到" : "暫時只喺你部手機"`
3. `AppStore+Voice.swift:70`, `detail`: `community.isSimulated ? "月尾匿名交俾屋邨管理" : "暫時只喺你部手機，接咗伺服器之後先會交俾屋邨管理"`
4. `AppStore+Places.swift:29`: in non-demo mode, end the sentence with "暫時只喺你部手機" instead of "同圈嘅街坊都會見到".
5. `AppStore+Places.swift:42`: in non-demo mode, use "記低咗：…。暫時只存喺你部手機。"

Effort: S (five string conditionals, no logic change).

confirmed.title: 解除街坊时说「佢唔會收到通知」，但未完成的约会会以「取消」的形式通知对方
confirmed.evidence: unlinkNeighbor 对未完成的约会调用 community.updateMeetup(.cancelled)，按协议注释，取消会直接通知对方，对方可以由此推断出被解除。对话框只写「佢唔會收到通知…同佢未完成嘅約會會取消」，执行后还朗读「佢唔會收到通知」。
confirmed.rule: F5：任一方可以随时解除街坊关系，对方不会收到通知；诚实文案
confirmed.fix: 有未完成的约会时，对话框和语音改为「佢唔會收到解除通知；不過你哋 N 個約會會取消，佢會收到『約會取消』。」没有约会时保持原文。

verdict.reason:
I tried to disprove this and could not. It is a real problem, but a small one.

The code still meets the letter of F5. No "you were unlinked" message is ever sent: `LocalCommunityService.unlinkNeighbor` (`Store/Community.swift:96`) does nothing, and the comment at `Community.swift:19` and `docs/backend_supabase.md:49` say only the user's own row is deleted.

The problem is meetups. `unlinkNeighbor` in `AppStore+Neighbors.swift:65-69` cancels every open meetup with that person. Open means `.waiting` or `.accepted` (`Models.swift:60`). It then calls `community.updateMeetup` for each one. The protocol comment at `Community.swift:28` says a cancellation notifies the other person directly ("取消直接通知对方"). The code comment at line 65 says the same thing: the other person is told the meetup was cancelled, just not why. So when there is an open meetup, the other person does get a notification, and the timing lets them guess they were unlinked.

The user is told otherwise in three places:
- The dialog at `Tabs.swift:584` opens with a flat "佢唔會收到通知" (he won't get a notification). Its later clause "同佢未完成嘅約會會取消" only says the meetups will be cancelled, not that he will be told.
- The spoken line at `AppStore+Neighbors.swift:72` always says "佢唔會收到通知", even right after a cancellation was sent.
- The button's accessibility hint at `Tabs.swift:724` says the same.

An older user will read this as "he won't hear anything at all". That breaks the honest-copy rule. It does not touch any settled decision: cancelling meetups on unlink is A's own design choice, not a fixed one.

Why the severity is low:
1. The literal F5 rule (no unlink notification) is met.
2. In the single-device demo `updateMeetup` sends nothing to anyone. It only cancels the simulated reply. The mismatch only matters once a real backend exists.
3. The dialog does at least mention that meetups will be cancelled.
4. It only applies when there is an open meetup with that person.
verdict.fix:
Change only the copy, based on whether there are open meetups with this person. Count them with `store.appointments.filter { $0.partnerID == r.id && $0.isOpen }.count`. This is about 15 minutes of work (size S).

(1) `Tabs.swift:584`: with no open meetups, keep the current text. With open meetups, change it to "佢唔會收到解除通知。之後佢出門你唔會知，佢亦見唔到你。你哋有 N 個未完成嘅約會會取消，佢會收到「約會取消」。想再做街坊，要見面再碰一碰。"

(2) `AppStore+Neighbors.swift:72`: in the cancel loop, count how many meetups were cancelled. If none, keep the current spoken line. Otherwise speak "已經同\(name)解除街坊，佢唔會收到解除通知；N 個約會已經取消，佢會收到約會取消。"

(3) `Tabs.swift:724`: change the accessibility hint to "佢唔會收到解除通知".

No logic changes are needed.

confirmed.title: 每次启动都会取一次定位，不只在散步时
confirmed.evidence: CLLocationManager 创建后，系统会立即回调 locationManagerDidChangeAuthorization。已授权时，这个回调无条件调用 requestLocation()，所以每次启动都会取一次定位；即使 loadMap 用的是已保存的 homeTile，也没有任何地方在等这个结果。
confirmed.rule: F1：只在步行时开启定位；README 隐私说明
confirmed.fix: 回调里只在 locationContinuation != nil 时才调用 requestLocation。

verdict.reason:
The report is correct. AppStore.swift:19 creates `MapService()` as a stored property, so MapService's `CLLocationManager` is created every time AppStore starts up. Since iOS 14, Apple calls `locationManagerDidChangeAuthorization` as soon as a manager is created. In MapService.swift:44-46 that callback calls `m.requestLocation()` whenever permission is `.authorizedWhenInUse` or `.authorizedAlways`, without checking whether anything is waiting for a fix.

After onboarding, `loadMap` (AppStore+Map.swift:15-20) reads the saved `homeTile` and skips `currentLocation()`. So `locationContinuation` is nil, and the fix that `didUpdateLocations` returns goes to `finishLocation`, which does nothing with it. The result: on a real phone, every launch after onboarding turns location on once (the location arrow appears and the system's App Privacy Report logs an access), and the fix is thrown away.

This breaks the spec line in F1 ("只在步行時開啟定位", spec line 39) and contradicts docs/prototype_status.md:14 ("只在步行时开定位"). The location is not stored or sent anywhere, so this is not a data leak. That is why severity is low.

The settled decisions do not cover this. The onboarding step that locates the user still needs location, and it would keep working after the fix: `currentLocation()` sets the continuation before it asks for permission, so the callback that follows permission being granted would still find a caller waiting.
verdict.fix: In MapService.swift:46, only call `requestLocation()` when a caller is waiting for a result: `case .authorizedAlways, .authorizedWhenInUse: if self.locationContinuation != nil { m.requestLocation() }`. This is a one-line change (size S). Onboarding is unaffected because `currentLocation()` sets `locationContinuation` before it calls `requestWhenInUseAuthorization`/`requestLocation`.

confirmed.title: 定位跳动或旧的缓存定位点会生成 1 分钟的假散步，并计入连续天数
confirmed.evidence: 定位只按精度过滤，不看 CLLocation.timestamp。开定位后系统先给的旧缓存点，或在屋企楼内跳到 60 m 外的点，都能开始一次散步；下一个点回到家附近又立即收尾。finishWalk 用 max(minutes, 1) 记 1 分钟、walks 加 1，连续天数照样计算。
confirmed.rule: F1；排行榜要公平
confirmed.fix: 丢弃 timestamp 早于 10 秒前的定位点。不足 3 分钟或轨迹不足 100 m 的不记纪录，只做隐身处理。

verdict.reason:
I checked this against the code and it holds up.

1. **No timestamp check.** WalkDetector.swift:106-116 only filters on horizontalAccuracy (0–100 m). It never looks at CLLocation.timestamp. Apple warns that the first point after startUpdatingLocation may be an old cached fix, so a stale point can get through.

2. **One point is enough to start a walk.** AppStore+Walk.swift:162-166 starts recording on a single fix when acc ≤ 30, the point is inside the base, and it is more than 55 m from home. There is no debounce and no second confirming fix. beginWalk then says 「偵測到你出咗門」 and calls publishOuting.

3. **Location stays on after a walk ends.** finishWalk → walkDetector.reset() does not call setLocating(false). Location only turns off when Core Motion next reports stationary. So while the user is still moving around at home or in the lobby, every new fix can trigger a walk. In high-rise buildings a point can land more than 55 m away while reporting accuracy of 30 m or better.

4. **The next point ends it at once.** A point back near home passes the relaxed check at line 159 (fromHome - acc < 40). finishLiveWalk at lines 132-135 gives minutes = 0. finishWalk at line 103 records max(0,1) = 1 minute and walks += 1. LocalStore.streak (LocalStore.swift:56) counts any day with walks > 0, so that day joins the streak, which is the F4 ranking basis. It also adds to the monthly walk count and step count. The app then says 「今日行咗 1 分鐘」.

Spec F1 says a walk is recorded when walking is detected. A single location jump is not walking, so this is a wrong record, and it changes the streak the leaderboard ranks by.

It does not conflict with any decided rule. The style-over-realism decision covers visuals and shade, not walk records. The real-device detection exists in the code even though it is outside the demo.

Why the severity is low:
- It only happens on a real device with demo mode off. The simulator and demo paths are not affected.
- Getting a fake streak day still needs Core Motion to report walking at home.
- publishOuting is an empty function in the local community service (Community.swift:98), so no neighbour actually gets a false alert today. With a real backend it would send one.
- "排行榜要公平" (the leaderboard should be fair) is not written in the spec. The basis here is F1 accuracy and the integrity of the F4 streak.
verdict.fix:
Effort: S.
1. In WalkDetector.swift:108, also filter out stale points: `abs($0.timestamp.timeIntervalSinceNow) < 10`.
2. In AppStore+Walk.swift:162, before starting a walk, require two fixes in a row (at least 5–10 s apart) that both pass acc ≤ 30 and fromHome > 55 m. Store the first one as a pending start point. This stops a single jump from saying 「出咗門」 and calling publishOuting.
3. In finishWalk, for a real-device walk (live == true) that is under about 2 minutes and whose pathLength(trail) is under about 100 m: skip recordWalk and only go invisible (publishOuting(nil), reset the scene). Use a different spoken line, or say nothing, instead of 「今日行咗 1 分鐘」.
4. Optionally, call walkDetector.setLocating(false) when a walk ends, so location does not keep running at home.

confirmed.title: 演示散步中退到后台再回来，会一次记几百「分钟」
confirmed.evidence: tick 用两次调用之间的实际时间 dt，minutes 等于从开始到现在的秒数。退到后台 10 分钟后回来，walk.minutes 变成 600，随即走完路线，recordWalk 记下 600 分钟，月步数多出 6 万，圈对圈的数字大跳。
confirmed.rule: 数据要合理
confirmed.fix: dt 限制在 0.5 秒以内；minutes 改为按累计的 dt 计算。

verdict.reason: The bug is real; I confirmed it in the code. In startTicker (ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Walk.swift:49-61), the Task measures dt as the actual time between two passes of its loop, and nothing caps it. When the app goes to the background, the only handler is appActive(false) (Store/AppStore+Services.swift:6-15). It stops hko and walkDetector but never cancels or pauses the ticker, and no other code watches the app going to the background. Once iOS suspends the app, the Task stops too, so the first tick after returning gets the whole time spent in the background as dt. tickWalk (line 71) then adds dt*9 metres to travelled, which jumps past the end of the route, and line 82 calls finishWalk right away. Line 73 sets minutes to the real seconds since the walk started (in the demo, 1 second counts as 1 minute). So 10 minutes in the background gives about 600 minutes. recordWalk (Persist.swift:154) adds that to the day's minutes. myMonthSteps (minutes*100) goes up by about 60,000. The ranking and other figures jump. The app also speaks the line at line 108: "今日行咗 600 分鐘". A short screen lock during a live demo is enough to trigger it. The 18-minute pacing tip at line 77 is also skipped. This does not conflict with any settled decision. It only affects the simulated walk (simulated: true). Real-device walks get their minutes from the last location fix (lines 131-134). So severity is low.
verdict.fix: Two changes, both small. (1) In startTicker, cap dt before calling tick: `let dt = min(Date().timeIntervalSince(last), 0.5)`. This also stops find from jumping. (2) In tickWalk line 73, base minutes on simulated time, not wall-clock time: `w.minutes = Int(w.travelled / Self.walkSpeed)`. travelled already equals the summed dt times walkSpeed, so no new field is needed. Optionally, also cancel the ticker in appActive(false) and call startTicker() again on return if walk or find is still set.

confirmed.title: 退到后台时不立即存盘
confirmed.evidence: 只有 0.5 秒的延迟保存。接受邀请或请假后马上上滑关掉 App，最后一次改动会丢失。
confirmed.rule: 本机数据保存要可靠
confirmed.fix: 在 appActive(false) 里先 saveTask?.cancel()，再调用 saveNow()。

verdict.reason:
The gap is real, but it seldom causes data loss. All persisted state is written only through scheduleSave(), which waits 0.5 s and then writes (AppStore+Persist.swift:26-34). This covers appointments, reports, walkLog, leaveDays and landmarkNames, which all call didSet→scheduleSave at AppStore.swift:55-72, plus savedNeighbors and the map key via storeLink, adoptMapKey and homeChanged. Nothing writes immediately when the app leaves the foreground. appActive(false) at AppStore+Services.swift:6-15 only stops the weather refresh and the walk detector, and StreetWalkApp.swift:13 calls it only on .background. The only places that call saveNow() directly are clearAllData() and DemoScript step 62.

How often this loses data in practice: iOS normally keeps a backgrounded app running for a few seconds, so the 0.5 s task usually finishes. Even if the app is suspended first, the task resumes and saves when the app returns to the foreground. Data is lost only if the app is suspended within 0.5 s and then killed before it comes back. That is rare, but it can happen. The trigger is the one in the report: the user taps 好 to accept an invite, or takes a leave day, and immediately swipes home; the system later reclaims memory. The leave day or appointment is then gone the next day.

On the rule: the spec has no line that literally says local saving must be reliable. But prototype_status.md:20 says the whole appointment flow is "全部存盘" (all saved to disk), and README.md:39 lists LocalStore as local persistence, so the docs promise this. Writing pending changes when the app goes to the background is also standard iOS practice. None of the agreed decisions conflicts with this.

One limit of the proposed fix: a force-quit from the app switcher passes through .inactive, and StreetWalkApp.swift:13 deliberately ignores .inactive. A flush in the .background branch alone does not cover that path. That scenario requires killing the app within 0.5 s, so it is very rare, and adding a flush on .inactive as well is optional.
verdict.fix: In the else branch of appActive(_:) in ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Services.swift, add `saveTask?.cancel(); saveNow()` as the first line. That makes it `} else { saveTask?.cancel(); saveNow(); hko.keepFresh(false) {}; walkDetector.stop() }`. Optional: to also cover a force-quit from the app switcher, have StreetWalkApp.swift:13 call `store.saveTask?.cancel(); store.saveNow()` on .inactive as well, without calling appActive. The JSON write is small, so writing on Control Center or an incoming call costs almost nothing. Effort: S (2 lines).

confirmed.title: 聆听中来了提醒或横幅会播报，打断语音识别
confirmed.evidence: 发出邀请 4 秒后对方回覆，或者 30 秒时钟触发提醒、过期提示，都会调用 speaker.speak。Speaker 会把 AVAudioSession 切回 .playback，正在录音的 AVAudioEngine 因此被打断，用户讲到一半识别就停了。
confirmed.rule: 以语音为主的流程要可靠
confirmed.fix: A 侧在 listening 为真时，把要播的句子排队，等停咪后再播；横幅照常显示。

verdict.reason:
The report is right. Only the line numbers are slightly off: the code is at AppStore.swift:160-167 (toast), AppStore+Meetup.swift:177-193 (partnerAnswered) and 239-254 (checkAppointments).

**What the code does**
- `Speaker.speak` (Voice/Speech.swift:12-16) always switches the audio session to `.playback` / `.spokenAudio`. It checks nothing first.
- `Listener.start` (Speech.swift:48-63) records with `.playAndRecord` and an `AVAudioEngine` input tap. The tap only stops when the user presses the mic again: `micTapped` → `stopListening`.
- Nothing in A's Store checks `listening` before calling `speaker.speak`.

**What can call `speak` while the mic is on**
- **Invite reply.** About 3 s after a proposal or change, `LocalCommunityService.answerLater` (Community.swift:113-122) fires. `partnerAnswered` then shows a banner and speaks (Meetup.swift:184-185 and 190-191).
- **30 s clock.** `startClock` runs `checkAppointments`, which speaks the reminder (Meetup.swift:247-248). It also sends the expiry notice through `toast`, which speaks (AppStore.swift:162).
- **Others:** `invitedBy`, `reportFollowedUp`, and during a walk the pace tip (Walk.swift:79) and the arrive-home line in `finishWalk` (Walk.swift:108).

**Why this breaks recognition**
- When `.playback` is set while the engine is running, the session loses its input. The audio hardware changes, so `AVAudioEngine` stops itself and the recognition request gets no more audio. What the user says after that is lost.
- Even if the engine kept running, the mic is in `.measurement` mode (no echo cancellation) with `.defaultToSpeaker`. It would record the speech being played and mix it into `transcript`.
- Either way, when the user presses stop, `handle(text)` parses a cut-off or polluted sentence.

**Why this is not covered by a settled decision**
- No decision covers when spoken prompts may play. Queuing them would not change "every voice action has a button" or "repeat back, then press 好".
- It does hurt the voice-first flow in §4 ("以语音和图像为主").
- Deferring the speech still satisfies "所有提示同时有语音和图像": the banner shows at once and the voice plays later.

**Why severity is low**
- The time the mic is on is short, usually a few seconds.
- Anything that affects other people still needs the repeat-back card and a 「好」 press, so a wrong parse cannot act on its own.
- The user can retry or use the phrase picker.
- There is no crash or privacy impact.

I did not run it on a device, but the code path is clear.
verdict.fix:
Make the change only on A's side, without touching Voice/:

1. In AppStore, add `var deferredSpeech: [String] = []` and a wrapper:
   `func say(_ s: String) { if listening { deferredSpeech.append(s) } else { speaker.speak(s) } }`
2. Switch these to `say`: the event-driven calls in `toast` (AppStore.swift:162), `partnerAnswered` / `invitedBy` / `checkAppointments` (AppStore+Meetup.swift:185, 191, 212, 248), `reportFollowedUp` (Places:77), and the walk calls (Walk:79, 108). Banners and haptics stay as they are.
3. In `stopListening()` and `handle()`, once `listening = false`, flush the queue.
   - If `handle` produced no spoken reply of its own, speak the queued lines joined into one string.
   - Otherwise, speak them after that reply. `Speaker.speak` calls `stopSpeaking(.immediate)`, which would cut off the earlier reply, so play the queued lines 2–3 s later, or keep only the newest line.

Effort: S, about 20 lines.

confirmed.title: 散步中碰一碰成功时，场景里的「我」会瞬移回屋企
confirmed.evidence: syncScene 的散步分支已经加入 id 为 me 的人物，碰一碰的 .found 分支又加一个站在屋企门口的 me。setPeople 用后者覆盖前者，人物从路上跳回屋企，镜头也飞去屋企；createNeighbor 之后再从屋企沿剩下的路线走。而散步途中碰面正是碰一碰最主要的场景。
confirmed.rule: 画面和状态要一致
confirmed.fix: walk 不为 nil 时，碰一碰分支用 myPosition() 作为站位，并且不重复加入 me。

verdict.reason:
The report holds up in the code. syncScene (ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Map.swift:147-163) does nothing to stop "me" from being added twice. During a walk with no find in progress (walk != nil, find == nil), line 150 adds "me" with .route(remainingRoute(w)). When bumpStage is .found, lines 159-162 add a second "me" standing at the home door, scene.nearestWalkable(homeTarget + (0,-18)) + (-4,0). DioramaController.setPeople (Scene/DioramaController.swift:568-585) loops over the list in order. The second "me" has a different motion, so apply(.stand) runs a 0.4 s move to the home door, replacing the walking action. On screen the walker slides from the street back to the door almost at once. startBump (Store/AppStore+Neighbors.swift:15) also flies the camera explicitly to homeTarget + (0,-18), and followID stays "me", so the camera stays at home.

Nothing stops this flow during a walk. MainTabBar is always on screen, the 街坊 tab's 碰一碰 button only checks bumpStage == .idle (UI/Tabs.swift:524), and startWalk/beginWalk lock nothing. Meanwhile the demo ticker keeps calling tickWalk, which advances w.travelled and redraws the trail (setTrail) ahead of the figure, which is no longer moving along the route. On a real device, every liveStep syncScene keeps "me" pinned at home. After createNeighbor, syncScene sends .route(remainingRoute) again. walk(pts, from: node) starts from the node's current spot at the door and heads straight to the current route point, likely cutting through buildings, before carrying on with the rest of the route. The scene and the walk state disagree the whole time.

This does not conflict with any settled decision. The layout sketch itself describes the bump as the two figures walking up to each other and waving in the scene. "Only scenery, no interaction" and "art style over realism" do not cover the user's own figure jumping away from where they are walking.

Severity is low. None of the scripted demos (script/script2) runs a bump during a walk, so it only happens when someone switches to 街坊 mid-walk and taps 碰一碰. It is purely visual: no crash, no data error, no privacy leak.
verdict.fix: In the .found branch of syncScene, choose where the two figures stand: `let spot = (walk != nil && find == nil) ? myPosition() : scene.nearestWalkable(scene.homeTarget + Vec2(x: 0, y: -18))`. Before adding the bump pair, call `people.removeAll { $0.id == "me" }`, then add me at spot + (-4,0) and the partner at spot + (4,0). Make the camera in startBump (AppStore+Neighbors.swift:15) target that same spot instead of homeTarget + (0,-18). Optionally, skip resetCamera in createNeighbor while a walk is in progress so followID can keep tracking. Effort S (about 10 lines).

confirmed.title: 改楼流程一开始就不能取消；从楼层页返回选楼时，场景状态不对
confirmed.evidence: beginChangeHome 进入定位和选楼两步，都没有返回或取消（canGoBack 只对楼层、小人两步生效）。人在外面时，只能在当前位置附近选一座楼，或者杀掉 App。在楼层页按「返上一步」回到选楼时，场景已是收窄后的 200 m 底座，住宅楼的高亮也已关掉，提示却仍写「住宅樓已經亮咗橙色」，远一点的楼也选不到。
confirmed.rule: 流程要能退出；文字要和画面一致
confirmed.fix: 改楼时在定位、选楼两步加「唔改喇」，恢复原来的屋企并重新 installDiorama。返回选楼时重新 install(pickView)，并调用 highlightResidential(true)。

verdict.reason:
两半都在代码里查实了，和已定的决定不冲突。
(1) 改楼不能退出：Settings.swift:79 有一个「改我住嘅樓？」确认框。按「揀過座樓」后，beginChangeHome（Settings.swift:140-145）会把 phase 设为 .onboarding(.locate)，再调用 loadMap(home:nil)。在 onboarding 阶段，loadMap 不读 homeTile，改用 currentLocation（AppStore+Map.swift:15-21），所以人在外面时，加载的是当前位置那一格地图。Onboarding.swift:66 的 canGoBack 只对 .floor 和 .avatar 生效，整个流程没有任何取消入口。用户只能随便选一座楼走完流程（finishOnboarding 会写入新 homeTile，并调用 homeChanged，把约会地点和反映位置清掉），或者杀掉 App（UserDefaults 里旧的屋企还在，重开会恢复）。长者用户不容易想到杀 App。规格原文里没有"流程必须可退出"的条文，所以判 low。
(2) 返回选楼时场景状态不对：confirmHome 先调 highlightResidential(false)，再调 installDiorama(home:id)，换成 simplified 的 200 m 底座，最多只有 6 座楼（MapModel.swift:100-101,155-160），镜头也换成主界面的总览镜头。goBack（Onboarding.swift:50-53）只改了 phase。所以回到选楼页后，看到的是收窄后的底座，只有刚才选的那座楼是 homeMat 淡橙色，其他住宅楼都没有高亮。可是 OnbPickHomeStep 的提示（Onboarding.swift:313）仍写「住宅樓已經亮咗橙色」，文字和画面不一致。往回走一般是因为选错了楼，但原来 pickView 里 300 m、10 座住宅楼的候选里，有些已经不在场景中，正确的楼可能根本点不到。另外，第一次使用时同样有这个回退问题，不只是改楼时才有。
两处都不会崩溃，也不涉及隐私，所以严重程度是 low。
verdict.fix:
工作量 S。
(a) 在 AppStore 加 changingHome 标志，beginChangeHome 里设为 true。改楼时，OnboardingFlow.topBar 在 .locate 和 .pickHome 两步显示「唔改喇」（floor 和 avatar 两步最好也加）。按下后：phase = .main；pendingHome = nil；floorChoice、mobilityChoice、colorChoice 从 UserDefaults 读回；然后 Task { await loadMap(home: 已存的 homeBuilding, animated: true) }，因为 .main 阶段会用已存的 homeTile 重新 installDiorama 并 populate；最后 scene.resetCamera()，changingHome = false。finishOnboarding 里也要把 changingHome 清掉。
(b) 在 loadMap 的 onboarding 分支，把 pickView 的结果缓存为 pickModel。再加一个 backToPickHome()：先 install(pickModel, home: nil)，再按 loadMap 第 33-34 行设定全屏镜头，然后 highlightResidential(true)。如果 pendingHome 仍在 pickModel 里，就调 scene.highlightBuildings([id], color: nil)。goBack 在从 .floor 退回时调用这个函数，不再只改 phase。

confirmed.title: F9 天气提示拼成两三句；只因降雨概率「中高」就叫人「等雨停先」
confirmed.evidence: 实时模式下，提示是 r.line（「天文台話打鼓嶺而家 29 度。」）加上 rest；酷热时 rest 来自模板，合起来是「…29 度。今日好熱。X 下晝 3 點後有樓遮住，嗰陣先出門啱啲。」共三句。只因今日降雨概率「中高」就判为 rain 时，提示是「今日降雨機會中高。唔好勉強出門，等雨停先。」，但当时还没下雨。
confirmed.rule: F9：每次提示不超过一句话
confirmed.fix: 合成一句，把来源和读数并入建议，例如「天文台話而家 29 度，皇后山總站 3 點後有樓遮，嗰陣先出門啱啲」。rain 分「落緊雨」和「可能落雨」两种说法。

verdict.reason:
This is real. F9 in the spec (docs/产品定稿_康乐社交App_v1.0.md:106) says plainly that each tip is at most one sentence. None of the agreed decisions covers how weather tips are worded, so nothing here conflicts with them. The code produces two or more sentences in every case.

1) Live mode, ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Places.swift:141-144. The tip is built as `r.line + rest`. `HKOReport.line` (Services/HKOWeather.swift:40-47) always ends with "。", and `rest` is another full sentence. Screenshot s1_34.png confirms this: "天文台話打鼓嶺而家 29 度。皇后山總站夜晚 6 點後有樓遮住…", which is two sentences. When it is hot, the `.hot` template (AI/TemplateAI.swift:145, owned by B) is itself "今日好熱。X…後有樓遮住，嗰陣先出門啱啲。". The live tip then becomes three sentences, for example "天文台話打鼓嶺而家 34 度，酷熱天氣警告生效。今日好熱。…". There is also no gap between the hot verdict and the reading: `isHot` (HKOWeather.swift:23-26) is true when today's forecast high is 33 or more, even if the current reading is 29 度.

2) Demo mode (script step 79 and the setWeather banner). Screenshot s1_82.png shows "今日好熱。皇后山總站夜晚 6 點後有樓遮住，嗰陣先出門啱啲。", which is two sentences, and it is also spoken aloud.

3) Rain wording. `isRain` (HKOWeather.swift:29-32) is true when today's rain chance (`todayPSR`) is 「中高」 or 「高」. `rest` (AppStore+Places.swift:141-143) then says "唔好勉強出門，等雨停先。" even when no rain is falling. The line before it does say "今日降雨機會中高", so this is a small wording inaccuracy, not a serious honesty problem.

The live card in Tabs.swift has no line limit, so the extra sentences only make the tip longer. Nothing gets cut off. That keeps the severity low.
verdict.fix:
Small change (S), made only inside AppStore+Places.swift:refreshWeatherTip.

(a) Join the parts with "，" instead of a full stop: `let body = rest.replacingOccurrences(of: "。", with: "，")`, then drop body's trailing "，" and add "。". Then `let tip = r.line.isEmpty ? body : String(r.line.dropLast()) + "，" + body`. In live mode, if `walkWarnings` already names 酷熱, drop the "今日好熱，" prefix so it is not said twice.

(b) For rain, check whether it is raining now: `rainMM >= 0.5`, rain icon 63–65, or a WRAIN/WTS warning. If it is, keep "等雨停先". If rain is only forecast (`todayPSR` 中高/高), say something like "可能會落雨，出門帶遮，或者聽日先行".

(c) Apply the same joining to the tip in the demo-override branch (shown in the banner and spoken). Also ask B to change TemplateAI.swift:145 from "今日好熱。" to "今日好熱，".

The existing selftest checks on `HKOReport.line` (tools/selftest/main.swift:125-136) are unaffected. Add one check that the final tip contains only one "。".

confirmed.title: 下午和晚上也写「今朝 N 人經過」，示範人数还可能低于 10 人门槛
confirmed.evidence: quietCard 不论几点都写「今朝 N 人經過…」，用 -hour 15 启动，下午仍显示「今朝 13 人經過大樹底」，而这个数字的含义是今日全天。示範人数是 9 加 seed 对 9 取余，最低会出现 9 人，低于产品其他地方「人数 ≥10 才出汇总」的门槛。
confirmed.rule: 文案准确；F10 人数 ≥10 原则
confirmed.fix: 改为「今日」（或按时段区分）；人数低于 10 时不显示数字。

verdict.reason:
This is only partly real. The headcount half holds up as a small consistency bug. The "今朝" half is weak.

1) Headcount below 10 (holds, minor). `passersToday` at ios/StreetWalk/Store/Community.swift:145-148 returns `9 + seed(landmark.id) % 9`, so the range is 9 to 17. The number depends on the id of the first landmark (`store.landmarks.first`). Landmark ids are built from live OSM data around the user (MapService.swift:65-73; LandmarkDeriver ids such as "bus-…" and "bench-…"). So roughly 1 estate in 9 will show "今朝 9 人經過…". The default demo map gives 13, which is why the screenshot looks fine. Showing 9 breaks the app's own interface promise: the protocol comment at Community.swift:38 says the anonymous summary gives "只出地标级、人数够多的数字". It also does not match the ≥10 line used elsewhere: spec F10 line 113, README.md:55, prototype_status F10, and `TemplateAI.minReporters = 10`. The spec's ≥10 rule is written for the F10 monthly report, and this number is labelled 示範 and made up, so no real privacy leak happens. That makes it a low-severity consistency problem, not a privacy violation.

2) "今朝" in the afternoon or evening (weak, not counted). The wording comes straight from the user's chosen layout sketch (docs/design/layout_sketch.html:99, `lab(44,138,'今朝 12 人經過')`). The number is a fixed demo value with a 示範 label. Reading "今朝 13 人經過" at 3 pm or 9 pm as "this morning 13 people passed" is not false. Only the function name `passersToday` hints at a whole-day count. This is a wording preference, not an obvious copy error. Changing it is optional and should not be the reason for the finding.

Whether the change is worth making depends on point 1.
verdict.fix: Minimal change: at ios/StreetWalk/Store/Community.swift:147, change `9 + seed(landmark.id) % 9` to `10 + seed(landmark.id) % 9`, giving a range of 10 to 18 that matches the "人数够多" promise and the ≥10 line. Optionally, add `count >= 10` as a fallback check in quietCard (Tabs.swift:67) so a future real CommunityService can't show a number below 10. "今朝" can stay because it is the sketch's wording. If you do change it, make it depend on the time: use "今朝" before 12:00 and "今日" after. Effort: S, under 5 minutes.

confirmed.title: 改地标名后，每日一句还在用旧名
confirmed.evidence: script3 把「皇后山總站」改成「大樹底」后，今日卡和排行榜「我那行」仍显示「12 樓喺皇后山總站坐咗陣」，同一屏旁边已经写着「今朝 13 人經過大樹底」，要重启才更新。
confirmed.rule: F3：改名后全产品统一用新名
confirmed.fix: rename() 之后调用 refreshMe()，并重新计算其他居民的 todayLine。

verdict.reason: The bug is real. In ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Places.swift:21-30, rename() updates landmarks[i].name, landmarkNames, community and the scene. It never regenerates Resident.todayLine. That field is a plain String built once, by ai.dailyLine (AI/TemplateAI.swift:76-83), which copies last.name into the sentence. Lines for other residents are built only in populate() (AppStore+Map.swift:117-121). My line is rebuilt only by refreshMe() (AppStore+Persist.swift:166-175) and markPassed (AppStore+Walk.swift:88-92), and rename calls neither. So after a rename, the Today card (UI/Tabs.swift:121-124), my row in the leaderboard (Tabs.swift:488-489), every other leaderboard row (Tabs.swift:444-445) and the resident card (Cards.swift:232-235) all keep the old name. The VoiceOver labels (Tabs.swift:467/472/508) read the old name too. The new name only appears after the next populate(), for example on relaunch. The screenshots confirm it. The script renames landmarks.first to 大樹底 at t=23 (DemoScript.swift:135). In s3_45 my leaderboard row still reads 12 樓喺皇后山總站坐咗陣. In s3_54 the Today card shows 今朝 13 人經過大樹底 above the AI line that still says 皇后山總站. This breaks F3, which says a rename applies to everyone in the circle, and the same screen shows two names for one place. It does not touch any settled decision. Severity is low: the text is only stale, nothing crashes, nothing leaks, and a relaunch fixes it.
verdict.fix: The smallest safe fix is in rename() at AppStore+Places.swift, after landmarks[i].name = name. Loop over the residents and replace the old name with the new one in each line: for j in residents.indices { residents[j].todayLine = residents[j].todayLine.replacingOccurrences(of: old, with: name) }. This updates me and every demo resident at once. It also keeps a line made by markPassed during a walk in progress; calling refreshMe() would overwrite that line with the day log, which does not yet include the current walk. A cleaner version has two steps. First, move the per-resident line loop in populate() (AppStore+Map.swift:118-121) into a helper, refreshDailyLines(). Second, call that helper from rename(), and rebuild my own line from walk?.passed when a walk is in progress, or with refreshMe() otherwise. Effort is S, about 3 to 10 lines.

confirmed.title: 「揀一句」的改约建议写死成「改做下晝四點」
confirmed.evidence: 有约会时，建议句固定是「改做下晝四點」。陳太约你的时间本来就是「今日下晝 4 點」时也照样出现；照着按，会把对方的邀请改成同一时间的反提议。
confirmed.rule: 建议句应当有意义、能直接用
confirmed.fix: 用 candidateTimes 选一个和当前约会不同的钟点来生成这句话。

verdict.reason:
The report is accurate, and the actual impact is a bit worse than it says. ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Voice.swift:39 always returns the fixed phrase 「改做下晝四點」 whenever targetAppointment(partnerID: nil) finds an appointment. It never looks at a.date.

In the standard demo (-hour 10), the two usual ways an appointment gets made both land on 4 pm:
- proposeMeetup with no time uses candidateTimes(nil, nil) (AppStore+Meetup.swift:23-37). Its first option is 16:00 today, because 16 > nowH+1.
- partnerInvites (AppStore+Meetup.swift:201) sets h = 16 whenever the hour is before 15:00, so 陳太's invite is for 16:00 today.

So in the most common state, the first suggestion (which is also the 「講啦，例如…」 example in ListeningCard, UI/Overlays.swift:386) does nothing. Screenshot s2_15.png shows it listed first while an appointment with 陳太 exists.

What happens if the user taps it:
1. handle → .changeMeetup → changed() produces the same date. The card still says 「改約陳太：今日下晝4點… 會再問陳太確認」.
2. Pressing 「好」 calls confirmVoice → changeMeetup (AppStore+Meetup.swift:130-142). Unlike confirmProposal, which has the 「冇改到，照舊」 guard at :79, changeMeetup has no check for an unchanged result. It unconditionally sets status = .waiting and fromPartner = false and calls community.updateMeetup.
3. Result: an already-accepted meetup drops back to "waiting", or 陳太's invitation becomes my own counter-proposal for the same time.

This doesn't conflict with any settled decision. The voice and button flows, and the rule to repeat back and press 「好」, all stay as they are. Only the phrase content and the missing check are wrong. The scripted demo (script3 t=13) uses 「改做下晝五點」, so it avoids this, but a live tap on the first chip hits it. The repeat-back card does make a careful user less likely to confirm, so severity is low, not medium.
verdict.fix:
Small change (size S) in AppStore+Voice.swift:
1. In suggestedPhrases (line 39), pick a target hour different from the appointment's hour, for example `let h = Self.hk.component(.hour, from: a.date); let alt = h == 16 ? "五" : "四"`, and return `"改做下晝\(alt)點"`. Alternatively, take the first hour from candidateTimes(day: nil, hour: nil) whose date is more than 30 minutes away from a.date.
2. Add a no-op check in handle's .changeMeetup case (around line 76), after computing c: `if c.date == a.date && c.landmarkID == a.landmarkID { toast("時間地點都冇變，照舊。"); return }`. Optionally add the same check at the top of changeMeetup (AppStore+Meetup.swift:130), so an unchanged change never resets status to .waiting or turns 陳太's invitation into my counter-proposal.

confirmed.title: 步数是「分钟 × 100」估算的，圈对圈比的其实是分钟；真机的步频下降提示（F9）永远不会出现
confirmed.evidence: myMonthSteps = minutes × 100，所以「圈内总步数」实际是分钟数。真机明明有 CMPedometer 却没有使用。paceTip 只在模拟散步第 18 分钟固定弹出（tickWalk 只在非真机时运行），真机散步没有步频数据，F9「步频明显下降提示休息」永远不会出现。
confirmed.rule: F4：按月比拼圈内总步数；§7 walks.步数；F9
confirmed.fix: 真机用 CMPedometer 记录步数和 currentCadence，写进散步记录；步频比本次散步的中位数下降 30% 时调用 B 的提示。轮椅用户的比拼可以改按分钟计。

verdict.reason:
The report is half right. Its facts are accurate, but only one of its two claims is a real, undisclosed problem.

1) Step count is minutes × 100: true (AppStore+Persist.swift:142-146). But it is already disclosed. The F4 row of docs/prototype_status.md says "我的月步数按散步分钟估算", and the code comments at Tabs.swift:391 and Persist.swift:142 say the same. That makes it a documented prototype simplification, not a hidden defect. The only leftover issue: with demo mode off, the circle card (Tabs.swift:398) shows "本月 X圈 行咗 N 步" with no 「約」 marker, so the estimate reads like a measured count. That is a small honesty point.

2) The F9 pace-drop tip never fires on a real phone: true, and not disclosed. paceTip is only set in tickWalk at AppStore+Walk.swift:77-80, on the fixed condition w.minutes == 18, not on any cadence data. tick() at Walk.swift:65 only runs tickWalk when !walkDetector.recording. A real-phone walk starts through beginWalk, which never starts the ticker, and liveStep/liveMinutes never touch paceTip. WalkDetector.swift uses only CMMotionActivityManager and CLLocationManager. It never uses CMPedometer, and Contracts.swift has no cadence interface. So the spec F9 rule "散步中，如果步频明显下降，提示休息并告知最近的座位" has no real-phone path at all. The demo's "行慢咗少少" is just a timer at minute 18. docs/prototype_status.md lists neither under "真的" nor under "模拟/未做" that this tip is demo-only. docs/backend_supabase.md:11 even lists "步频" as data kept on the phone, but the code never collects it. Also, §7 walks.步数 is never recorded.

This does not conflict with any settled decision. Those decisions cover a single-phone demo, simulated residents, template AI and simulated bump, not a fake cadence trigger. F9 is B's feature in §6, but the sensor, the walk record and the paceTip code are all A's. Severity is low: it is a hackathon prototype, the step estimate is disclosed, and the gap only affects the real-phone path.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix (S, docs plus one line of copy):
(a) In the F9 row of docs/prototype_status.md, under 「模拟 / 未做」, add: 散步中「步頻下降→提示休息」只在演示散步第 18 分鐘固定出現；真機未接計步器，唔會觸發. Add the same item to 「未做 / 需要真机」.
(b) Change 「原始轨迹、步频」 in docs/backend_supabase.md:11 to say cadence is not collected yet.
(c) In Tabs.swift:398, prefix the step number with 「約」 when it comes from minutes (for example, use 「約 N 步」 for race.ourSteps).
Full fix (M), optional: add CMPedometer to WalkDetector.swift and call startUpdates(from: walk start) during a real-phone walk. Store numberOfSteps on the day's DayLog and use it in myMonthSteps, falling back to the minutes × 100 estimate when there is no step data. Track currentCadence; after 10 minutes, if it stays below 70% of this walk's median cadence for 2 minutes, set paceTip once (pointing to the nearest seat) and say it aloud once only. That matches F9's rule that an ignored tip is not repeated.

confirmed.title: 本机模型和后端文档的字段与 §7 不一致，也没有说明（walks、leaves、reports、users）
confirmed.evidence: §7 的 walks 有开始和结束时间、步数、当天一句；本机 DayLog 只按日汇总 minutes、walks、landmarks，backend 的 walks 只有 day 和 minutes，也没有步数，而 circle_race 是按总步数比拼。leaves 在规格里是开始和结束日期，文档写成 (user_id, day)。reports 在规格里有原话文字，Report 模型没有 rawText。users 缺「家附近范围」和「语言」（本机 homeRadius 写死 40 m）。landmarks 缺坐标（这是有意为之，但没说明），meetups 多了 expired。文档开头说字段「沿用规格 §7」，却只说明了 neighbors 改成一个方向一行这一处差异。
confirmed.rule: §7 数据表；§6：A 负责全部数据表；文档与规格一致，或列明差异
confirmed.fix: 本机加 WalkRecord(start, end, steps, landmarkIDs, stopovers, dailyLine)，DayLog 由它推算；Report 加 rawText。backend 文档开头列出「与 §7 的差异及理由」，walks 加 steps，leaves 改成起止日期。

verdict.reason:
Partly real, and only on the documentation side. The local-model half does not hold up.

What holds up, in docs/backend_supabase.md:
- Line 5 says 「表的字段沿用规格 §7」, but the SQL in lines 26-99 differs from §7 in several places, and only one difference is explained: the neighbors note at line 49 (one direction per row).
- walks (lines 66-73) has no start or end time and no steps; it is a per-day total (day, minutes, landmark_ids, daily_line). The report's wording 「只有 day 和 minutes」 is slightly off, since landmark_ids and daily_line are there.
- leaves (line 75) is (user_id, day), where §7 has a start date and an end date.
- users (lines 27-36) has no 家附近范围.
- landmarks (lines 38-44) has no coordinates.
- reports adds follow_up; meetups adds expired.
- There is also an internal contradiction: line 131 says circle_race(month) is 「圈内总步数」, and spec F4 (line 66) also compares circles by total steps, but no table in the doc stores steps. A Supabase build following this doc could not produce F4's comparison.

Why this is not a spec violation:
- §7 is labelled 「初稿，第 1 天两人一起确认」, so changing fields is allowed.
- Most of the changes are sound privacy choices that fit spec F1 and 「不显示坐标」: no coordinates or home range on the server, and per-day totals only. Line 20 (「服务器上没有任何坐标」) half-explains the landmarks change.
- The real problems are that the doc says the fields 「沿用 §7」, which is untrue, and that steps is missing while circle_race depends on it.

Where the report overreaches (the local model):
- LocalStore and Models are the single-device cache, not §7's server tables. Under the agreed single-device demo, DayLog's per-day totals plus leaveDays fully cover the current features: streak with leave, and month steps estimated from minutes, which docs/prototype_status.md:17 already states.
- Report needs no rawText: the classifying is done by B's templates, and nothing reads the raw text.
- The leave UI only toggles today, so per-day storage is equivalent to a date range.
- The homeRadius = 40 m constant at AppStore+Walk.swift:114 is a prototype constant. It does not violate the spec.
- So adding WalkRecord and rawText would be heavy work with no matching requirement. I rule that part not real.

A small related doc-vs-code mismatch:
- LocalStore.swift:4 says 「散步记录（含原始轨迹）只存在手机」, and backend_supabase.md:11 says 「原始轨迹、步频 | 只在手机（LocalStore）」.
- In fact LocalStore does not save the track at all: WalkSession.route lives only in memory, and DayLog's comment at LocalStore.swift:23 says 「不记轨迹」.
- This errs on the side of protecting privacy, but the wording is inaccurate.
verdict.fix:
Documentation only; no code change (effort S).
1. In docs/backend_supabase.md, change line 5 to 「表以规格 §7 初稿为底，差异如下」, followed by a short list of the differences and why:
   - walks is one row per person per day (privacy: per-day totals only, no start or end times).
   - leaves is stored one row per day, which equals a start-to-end range.
   - landmarks and users have no coordinates and no 家附近范围; these stay on the phone, and the server has no coordinates.
   - reports adds follow_up, for the F10 replies.
   - meetups adds expired.
   - neighbors is one direction per row (already explained at line 49).
2. Add `steps int not null default 0` to the walks table, so that circle_race(month) on line 131 has data to add up.
3. Optional: change backend_supabase.md:11 to 「原始轨迹：只在散步期间留在手机内存，不存盘」, and LocalStore.swift:4 to 「散步只存每日汇总，不存轨迹」, so the docs match the code.
Do not add WalkRecord or Report.rawText to the local model.

confirmed.title: 多处 VoiceOver 标签有误或有歧义
confirmed.evidence: 设置页的颜色圆点读作「顏色 1…7」，首次使用的同一组颜色却读「綠色、紫色…」，前后不一致，读屏用户也不知道选的是什么颜色。排行行的标签读出来是「第 1，3 樓」，名次和楼层容易混淆。场景里自己的名牌文字是「你」，读出来却是「街坊：你」。场景上的反映标记都是用户自己的反映（scene.reportMarks = reports），却读成「街坊反映：好曬」。自绘的标签栏没有 tab bar 特征，VoiceOver 不会说「第 1 個，共 3 個」。
confirmed.rule: 读屏标签要准确、一致
confirmed.fix: 把 colorName 提到共用位置，设置页也用它。排行行改读「第 N 名，…」。.person 且 id 为 me 时读「你」。反映标记读「你嘅反映：好曬」。标签栏外层加 .accessibilityElement(children: .contain) 和 .accessibilityAddTraits(.isTabBar)。

verdict.reason:
I checked every item against the code. All five are real, and none conflicts with the settled decisions. The settled "view-only scene" decision does not apply, because the overlay labels are not hidden from VoiceOver and the scene labels are still read aloud.
(1) The settings colour row in UI/Settings.swift:100 reads "顏色 \(i + 1)", which does not say the actual colour. The same palette in UI/Onboarding.swift:487-490 and 613 reads real names such as 綠色 and 紫色. The order of that name list matches Palette.people in Domain/Models.swift:32-40.
(2) The ranking labels in UI/Tabs.swift:467 and 472 are "第 \(rank)，\(r.listName)…". listName in Domain/Models.swift:26 is "\(floor) 樓 \(name)", so VoiceOver reads something like "第 1，3 樓 陳太", where the rank and the floor run together. The user's own row at line 508 uses "你排第 N" and is correct.
(3) Store/AppStore+Map.swift:148, 151 and 159 give the user's own figure the label "你". DioramaController:710 turns every person into kind .person, and Overlays.swift:159 then reads it as "街坊：你".
(4) Every entry in the reports array comes from the user's own report() call in AppStore+Places.swift:39. AppStore+Map.swift:171 puts the whole array into reportMarks, and Overlays.swift:162 reads each one as "街坊反映：…". Since 街坊 can include the user, this is only mildly misleading.
(5) MainTabBar in UI/MainView.swift:417-468 is a custom HStack of buttons. Searching the whole codebase finds no .isTabBar, so VoiceOver does not announce it as a tab bar or give the "1 of 3" position.
The spec has no explicit VoiceOver requirement, but the target users are older people and prototype_status.md treats screen-reader order as in scope. Each item is a small text or trait problem that does not block any function, so the severity is low.
verdict.fix: (1) Move colorName into a shared place, such as a static Palette.name(_:) in Domain/Models.swift, and use it for the accessibilityLabel in both Settings.swift:100 and Onboarding. (2) In Tabs.swift:467 and 472, change the label to "第 \(rank) 名，\(r.listName)，\(r.todayLine)". (3) In the .person case of accessibilityText in Overlays.swift:159, read "你" when the item id is "p:me", and keep "街坊：\(text)" otherwise. (4) In Overlays.swift:162, change the label to "你嘅反映：\(item.text)". (5) After the HStack in MainView.swift's MainTabBar, add .accessibilityElement(children: .contain) and .accessibilityAddTraits(.isTabBar). Total effort is small, about 10 lines.

confirmed.title: App 自己的语音播报会和 VoiceOver 撞在一起，连续播报也会互相打断
confirmed.evidence: Speaker.speak 每次先 stopSpeaking(at: .immediate)，再用 AVSpeechSynthesizer 直接播，不判断 isVoiceOverRunning，也没设 prefersAssistiveTechnologySettings。例如同意页一出现，VoiceOver 读标题「歡迎嚟到街坊行」的同时，App 也在读同意说明，两路声音重叠。前一条提示还没讲完就被下一条截断，比如碰一碰成功后紧接着问开不开提醒。
confirmed.rule: §4：以语音为主；与读屏兼容
confirmed.fix: VoiceOver 开着时改为发 AccessibilityNotification.Announcement，或者设 utterance.prefersAssistiveTechnologySettings = true，并等 VoiceOver 读完再播（监听 UIAccessibility.announcementDidFinishNotification）。非紧急提示改为排队，不打断。Speaker 归 B，A 侧提出需求。

verdict.reason:
Half of this report holds up and half doesn't.

What holds up: there is no VoiceOver handling anywhere in the code. A grep for isVoiceOverRunning, prefersAssistiveTechnologySettings, AccessibilityNotification and announcement finds nothing.
