Speaker.speak (Voice/Speech.swift:12-22) always speaks straight through AVSpeechSynthesizer. Onboarding.swift:202-205 calls speak() in onAppear on the consent page. When VoiceOver is on, it moves focus to the first element and starts reading it while the app's synthesizer reads the consent text at the same time, so the two voices overlap. The other onAppear calls (Onboarding.swift:300/434/522, FullScreen.swift:48) and every speak() fired by toasts and banners do the same thing. This doesn't conflict with any of the agreed decisions. The UI clearly means to support VoiceOver (accessibilityElement/accessibilityHidden throughout, and prototype_status.md:24 mentions screen-reader reading order), and the overlap breaks that. It is a real accessibility defect.

What doesn't hold up:
(1) The quoted rule "与读屏兼容" (compatible with screen readers) is not in §4 of the spec. §4 only says "以语音和图像为主" (voice and images first) and "所有提示同时有语音和图像" (every prompt has both voice and an image). So this is a general accessibility defect, not a breach of a spec clause.
(2) The interruption example is wrong. After a bump, RemindPrompt (Cards.swift:283-) asks about reminders only as text and never calls speak(). The "你同…而家係街坊" line (Neighbors.swift:13) plays alone, and the card only appears 2.6 seconds later. Cutting off stale speech when a new event arrives (stopSpeaking .immediate) is a reasonable design choice. Only rare cases like several items firing in one pass of checkAppointments cut each other off, which is not enough to count as a defect.
(3) The suggested prefersAssistiveTechnologySettings only makes the utterance use VoiceOver's voice and speed settings. It does not stop the overlap.

Severity: low. It only affects VoiceOver users; the demo is unaffected and nothing crashes.
verdict.fix: Minimal fix in Speaker.speak (Voice/Speech.swift, owned by B; A files the request). Keep setting lastSpoken. If UIAccessibility.isVoiceOverRunning, skip the synthesizer and post the text as a VoiceOver announcement instead: build an AttributedString with accessibilitySpeechLanguage = "zh-HK" and accessibilitySpeechAnnouncementPriority = .low (queued, so it doesn't cut off what VoiceOver is reading), then call AccessibilityNotification.Announcement(attr).post(). VoiceOver then queues the speech itself. Otherwise keep the current AVSpeechSynthesizer path. That's about 10 lines and well under an hour. No need to add our own queue or listen for announcementDidFinishNotification. prefersAssistiveTechnologySettings alone is not enough.

confirmed.title: 自动开始散步时强行切到「今日」页
confirmed.evidence: beginWalk 里有 tab = .today。真机上散步由定位自动触发，用户正在看排行榜或街坊页时，页面会突然跳走，读屏焦点和滚动位置都会丢失。
confirmed.rule: 无障碍：不在用户没有操作时改变情境（WCAG 3.2）
confirmed.fix: 不再切换标签页，改用横幅或提示「開始記錄」，语音保留。

verdict.reason:
问题属实。ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Walk.swift:30 的 beginWalk 无条件执行 `tab = .today`。真机上 beginWalk 只从 handleWalkEvent 的 .location 分支（同文件约 163–165 行）调用，条件是离家超过 55 m 而且定位精度不超过 30 m，用户不用按任何掣。WalkDetector.swift 的注释写明定位只在"使用期间、前台"开启，所以这次切页只会在 App 开着、用户可能正在看排行榜或街坊页时发生，报告里的情形是真实的。

MainView.contentArea 只渲染当前页（page(for:).id(tab)），切页时旧页整页移除，VoiceOver 焦点停在的元素也跟着消失，切页又没有发任何无障碍通知。

这次切页对"所有提示同时有语音和图像"（§4）不是必要的：左上的 HomeChip「行緊 N 分鐘」在三个标签上都显示，场景镜头也会跟住"me"，再加上 speaker.speak 播报，语音和图像都已经有了。规格 F1 只要求自动记录、用户不需要操作，没有要求跳到「今日」。这一点也不涉及"已定的决定"。

报告也有部分夸大：
- 滚动位置丢失和用户自己切标签时一样，不是这次自动切页独有的问题。
- 所引的 WCAG 3.2.5 属于 AAA 级，规格里没有明文要求。
- 演示路径由「出門」按钮（Demo.swift:12）或脚本触发，属于用户发起，在那里切页没有问题。

所以只算低严重度的无障碍和体验问题，只影响真机的自动检测路径。
verdict.fix: 把 `tab = .today` 从 AppStore+Walk.swift:30 的 beginWalk 移到 startWalk()（只有演示「出門」按钮和脚本会调用，属于用户发起）。这样真机由定位自动开始散步时不再切换标签。现有的 HomeChip「行緊 N 分鐘」（三个标签都可见）和语音播报已经满足"语音 + 图像"。可以选择补一行 `UIAccessibility.post(notification: .announcement, argument: "開始記錄散步")`，在不移动焦点的情况下通知 VoiceOver 用户。DemoScript 第 28 步之前，第 22 步已经设了 tab = .today，不受影响。工作量 S（改 1–3 行）。

confirmed.title: 选楼页的提示同时显示两次，顶部那条压在进度点上
confirmed.evidence: RootView 给整个 OnboardingFlow 叠了一层 ToastView（顶部 padding 8）。OnbPickHomeStep 自己又在说明卡下面用 Label 显示 store.toast。点到非住宅楼时，「請揀一座住宅樓」会同时出现两条，顶部那条还和返回键、进度点重叠。
confirmed.rule: 明显的视觉问题
confirmed.fix: 删掉 RootView 里的 overlay，只保留选楼页内联那条；或者反过来，删掉内联那条，把顶部 overlay 移到 topBar 下方。

verdict.reason: This is real, but one detail in the report is wrong. On the pick-home step, tapping a non-residential building calls `toast("請揀一座住宅樓")` at Store/AppStore+Map.swift:77, which sets `store.toast`. Two views read that value at the same time. (1) RootView.swift:17 puts `ToastView()` over the whole OnboardingFlow with `.overlay(alignment: .top)` and `.padding(.top, DS.gap)`. Its comment says it exists for exactly this message. (2) OnbPickHomeStep, at Onboarding.swift:281-288, shows the same `store.toast` again as a Label below the instruction card. So the same message appears twice. The overlay sits on top of the view that already has `.safeAreaInset(edge: .top) { topBar }` (Onboarding.swift:33). That puts the toast at the top of the safe area, at the same height as the top bar, which also has 8pt top padding. It is drawn above the bar. Both the toast and the progress-dots capsule are centred, so the toast covers the dots. The wrong detail: there is no back button on this step (`canGoBack` is true only for .floor and .avatar), so the overlap is with the progress dots only, not the back button. None of the decided points cover this. It is a clear visual bug: the same message shows twice and the progress indicator is hidden. Severity is low because it only happens after tapping the wrong building, the toast clears itself, and nothing stops working.
verdict.fix: Delete the `.overlay(alignment: .top) { ToastView().padding(.top, DS.gap) }` line in ios/StreetWalk/UI/RootView.swift:17, along with its comment on line 16. Keep the inline Label in OnbPickHomeStep. That step is the only onboarding screen that calls toast (the other onboarding steps — consent, locate, floor, avatar — never set store.toast), so nothing else is lost. If a top toast is wanted later, add it inside OnboardingFlow below the topBar safeAreaInset, not over it. Effort: S (one line).

confirmed.title: 找人全屏时，提示框压住顶部卡
confirmed.evidence: 全屏时 Toast 放在 safe.top+64 的位置，而顶部卡从 safe.top 开始，高约 84 pt（有播送行或大字号时更高）。迟到卡里按「打電話」后弹出的「示範街坊冇電話號碼，真機會直接打俾佢。」会压在顶部卡的下半部分。
confirmed.rule: 界面不应截断或重叠
confirmed.fix: 测量顶部卡的高度，把 Toast 放在它下面；或者全屏时把 Toast 放到底栏上方。

verdict.reason: The report is accurate. In find full screen, FindOverlay gets .padding(.top, safe.top) (MainView.swift:129-130), and its VStack puts topCard first with no extra top padding (FullScreen.swift:196-198). The card starts right at safe.top. Its smallest height is 16 + 52 (avatar) + 16 = 84 pt. In practice the bodyBold 24pt text such as "陳太出咗門 · 大約 N 分鐘到{place}" wraps to two lines at about 277 pt wide, so the card is about 96-100 pt tall, and taller with the broadcast row or Dynamic Type. ToastView is pinned at safe.top + 64 (MainView.swift:141-143). It sits above FindOverlay in the ZStack and has an opaque regularMaterial background, a shadow and a 48 pt minimum height, so for 3.5 s it covers the lower part of the top card (the second ETA/place line, and the broadcast row if shown). The code even contradicts itself: CaptionView in the same file uses safe.top + 104 and its comment calls that spot "顶卡之下", while the toast uses 64. This is reachable. Pressing 「打電話」 on the late card (FullScreen.swift:321-323) calls store.call, which shows 「示範街坊冇電話號碼…」 in demo mode (AppStore+Services.swift:22). Other toasts can also fire during full screen, e.g. the non-neighbour-went-out toast (AppStore+Neighbors.swift:99) and expired appointments (AppStore+Meetup.swift:252). None of the settled decisions cover this. Severity is low: the overlap is brief, the toast is also spoken, and nothing breaks.
verdict.fix: Simplest fix: in full mode, show the toast as part of FindOverlay's own layout so it lands under the measured card, rather than at a fixed offset. In FullScreen.swift:197, change the VStack to `VStack(spacing: 8) { topCard(f, p, place); ToastView(); Spacer(minLength: 0) ... }`. In MainView.swift:140-144, draw the global ToastView only when !full, i.e. wrap it in `if !full { ToastView().padding(.bottom, tabH + 12).frame(..., alignment: .bottom).allowsHitTesting(false) }`. A quicker alternative is to raise the offset to match CaptionView (`safe.top + 104`), but that still breaks with two-line text or the broadcast row. Effort: S, about 5 lines.

confirmed.title: 今日页可能同时出现多个橙色主按钮
confirmed.evidence: 每张在外街坊的卡都有一个 dsPrimary 按钮「約佢／過去搵佢」，今日约会卡的「出發」也是 dsPrimary。街坊在外、当天又有已应承的约会时，同一屏会有两个以上主按钮；横幅上的「約佢」和卡片上的「約佢」也会同时出现。
confirmed.rule: Design.swift:73：一个视图里最多一个主按钮；草图里今日页的「出發」是次按钮
confirmed.fix: 「出發」改为 dsSecondary，或者只给最近、最重要的一项用主按钮。

verdict.reason:
This is real. The code and the screenshot both confirm it.
(1) Design.swift:73 says of PrimaryButtonStyle: 「一个视图里最多一个」 (at most one per view). The layout sketch (docs/design/layout_sketch.html:44) styles the today page's 「出發」 as `class="bt"`, which is a secondary button. Only 「約佢」 uses `bt ok`, the orange primary.
(2) In code, Tabs.swift:103 gives every out-neighbour card from outCard a `.dsPrimary` 「約佢／過去搵佢」 button. The out-neighbour section loops over all of store.outNeighbors (Tabs.swift:47), so two neighbours out at once means two primary buttons. Tabs.swift:219 makes the accepted appointment's 「出發」 `.dsPrimary` too, which contradicts the sketch.
(3) The banner button at Overlays.swift:285-289 is also `.dsPrimary`. AppStore+Neighbors.swift:105 sets its actionTitle to 「約佢」 or 「過去搵佢」, the same label as the card.
(4) Screenshot s1_26.png shows the banner's orange 「約佢」 and the 陳太 card's orange 「約佢」 on screen together. That makes two identical orange primary buttons, plus the orange mic.
This does not conflict with any of the settled decisions. Those fix the layout proportions and font sizes, not how many primary buttons a page has. It breaks the project's own design rule and the user-chosen sketch. For older users, two identical orange buttons on one screen make it unclear which one to press. It does not affect function, so severity is low.
verdict.fix:
Minimal fix (effort S, about 3 lines):
1. Change Tabs.swift:219 for 「出發」 from `.dsPrimary` to `.dsSecondary`, matching layout_sketch.html:44.
2. Give the outCard button at Tabs.swift:103 `.dsPrimary` only on the first out neighbour and `.dsSecondary` on the rest. For example, pass `isFirst` from the ForEach at line 47 and pick the style with a conditional.
3. While the banner is showing, the card and banner duplicate the same 「約佢」. Change the banner action button at Overlays.swift:289 to `.dsSecondary`, which suits its dark background better anyway. Alternatively, make the today page's outCard use secondary while `store.banner` is non-nil.
Doing just step 1 plus step 3 already gives one primary button in the common case shown in s1_26.png.

confirmed.title: 右上「演示」胶囊显示成系统蓝
confirmed.evidence: Menu 的 label 是蓝色，是全 App 唯一的蓝色元素，和左上的灰色齿轮、橙色强调色都不协调。
confirmed.rule: Design.swift：只用一个强调色橙
confirmed.fix: 在 Menu 上加 .tint(.primary)（或 DS.accent）。

verdict.reason: The report is accurate. In ios/StreetWalk/UI/Demo.swift:46-58, the Menu label sets `.foregroundStyle(.primary)` on the HStack, but on the iOS 26.5 simulator that run.sh uses, the Menu ignores it and draws the label in the system tint. The screenshots were taken after Demo.swift last changed (Demo.swift 10-07, screenshots 10-08 15:12 and later). They all show the sparkles icon and the word 演示 in system blue: s0_home.png, crop_sx33.png, and all five frames of m_sx_a.png. Swapping in the global AccentColor asset does not explain it. That asset is orange #D85A30 and is compiled in (NSAccentColorName=AccentColor, AccentColor is in Assets.car), so the Menu label is simply not picking it up. Other controls that set `.tint(DS.accent)` explicitly do render orange (the Settings pickers and toggle in full_settings.png). That leaves this capsule as the only blue element on the main screen. It sits in the top-right corner of every main-screen view whenever demo mode is on (MainView.swift:231 `if store.demoMode { DemoMenu() }`), and demo mode is exactly what gets presented. This breaks the rule written in the Design.swift:3 header, 「单一强调色橙」 (orange as the single accent colour). It also clashes with the gray gear on the left. None of the decisions already made say anything about this button's colour, so there is no conflict with them. It is cosmetic only: no effect on function, accessibility or privacy, so severity is low.
verdict.fix: In ios/StreetWalk/UI/Demo.swift, add `.tint(.primary)` to the Menu itself, after `.menuOrder(.fixed)` (around line 60). The `.foregroundStyle(.primary)` inside the label is not enough. That makes the capsule the same neutral colour as the gear on the left. If you want it orange instead, use `.tint(DS.accent)`. The destructive 重置演示 item keeps its red. Re-take a screenshot of the main screen to confirm. Effort: S (one line).

confirmed.title: 时间滑杆半屏 sheet 的玻璃底透出下面的橙色按钮，「完成」看不清
confirmed.evidence: iOS 26 的 .medium sheet 用玻璃底，标题行后面透出「碰一碰加街坊」的橙色按钮，橙色的「完成」落在橙粉色的底上，对比度不足。
confirmed.rule: 视觉清晰、对比足够
confirmed.fix: 给这个 sheet 加 .presentationBackground(Color(.systemBackground))。

verdict.reason:
I tried to disprove this and couldn't. The report holds up.

The sheet code is in ios/StreetWalk/UI/MainView.swift:176-183 (inner modifiers repeated at UI/Demo.swift:142-145). It uses `.presentationDetents([.medium])` and `.presentationBackgroundInteraction(.enabled(upThrough: .medium))`. Nothing sets a background, so on iOS 26 the sheet gets the default see-through glass and the screen behind it is not dimmed. The 「完成」 button (Demo.swift:80-82) is `.ds(.bodyBold)` in `DS.accent`, which is #D85A30. On the 街坊 tab, the full-width orange `.dsPrimary` button 「碰一碰加街坊」 (UI/Tabs.swift:524-537) sits right under the sheet's title row.

I sampled pixels from crop_slider.png. Behind 「完成」 the background is about RGB(255,194,170), and the darkest pixel of the text is about (211,76,33). That gives a contrast of about 2.5–2.8:1. The large-text minimum (WCAG) is 3:1, so this fails. The same orange on plain white is about 3.9:1, which passes. So the see-through background is what causes the failure. The blurred outline of the orange button also shows behind 「時間」, which looks messy.

This doesn't conflict with any settled decision. The 42% layout and the paper-cut style aren't affected, and the requested fix still leaves the 3D scene visible above the half-height sheet, so you can still watch the shadows move. Spec §4 doesn't set a contrast ratio, but it does require 色弱安全 (colour-blind-safe) colours, and this design is for elderly users.

The impact is small. The sheet is only reachable from the 演示選單 (Demo.swift:36) and the demo script (DemoScript.swift:66). The text is still readable, and the problem only happens when an orange control is under the sheet.
verdict.fix: Give the sheet a solid background. In ios/StreetWalk/UI/MainView.swift, inside the `.sheet(isPresented: $store.showTimeSlider)` block, add `.presentationBackground(Color(.systemBackground))` (or the matching `DS` card colour). Keep `presentationBackgroundInteraction` as it is so the scene above can still be dragged and watched. Optional: the detent modifiers are set twice, and the two disagree (`[.medium]` in MainView, `[.medium, .large]` in Demo.swift:142-145). Remove one set so only one place controls the sheet. Effort: S, one or two lines.

confirmed.title: 屋企靠近格子边时，200 m 底座有一大片超出已拉取的资料范围
confirmed.evidence: 地图只拉格子中心周围 560 m 见方的范围，但 pickView 允许选离格心约 280 m 的楼，以这座楼为中心的 200 m 底座就会伸出资料边界。东涌实时资料（-56_-61 格）测试：谦逸樓超出 41 m，信逸樓 71 m，#451294300 44 m，等于底座有 20–35% 没有任何资料，西边的邻座和道路都不见了（roads=0）。
confirmed.rule: 已定决定：底座是我屋企周围 200 m
confirmed.fix: confirmHome 之后，如果屋企在任一轴上满足 |home| + 100 > 280，就同时拉相邻格再合并（仍按格子对齐，不暴露精确位置）；或者把 homeTile 改为离屋企最近的格子重新拉取。

verdict.reason:
The code confirms the problem, so the report stands. Each step:
1. Only data inside the tile is kept. The map is fetched and parsed only within the tile: TileKey.plinthSize = 560 at Domain/Geo.swift:57, so half = 280 m. OSMParser.swift:28 clips every building, road and POI to |x|,|y| ≤ 280, so nothing exists beyond that.
2. Buildings near the tile edge can be picked as home. pickView (MapModel.swift:203-210) keeps residential buildings up to about 274 m from the tile centre. When the location is known, the view centre is clamped to ±130 and the view is 300 m wide, keeping buildings up to 144 m from that centre (line 123). When the location is unknown, it shows the whole 560 m tile.
3. The plinth is then centred on the picked home. confirmHome → installDiorama (AppStore+Map.swift:46-50) cuts simplified(around: home centroid, size: 200). Its edge reaches 274 + 100 = 374 m, up to about 94 m past the data. The plinth is also rotated, so a corner can stick out 100·√2 ≈ 141 m.
4. It can happen even when the user picks their own home while standing there. TileKey.snap only guarantees the user is within ±200 m of the tile centre, and 200 + 100 > 280. The comment at Geo.swift:56 says the 560 m size is meant to keep content around a user at the tile edge, and that is not achieved.
5. The gap is not a style choice. The missing area has no buildings, roads, landmark candidates or shade-casting buildings at all. That is different from "画风优先于真实" (simplifying height, shape or position), and it works against the settled decision "底座是我屋企周围 200 m".
6. The demo is mostly unaffected. In the bundled 皇后山邨 data the outermost residential block, 皇盛樓, is at x≈193, so it overflows only about 13 m (plus the rotated corner). The demo script also picks the first named block. The visible impact is limited to live data with a home near the tile edge. Severity is low, as reported.
verdict.fix:
Smallest fix (effort S, no need to fetch neighbouring tiles):
1. Domain/Geo.swift:57: raise plinthSize from 560 to 720 (half = 360 ≥ 200 snap offset + 100·√2 rotated corner + about 18 m spare). The bbox still comes from the tile, so no exact position is sent and privacy is unchanged.
2. MapService.swift:109: change the cache directory from tiles/v1 to tiles/v2. Old caches were fetched with the 560 m bbox and would still be missing the outer ring.
3. MapModel.pickView (around line 203): only offer residential buildings whose centroid satisfies max(|x|,|y|) ≤ half − 100·√2 (about 218 m). Do this for the highlight list (residentialBuildings) and for the pickHome check, so a 200 m plinth always lands fully inside the data. The existing lim = half − 150 scales with the larger half and needs no change.

The reporter's alternative, fetching and merging neighbouring tiles, also works but is effort M.

confirmed.title: 地名不用屋邨名，出现「德逸樓圈」「石湖新村公廁」
confirmed.evidence: placeName 只看建筑名，没有用已经解析出来的 landuse=residential 面的名字。实时资料结果：东涌显示「德逸樓」，但 OSM 其实有 landuse=residential 的「逸東邨」；天水围显示「14座」；鳳凰嶺显示「石湖新村公廁」（一座 building=yes 的公厕）。这个名字会用在首次使用的说明、F4 比拼的「placeName圈」（Tabs.swift:393）、F10 月报标题（AppStore+Places.swift:58）和设置页。
confirmed.rule: 文案正确；F4、F10 的展示
confirmed.fix: 优先用包含屋企或当前位置的住宅 landuse 面的名字（去掉英文），其次用以邨、苑、村、山莊结尾的名字，再其次才用住宅楼名；不要用 .other 或 .small 类建筑的名字；都没有时才用「你附近」。

verdict.reason:
The report holds up. I tested the placeName logic in MapModel.swift:82-90 against the real Overpass tiles cached in the simulators (Library/Caches/tiles/v1).

How the logic works now: it first takes any building whose name ends in 邨. If there is none, it takes the named residential building nearest the tile centre. If there is none of those either, it falls back to `named.first`, which is any named building, including .other and .small ones. It never looks at landuse=residential areas, even though OSMParser.swift:88-91 already keeps them with their names as Area(kind: .residential).

What the cached tiles produce:
- Tile -5_1 (鳳凰嶺 / 石湖新村) gives "石湖新村公廁". That is a building=yes, amenity=toilets, and it is the only named building in the tile, while the landuse area 奕翠園 is ignored.
- Tile -56_-61 (東涌) gives "德逸樓", although the landuse area 逸東邨 is in the tile.
- Tile -13_-1 gives "17座", although the landuse area 嘉麗山莊 is in the tile.
- Tile 3_-51 (旺角) gives "光榮大樓".

Where the name shows up:
- F4 race: Community.swift:154 shows "\(placeName)圈", so the user sees "石湖新村公廁圈".
- F10 report title: TemplateAI.swift:171, reached from AppStore+Places.swift:58, shows "石湖新村公廁 · 本月散步報告". The spec (F10 §108-111, §8 monthlyReport(estateId)) says the report covers a whole estate, so the title should be the estate name.
- The first-use map caption (Onboarding.swift:323) also shows it.
- Settings (Settings.swift:16) shows it only when the user has no blockName.

Also, the name is chosen by distance to the tile centre, not to the user's home, because simplified() sets `out.areaName = placeName` from the full 560 m tile. So the "圈" can be named after a block the user doesn't live in.

This doesn't clash with any of the settled decisions. Style-over-realism covers geometry, not text, and live map loading is a real code path (MapService.load, labelled "實時").

Why severity is low: the demo uses the bundled 皇后山邨 data (tile 0_0) and is not affected. There, "皇后山邨" comes from a bus-station roof (building=roof) whose name ends in 邨, which the first rule catches. The problem only appears with live or cached data from other places.

Effort: small. The reporter's own fix has a regression risk: if landuse names are checked before the 邨-suffix building rule, the demo could pick up a nearby private estate's name. In the demo tile, 皇后山一號, 龍騰居 and 皇后山房 are all landuse=residential.

confirmed.title: 寻路把水面当作可走，「我」会穿过水池
confirmed.evidence: PathGrid 只把建筑设为不可走，水面的 cost 是 2.5。天水围实时资料测试：从屋企到地标的散步路线中，有 3 条穿过 .water 面（天水围公园水池），场景里小人和轨迹带画在水上。
confirmed.rule: 路线应该是能走的
confirmed.fix: PathGrid.init 把 .water 面内的格子设为 0（不可走）；nearestWalkable 已经能处理不可走的格子。

verdict.reason: The bug is real. I confirmed it by reading the code; I did not run the simulator. In ios/StreetWalk/Map/PathGrid.swift:10-44, every cell starts at cost 2.5. Roads lower that cost (lines 21-35), and only buildings that are not canopies are set to 0 (lines 36-43). PathGrid never reads map.areas, so a water area costs the same as any open ground and A* routes straight across it. MapModel.simplified (MapModel.swift ~166-182) keeps water areas. It turns each one into a light-blue rectangle that can cover up to 20% of the base, and GroundPainter.swift:22-31 paints it on the ground. Every route goes through DioramaController.route() -> PathGrid.path: the walk legs (AppStore+Walk.swift:18), the routes for finding someone (AppStore+Find.swift:11/55/57) and the route home (AppStore+Find.swift:137). So the person and the route ribbon can be drawn on top of the water. The code itself treats water as somewhere you cannot stand: LandmarkDeriver.settle (LandmarkDeriver.swift:106-110) moves landmarks out of water on purpose, so the pathfinding is inconsistent with that. This does not clash with the 'style over realism' decision. That decision covers building heights, shapes, positions and shade accuracy, not a route crossing water that the scene itself draws. Scope: the bundled fallback data fallback_queenshill.json has no water polygons (I checked: natural=water, reservoir/basin, riverbank/dock all 0), so the -offline / fallback demo is not affected. It only happens with live or cached Overpass data that has water inside the base, for example a park pond in Tin Shui Wai. I could not reproduce the reporter's Tin Shui Wai run itself, but the code path does produce this result. It is a visual and logic glitch, not a crash or privacy problem, so the severity is low.
verdict.fix: In PathGrid.init, after the road loop and before or after the building loop, add a loop over `for a in map.areas where a.kind == .water`. Use the same bounding-box plus Polygon.contains(a.outline, cellCenter(i, j)) check as the building loop, and set cost[j*n+i] = 0 only where cost[j*n+i] >= 2.5. Roads drawn over water (GroundPainter paints roads above areas) then stay walkable as bridges. nearestWalkable (search radius 20 cells, 80 m) already moves a start or goal inside water to the nearest walkable cell. Water rectangles are at most 20% of the base (about 134 m square, 67 m from centre to edge), so that radius is enough. Known edge case: a long strip of water such as a river with no car road across it splits the base in two. Routes across it then become unreachable and path() falls back to the straight line [start, goal], which is no worse than today. Also update the comment on line 3 to say water is not walkable. Effort: S, about 8 lines; a unit test in StreetWalkTests with a water rectangle between start and goal can check it.

confirmed.title: 死代码：手势和惯性、无人调用的函数和属性、空操作语句、走不到的天气分支
confirmed.evidence: (1) 场景已定为只看不操作，但平移、缩放和惯性的一整套代码（panBegan 到 pinchChanged、tick、stopMomentum、moveTarget、velocity、displayLink、panAnchor、pinchStart，约 60 行）没有任何调用，followStep 还在检查 panAnchor 和 lastUserInteraction。(2) 没有引用或只写不读的：flyHome、homeDistance、onOverlay（从未赋值）、debugInfo（只写不读）、prefix(1200) 上限（前面已经 prefix(5)）、SceneChip、facadeTile、Polygon.simplify、PathGrid.isWalkable、showStats（没人设置）。(3) MapService.fetch 里的 if i == 0 { continue } 是空操作。(4) HKOReport.todayMax 和 todayPSR 只有九天预报包含今日时才有值，但预报从明天开始（selftest 自己断言 todayPSR == nil），所以 isHot、isRain、line 里依赖它们的分支实际走不到。
confirmed.rule: 代码整洁；避免走不到的逻辑误导维护者
confirmed.fix: 删除手势和惯性代码，以及上面这些没有引用的函数和属性。todayMax 和 todayPSR 改用 rhrread 的数据，或者直接删掉。

verdict.reason:
Items (1) to (3) check out against the code. Item (4) does not.

(1) DioramaView.swift:28 installs only a tap recognizer, and its comment says the scene is view-only (只看不操作). Searching all of ios/ finds no callers outside DioramaController for panBegan, panChanged, panEnded, pinchBegan or pinchChanged (DioramaController.swift:415-475). So velocity, displayLink, lastTick (71-74), panAnchor, pinchStart, tick, stopMomentum, moveTarget, minDistance and maxDistance (66-67) only serve that dead path. The followStep guard (678-679) still tests panAnchor, displayLink and lastUserInteraction, but none of them ever changes. The comments contradict the settled view-only decision. Line 58 says the camera "只平移、缩放" (only pans and zooms). Line 84 says it pauses 3 s after the user drags (用户拖动后暂停 3 秒). This is a comment-versus-code mismatch.

(2) Nothing references these: flyHome (400), homeDistance (69), SceneChip (Design.swift:141), GroundPainter.facadeTile (65), Polygon.simplify (151), PathGrid.isWalkable (54). onOverlay is only invoked at line 729 and never assigned. debugInfo is written at line 263 and never read. showStats is never passed by either DioramaView call site (Onboarding.swift:20, MainView.swift:196). prefix(1200) on line 264 does nothing because line 262 already applies prefix(5). The comment on line 261 says "最多 12 棵" (at most 12 trees), which also disagrees with the code.

(3) The `if i == 0 { continue }` at MapService.swift:100 is the last statement of the loop body, so it does nothing.

(4) is overstated. todayPSR and todayMax are filled only when the 9-day forecast (fnd) includes today's date. The selftest fixture starts at tomorrow, but that is one sample. The forecast's first day is tomorrow at the time it is issued. After midnight, the last forecast from the previous evening still lists the new 'today' first until HKO issues the next one. So the isHot, isRain and line branches can be reached in the early morning. The field comment "九天预报里有今日才有" (only present when the 9-day forecast includes today) is accurate. Do not delete these fields.

Overall: this is real but low severity. It is cleanup plus misleading comments. No user-facing behaviour, spec or privacy rule is affected, and it does not conflict with the settled decisions.
verdict.fix:
Effort S.

DioramaController.swift:
- Delete these gesture and momentum members: panAnchor, pinchStart, panBegan…pinchChanged, tick, stopMomentum, moveTarget (415-475), velocity, displayLink, lastTick (71-74), minDistance and maxDistance (66-67), and lastUserInteraction (86).
- Reduce the followStep guard to `guard let fid = followID, cameraNode.action(forKey: "fly") == nil else { return }`.
- Change the comment on line 58 to say the camera has a fixed pitch and azimuth and is moved only by the app flow. Remove "用户拖动后暂停 3 秒" from line 84.
- Delete flyHome (400), homeDistance (69), and onOverlay (83) together with its call at 729.
- Delete debugInfo (87) and the write at 263. Make line 264 `MeshBuilder.trees(spots, …)` and change the comment on line 261 to "最多 5 棵".

Other files:
- Delete SceneChip (Design.swift:140-156), GroundPainter.facadeTile (65), Polygon.simplify (151…), PathGrid.isWalkable (54) and DioramaView.showStats (8, 23, 38).
- MapService.swift:100: delete `if i == 0 { continue }` and change `enumerated()` to a plain `for endpoint in Self.endpoints`.

Keep HKOReport.todayMax and todayPSR. If anything, only change the selftest message so it does not imply today is never present.

Build and run the selftest to confirm nothing else referenced these.

confirmed.title: prototype_status 的「未做」一节漏列了二维码添加、年龄与肤色、色弱检查
confirmed.evidence: F5「备选：扫二维码添加」没有任何代码。§4「卡通形象要覆盖…不同年龄和肤色」只做了 4 种行动方式加衣服颜色，没有年龄和肤色选项。§4「配色要通过色弱安全检查」没有检查记录。状态文档的「未做／需要真机」一节都没有提这三项。
confirmed.rule: 如实说明完成度
confirmed.fix: 在 prototype_status 的「未做」一节补上这三项（或按 A42、A50、A51 实现后再更新）。

verdict.reason:
I tried to disprove this and couldn't. The status doc's own goal is to say what works and what is simulated (prototype_status.md:3), but it leaves out three spec items that aren't done.

1) QR fallback. Spec F5 (产品定稿:76) lists "扫二维码添加" as the fallback. Nothing in ios/ implements it: no QR code, no AVCapture, no CIQRCode. The F5 row (prototype_status.md:18) and the "未做" section (:33-36) mention only UWB and the simulated phone. The fixed decision that bump is simulated covers the demo-fallback purpose. It does not cover phones that can't do UWB, so the doc still has to say this isn't done.

2) Ages and skin tones. §4 (:122) asks for different ages and skin tones. Figures.person (Figures.swift:20-73) varies only the Mobility case and the clothing color. Every head uses the single color SceneStyle.skin (SceneStyle.swift:66, used at Figures.swift:36), and there are no age variants. This is not covered by "画风优先于真实", which is about building height, shape, position and shade accuracy, not who the figures represent.

3) Colour-blind check. §4 (:121) asks for one. docs/, README and code have no check record: grepping for 色弱, contrast, 对比度 and deuter finds nothing outside the spec. Yet the "知情同意、无障碍" row (:24) lists other gaps (no Mandarin UI, screen-reader order not checked) and not this one, so readers will think it was done.

None of this conflicts with the fixed decisions. It is only a documentation-honesty gap: the app doesn't break or crash, so severity is low.
verdict.fix:
Docs-only, size S. In docs/prototype_status.md:
(a) F5 row, :18, "模拟 / 未做" column: add "扫二维码添加（备选）未做".
(b) "知情同意、无障碍" row, :24: add "卡通形象只有 4 种行动方式加衣服颜色，未分年龄和肤色；配色未做色弱安全检查".
(c) "未做 / 需要真机" section, :33-36: add one line covering all three.
Alternatively, implement them (A42/A50/A51) and then update the doc. The quickest real fix for skin tone is a small palette of skin colors in SceneStyle, chosen per person by id hash.

rejected.title: 出门状态在退到后台、App 被杀、重置演示、改楼后都不撤回，后端也没有过期机制，街坊会一直看到我「在外面」
rejected.reason:
The code paths the report describes do exist, but the harm it claims ("街坊会一直看到我「在外面」") can't happen in this prototype.

What checks out in the code:
- publishOuting(landmarkID: nil) is only called in finishWalk (ios/StreetWalk/Store/AppStore+Walk.swift:104).
- appActive(false) only calls walkDetector.stop() (AppStore+Services.swift:11-14).
- regenerateHere and resetDemo (DemoScript.swift:98-108) and beginChangeHome (UI/Settings.swift:140-145) set walk = nil directly.
- WalkSession is not saved to disk, so if the app is killed, the next launch never sends nil.
- The outings table in docs/backend_supabase.md:60-65 has no expiry.

Why it is not a real problem:
1. The only CommunityService implementation in the app is LocalCommunityService, and its publishOuting is an empty function (Store/Community.swift:98). The outing state never leaves the phone. All other residents are simulated 「示範」 characters, and none of them read my outing state. So nobody can see that I am "out", and the privacy leak cannot be triggered now.
2. Adding a TTL, view or RLS expiry to the outings table is design work for a backend that doesn't exist. That conflicts with the settled decision: "单机演示 + CommunityService 预留接口，不做 Supabase". backend_supabase.md itself says it is "未实现".
3. Of the code paths that drop a walk without going home, regenerateHere and resetDemo are only in the demo menu. In demo mode the real walk detector is off, and the outing state is a no-op anyway. The finishLiveWalk path, which the walk detector uses when it sees me back near home, does send nil, which matches the protocol note "回家隐身（nil）".
4. Foreground-only detection (when-in-use permission, no background location) is a known limit of the prototype, noted at WalkDetector.swift:5. F1 "进入家附近范围后停止记录，并且不再对外显示位置" holds for the parts that are implemented.

What remains is a hidden risk only if someone later plugs in a real backend: a few code paths don't follow the protocol's "回家隐身" rule. At most this is low-priority hardening, not a privacy bug in the current version.

rejected.title: 「清除我嘅紀錄」只清本机：不删住址、楼层和地图缓存，也不把解除街坊、取消约会同步出去
rejected.reason:
I checked each part of the report against the code and could not confirm any of it as a real problem today.

(1) Not telling the community service when clearing. It is true that clearAllData (AppStore+Persist.swift:86-94) does not call community.unlinkNeighbor or updateMeetup. But the decision is a single-phone demo with no Supabase, and the service in use is LocalCommunityService, where unlinkNeighbor does nothing (Community.swift:96). So nothing exists anywhere that could stay out of sync. Waiting invites are not a problem either. After a clear, the demo neighbour's delayed reply can still arrive, but partnerAnswered (AppStore+Meetup.swift:178) returns at its guard because the appointment is gone. Nothing shows on screen.

(2) "Relationships come back on the next populate." This is wrong for the current code. populate (AppStore+Map.swift:112-125) rebuilds neighbour links only from savedNeighbors, which clearAllData has just emptied. The server problems the report describes (the other person still getting my outing alerts, still waiting for a meetup) only appear with a backend that is not built yet. LocalStore.swift:4 already says that once a server exists it becomes the source of truth and the phone only keeps a cache. What "clear" should mean then is a design question for that later backend, not a bug in this version.

(3) Address, floor and avatar are kept. The product spec has no "delete all data" requirement. Settings.swift:15-29 shows home building, floor, avatar and colour as separate profile settings that can be changed. The button says "清除我嘅紀錄" (clear my records). The confirmation message (Settings.swift:76) lists exactly what gets deleted: neighbours, meetups, reports and walk records. It never says the address is deleted, so it is not misleading. The map tile cache is public OSM data that expires after 30 days, not something the user created.

(4) iCloud backup. The footer "都只存喺你部手機" (only stored on your phone) is accurate in the single-phone demo: nothing goes to any server. The phone's own iCloud backup belongs to the user and is standard iOS behaviour. That is not a dishonest claim.

The only accurate part is a small inconsistency. homeChanged and unlinkNeighbor tell the service when they cancel open meetups, but clearAllData does not. With the current local service this has no visible effect. It does not break any spec rule or settled decision, so I judge real=false.

rejected.title: 找人方向只靠箭头，读屏标签和语音都不讲方向，也没有地标图标
rejected.reason:
The facts in the report are correct, but it doesn't break a spec rule. The nearPill accessibility label in FullScreen.swift:300-301 does leave out arrowAngle. The 50 m voice line in AppStore+Find.swift:89 does only say 「喺附近，跟住箭咀行」. The reasons it is not a violation:

(1) §4 「所有提示同时有语音和图像」 is met. The near prompt has a voice line, a vibration (Haptics.success), and a picture (the big arrow plus the distance). Nothing in §4 or F8 says the voice has to repeat the direction. F8 only says to show the big arrow and the landmark icon.

(2) The landmark graphic is on screen. Find mode is full-screen 3D (findFullScreen). scene.highlightLandmark(lm.id) makes the target landmark's halo pulse (DioramaController.swift:525-541). The overlay puts the landmark name over each landmark (DioramaController.swift:712-716). The top card and the voice lines both name the place (「喺\(lm.name)等你」, 「大約 N 分鐘到\(place)」). So a landmark graphic and its name are present, just not inside nearPill.

(3) The suggested fix would mislead people. f.bearing is measured against the screen, where 「屏幕上方 = 西北」 (AppStore+Find.swift:83-85), and the scene camera is fixed. It is not measured against which way the phone or the person is facing. Real ultra-wideband (UWB) direction needs a real device (prototype_status.md F8 row). Turning this angle into 「左前、右後」 or clock directions would send a real walker the wrong way.

(4) The product is visual-first for older users, and the arrow is drawn on a simulated scene. Leaving a screen-relative angle out of the VoiceOver label is not a clear accessibility defect.

The report also merges two claims, and neither one stands on its own. Since I'm not certain, I'm marking it not real, per the rule.

rejected.title: 碰一碰画面没有失败、超时、机型不支持的状态，没有二维码后备，找到对方后也没有「走近挥手」
rejected.reason:
此问题与已定的决定「单机演示 + 碰一碰用模拟实现（B 负责）」冲突，按规则判不成立。

1. 失败、超时、机型不支持：现在唯一的实现是 ios/StreetWalk/Bump/SimulatedBumpService.swift。它 2.2 秒后一定碰到第一个还不是街坊的人；没有候选人时，startSearching 直接返回，AppStore+Neighbors.swift:21-24 会马上把状态改回 .idle，并提示「圈入面嘅人都已經係你街坊」。所以在这个原型里，任何路径都到不了「一直转圈」。超宽带碰不到人、机型不支持，只会在 B 以后接真机实现时才出现。F5 的配对逻辑归 B（§6），改 Domain/Contracts.swift:46 的 BumpService 协议也要双方同意（§6 规则），不是 A 现在的缺陷。

2. 二维码后备：规格 F5 写的是「给不支持的机型用，也作演示现场的兜底」。单机演示只有一部手机，用的模拟碰一碰不会失败，本身就是兜底。二维码配对要两部真机，配对逻辑也归 B，现在做只能再做一个模拟画面，和已定的方案重复。

3. 「走近挥手」：属实但很小。草图 docs/design/layout_sketch.html:73 的说明写着「碰到后两个小人在场景里走近挥手」，而 AppStore+Map.swift:159-163 只让两人用 .stand 各站在家门口一侧，并给对方加了高亮。不过 §6 要求的「碰一碰的画面和动画」已经有了：FullScreen.swift:52-80 的两部手机靠近加涟漪动画、找到后镜头移过去、两人一起出现、RemindPrompt 的勾号弹跳动画。草图说明不是规格条文，缺挥手动作属于打磨，算不上明显的视觉缺陷。

整体判不成立。

rejected.title: 「打電話」没有号码来源：PhoneBook 永远为空，后端设计又明确不收电话
rejected.reason:
The facts in the report are accurate, but they don't add up to a violation by member A, so I'm judging it not a real issue.

What is true:
- PhoneBook.swift:6 is an empty dictionary.
- Resident (Domain/Models.swift:4-23) and NeighborLink (Store/LocalStore.swift:17-21) have no phone field.
- backend_supabase.md:26 says no phone numbers are collected.

Why it is still not a real problem:
1. What F8 requires is done. The spec text is "超过约定时间 10 分钟仍未碰头，AI 询问是否拨打电话" (after 10 minutes, the AI asks whether to call). AppStore+Find.swift:108 speaks that question. FullScreen.swift:305-327 shows a card with 「再等等」 and 「打電話」 buttons. AppStore+Services.swift:19-29 really opens a tel: link when a number exists and gives a clear message when it doesn't. F8 says nothing about where numbers come from.
2. The empty phone book follows directly from a settled decision: a single-phone demo where everyone else is a simulated 「示範」 resident. Simulated residents can't have real numbers. With demo mode off, the circle is just you, so there is no one to call anyway.
3. The limitation is already written down. prototype_status.md:21 says 「示範街坊没有电话号码，所以会显示说明」 (demo neighbours have no number, so an explanation is shown). That is honest.
4. The backend doc matches the spec. Spec §7's data tables (users, neighbors and the rest) have no phone field either, so backend_supabase.md isn't departing from anything. If phone numbers are needed after launch, that is a gap in the spec. That needs both members to agree on a new feature. It is not a defect in A's code. Supabase is also explicitly out of scope ("不做 Supabase").
5. The suggested fix (swapping numbers over MultipeerConnectivity during the bump) is in Bump/, which is B's area. It would also add a new kind of personal data that needs its own consent wording. That is new feature work, not a minimal fix.

One small side issue, outside this report: the demo message at AppStore+Services.swift:22 says 「示範街坊冇電話號碼，真機會直接打俾佢」 (demo neighbour has no number, a real phone would call them directly). Someone running on a real iPhone still sees this message and nothing gets dialled, so "真機" (real phone) slightly overpromises.

rejected.title: 没有用户身份和昵称：首次使用不问昵称，「我」写死成 id me、名字「你」
rejected.reason:
The facts in the report are accurate, but treating them as a medium spec gap for this prototype doesn't hold up.

What the report gets right:
- AppStore.swift:9 lists the first-run steps as consent, locate, pickHome, floor and avatar. None of them asks for a nickname.
- AppStore+Map.swift:128 and AppStore.swift:95 hard-code me as id "me" with the name "你".
- The CommunityService protocol (Community.swift:8-44) has no sign-in or current-user method.

Why it isn't a real problem now:
1. It conflicts with a settled decision. The prototype is a single-device demo with a reserved CommunityService interface and no Supabase. The login §6 asks for is the backend's anonymous sign-in (backend_supabase.md:26, :151), and the docs already list it as not done (prototype_status.md, "未做 / 需要真机": 后端). With no backend, no user identity has anything to log in to.
2. Nothing in the demo would use a nickname. Everyone else in the circle is a simulated 示範 resident whose name comes from LocalCommunityService.roster. In the F6 line "12 楼陈太刚出门", the name is the neighbour's, and the roster supplies it. The user's own name only appears in the user's own UI, where "你" is correct (the scene label, the leaderboard's 我 row). The report's point that neighbours have no source for my name only applies to the multi-user launch version, which is out of scope.
3. None of F1–F10 or §4 requires a nickname step at first launch. users.nickname is in §7, which the spec labels a first draft and is the backend schema. Adding a step to a demo where nobody sees the name would only lengthen first-run setup for older users, which §4's simplicity requirements argue against.

What is left is a minor documentation inaccuracy, not this issue. backend_supabase.md:5 says that going live only needs a new SupabaseCommunityService and "App 其他部分都不用改" (no other part of the app needs changing). But the protocol has no way to sign in or upload my profile: nickname, block, floor, avatar, estate. users.nickname is declared not null, so a real backend would need a new protocol method and a nickname step at first launch. That is low severity, documentation only, and not worth a code change in the prototype.

rejected.title: 隐私规则、真机散步逻辑和约会生命周期都没有单元测试
rejected.reason:
The facts in the report are correct, but they don't add up to a reportable defect.

What checks out:
- ios/StreetWalkTests/CoreTests.swift has exactly 19 @Test functions: MapTests 4, SunShadeTests 2, VoiceTests 7, StoreTests 4, CommunityTests 2.
- ios/tools/selftest/main.swift covers TileKey, OSMParser, landmarks, the diorama, sun position, shade, path finding, scenePoint (including rotation) and HKOReport.
- Neither file touches the areas the report lists: syncScene / scene privacy, handleWalkEvent thresholds, the appointment lifecycle, publishOuting arguments, resetDemoData or decoding old save formats. Shade with rotation ≠ 0 is also untested; only scenePoint is tested with rotation.

Why it is not a real issue:
1. The product spec (§4 general requirements, F1–F10) has no unit-test or coverage requirement. The rule the report cites, that the privacy promises "需要能验证" (must be verifiable), does not appear in any document. It is the reporter's own wording.
2. There is no mismatch between the docs and the code. README.md:22 and docs/prototype_status.md:28 describe the 19 tests and the areas they cover accurately. They never claim that privacy rules, walk thresholds or the appointment lifecycle are unit-tested. prototype_status.md:30-31 says those flows are checked through the -script2/-script3 demo scripts instead. The README privacy section (lines 52-56) describes behaviour, not test coverage.
3. A missing test is not one of the reportable categories: spec gap, wrong behaviour, crash, privacy or honesty problem, accessibility defect, visual or copy problem, doc–code mismatch, or performance risk. Any real bug in these areas (such as the A06 walk-threshold problem the report mentions) should be filed as its own wrong-behaviour finding, and A06 already is. "More tests would be nice" adds no new defect.
4. The proposed fix is an M-sized refactor of a single-device hackathon prototype: injecting a mock CommunityService and a clock, and pulling scenePeople, checkAppointments and other logic out into pure functions. That is an engineering preference, not a fix for a defect.

When unsure, the rule is to judge real=false, and here nothing is broken or misdocumented.

rejected.title: F8 找人要用实时距离和方向，与「服务器没有任何坐标」「街坊只以地标级出现」冲突，文档没说怎么解决
rejected.reason:
This is not a real conflict, so I am rejecting it.

1. **Nothing in F8 needs coordinates on the server.** Spec §3 F8 says that inside ultra-wideband (UWB) range the app shows a big arrow and a landmark icon and does not show a map. UWB ranging (Nearby Interaction) is direct between the two phones, so it never touches the server.
   - The arrival estimate can be worked out on the partner's own phone and sent as a number of minutes.
   - The 50 m buzz can come from a landmark-level "arrived near the meeting landmark" status: each side checks its own distance to the landmark on its own phone. It can also come from UWB.
   - So "服务器上没有任何坐标" (backend_supabase.md:20) and README.md:56 can both hold. Ruling out continuous position exchange does not create a problem with no answer.

2. **The prototype is already labelled as simulated.** In the demo, the partner moves along a route built from landmark positions (AppStore+Find.swift:56-57), and the "N 米" figure and arrow come from that made-up route (:74-91). docs/prototype_status.md:21 already says 对方的位置是模拟的 and 超宽带测距要真机. That is a fair disclosure for a single-device demo with no backend, which is the agreed approach.

3. **The proposed fix would overturn a fixed decision.** It changes README:56 to add 除咗約好咗當日搵人期間 and suggests sending rough positions over a Realtime channel. "街坊只在出门时、只以地标级位置出现" is one of the decisions that cannot be changed, so by the rules this report counts as not real.

4. **What is left is minor.** backend_supabase.md §5 has no row for F8, and the 我喺涼亭 broadcast in broadcastHere() (AppStore+Find.swift) only speaks on the local phone; it does not go through CommunityService. That is a small gap in the design notes for a backend that is deliberately not being built in this phase. It is not the location-privacy conflict the report describes.

rejected.title: 家附近约 560 m 范围会发给第三方 Overpass 镜像（包括 maps.mail.ru），README 却写「400 m 网格」
rejected.reason:
The facts in the report are right, but they don't amount to a privacy or honesty problem.

1) Box size vs. "400 m": TileKey.bboxString (Geo.swift:71-76) builds a 560 m box from plinthSize. That box is calculated only from the 400 m grid cell. It is centred on the cell centre, which is rounded from the user's position (Geo.swift:59-62). So a server that sees the box learns exactly as much as the 400 m cell, and nothing more precise. The request body is only estate.overpassql with {{bbox}} filled in: no precise coordinates and no ID. The README:54 promise that only the 400 m grid area is sent, never the exact position, is true in substance. A larger box gives away less, not more. At most this is loose wording, with no effect on privacy.

2) The mirrors: overpass-api.de, maps.mail.ru and overpass.private.coffee are all public Overpass map services. README:54 says the area goes to a "地图服务" (map service), and that covers all three. The two backups are only tried after the main server fails twice. They get the same box as the main server, and the main server is also a third party. Any network request carries an IP address, and the weather request does too. That is not a new leak.

3) Rules: spec §4 asks for informed consent about "谁能看到什么" (who can see what), and in context that means other residents. The consent page (Onboarding.swift:155-158) promises that positions are shown as landmarks and only to residents who have bumped phones. Neither promise is broken. The location permission text (project.pbxproj:260) gives the purpose truthfully, and nothing in the spec or Apple's rules says it must name the map servers. "對外只講地標" (only landmarks are shared outward) there is about the route and about other people. prototype_status.md:13 already documents the live Overpass fetch.

So there is no spec breach, no false claim, and no extra privacy exposure. Choosing which mirrors to keep is a separate decision (the related A28), not a privacy bug. Verdict: not real.

rejected.title: 拉时间滑杆会把今日约会永久标成过期，或提前用掉提醒
rejected.reason:
The code does what the report says, but that behavior is intended and documented, so it is not a defect.

What the code does: setDemoHour (AppStore+Map.swift:181-186) calls checkAppointments. checkAppointments (AppStore+Meetup.swift:239-254) uses `now`, which is the demo hour when one is set. It fires the 30-minute reminder and marks an appointment .expired once it is more than an hour past. `appointments` saves itself on every change (AppStore.swift:55).

Why that is not a bug:
(1) Only the demo menu opens the time slider: "演示" → "天氣同時間" → "時間…" (UI/Demo.swift:36). It is a demo control that simulates time passing, not a view-only tool.
(2) The main demo relies on it. DemoScript.swift:140-141 (-script3) calls setDemoHour(16.6) to show the departure reminder and setDemoHour(18.2) to show expiry. docs/prototype_status.md:20 says the reminder 30 minutes before departure and the automatic「過咗期」are "全部存盘" (all saved), and README.md:29 lists -script3 as showing 出发提醒 and 过期. Running reminders and expiry in memory only, as the report suggests, would go against the documented behavior.
(3) In the single-device demo every partner is a 示範 resident. The demo menu's 「重置演示」 (resetDemoData, AppStore+Persist.swift:105-113) clears every appointment with a demo resident, so the demo can be reset and nothing is lost for good.
(4) The rule the report cites ("用来看画面的工具不应修改数据", a view-only tool should not change data) is not in the spec or in the agreed decisions.

The resume sub-claim (Community.swift:111 compares against the real Date()) only triggers if all of these hold: the app was launched with -hour, it is killed within the 3-4 seconds after an invite is sent, and the real clock is already past the appointment time. Even then the appointment expires the next day once checkAppointments runs. This is too marginal to count as a spec violation.

rejected.title: F2 圈：示範成员被轮流分到附近各座楼，没有「刚入伙按同一座楼分圈」，也不支持一人多圈
rejected.reason: 规格 F2 原文（docs/产品定稿_康乐社交App_v1.0.md:46-51）最后一条写的是「原型阶段使用预设的分组」。「≥3 个落脚点重合归圈」「刚入伙按同一座楼分圈」「一人多圈」这几条，都要靠多用户的真实落脚点数据，或者靠后端的 circles / circle_members 表，属于正式版规则。原型阶段规格本身就允许用预设分组代替。现在的做法是 LocalCommunityService.circleMembers（ios/StreetWalk/Store/Community.swift:83-93）返回固定 6 人的示範名单，正好就是这种预设分组。docs/prototype_status.md:15 也写明了「按规格"原型阶段用预设分组"：示範街坊 6 人」，文档和代码一致。另外，「单机演示 + CommunityService 预留接口，不做 Supabase」是已定的决定，按真实数据分圈、一人多圈这类功能本来就留到后端版本。docs/backend_supabase.md:138 已经把 circleMembers 映射为 `circle_id in (我的圈)`，接口层也留了多圈的位置。示範街坊分到附近几座楼，只影响演示角色的座数怎么显示，不违反任何规格条文。按规则，这类问题判为不成立。

rejected.title: §8 接口签名偏离规格且没有记录：getShade 只接时刻、不接时段，createNeighbor 没有成功或失败结果
rejected.reason:
I'm rejecting this one: each of its three points either clashes with a decision already made or has no observable effect.

1. **Signatures differ from §8.** That is true, but the spec expected it. §8 lists interface names and meanings only and says the input/output examples will be filled in on day 1 (docs/产品定稿_康乐社交App_v1.0.md:206). Contracts.swift was written on day 1 (commit e8dee28, 2026-10-06, "§8 接口") as that filled-in version. Every B interface also differs from the §8 sketch, not just the ones the report names. Examples: dailyLine(walk) became dailyLine(for:passed:), walkAdvice(userId,date) became walkAdvice(weather:now:shadeTip:), and monthlyReport(estateId,month) became monthlyReport(placeName:reports:landmarks:stats:). So the code is the agreed baseline, not an unrecorded change. The only changes made later (10-07: changeMeetup, cancelMeetup, stats) are already marked 待 B 确认 in Contracts.swift:13 and :36 and in README.md:47.

2. **getShade takes one moment, not a time slot.** Appointment (Models.swift:46) has only a start `date` and no length, so there is no slot to average over. Reading shade for the 15-minute block at the meeting time is a precision trade-off. The settled decision says shade only needs to be "大致准确" and that shade accuracy gives way to the visual style. Treating this as a defect would overturn that decision.

3. **createNeighbor returns nothing.** B never calls it. A's remind-prompt buttons call it (Cards.swift:319, 327), and so does DemoScript. B's BumpService only reports success through onFound. The spoken confirmation happens in A's startBump (AppStore+Neighbors.swift:13), before createNeighbor runs. There is no server and no pairing code, because the app is a single-device demo with no Supabase (a settled decision). So the failure case the report describes ("server rejects the pairing code") cannot happen in this build.

4. **parseVoice takes text instead of audio.** That interface belongs to B. Speech recognition (Voice/) and parsing (AI/) are both B's code, so A's screens are unaffected.

No behaviour breaks and no rule is violated. At most this is a documentation nit.

rejected.title: 主界面的读屏顺序没有设定，咪和设置按钮排在内容后面
rejected.reason:
I couldn't confirm this one, so it's judged not real. It doesn't conflict with a decided item. The core premise is that SwiftUI reads elements in the order they're declared. That premise is doubtful. Within one accessibility container, SwiftUI orders siblings by on-screen position, top-left to bottom-right. Apple's WWDC21 guidance on accessibility containers relies on this. It's also why `BottomCardSlot` (MainView.swift:582) uses `.accessibilityElement(children: .contain)` to keep a card's contents together.

Mapped to the actual frames in MainView.swift:99-156, position-based ordering gives this sequence:
- the banner (when shown)
- the settings button or walk-time chip at the top-left, at `safeTop+gap`
- the demo pill at the top-right
- the scene name tags, which avoid the top strip and the mic (Overlays.swift `placed()` checks the reserved rectangles)
- the mic, whose top edge is at `sceneH - micSize/2`
- the tab title, starting at `sceneH+12`
- the content
- the tab bar

That already follows the visual and task order. Settings does not come after the content, and the mic does not come after the tab bar.

The focus-jumping claim for scene name tags is also unproven. Tags are only added or removed when they overlap or when items change, and nothing shows VoiceOver focus actually jumping. The spec's general requirements (§4) don't mention screen-reader order either. prototype_status.md:24 does say the reading order hasn't been checked screen by screen by hand. That is an open item already recorded honestly, not proof of a defect. Nothing was run, so there is no runtime evidence. Under "when unsure, judge real=false", this is not real.

rejected.title: 小人因换颜色或行动方式重建后不再移动
rejected.reason:
The code does what the report says, but no user can reach it today. In DioramaController.swift:568-583, a node rebuilt after a color or mobility change only gets apply(p.motion) when old?.motion != p.motion. But no reachable state shows a wrong result:
(1) Other residents' color and mobility come from a fixed list in Store/Community.swift:78-81 and never change. Only "me" can change, and only through setAvatar in UI/Settings.swift:117.
(2) The only entry to Settings is the gear in HomeChip. HomeChip shows the gear only when walk == nil (UI/MainView.swift:320-340), and topChips is hidden while find is full screen (MainView.swift:112-116).
(3) The reported example, a fixed route while finding someone, cannot happen with Settings reachable. goFind only runs during a walk (Tabs.swift:99; the banner action only when walk != nil; the card button calls goFind directly but only during a walk), and the gear is hidden then. departForAppointment and startGoing switch straight to findFullScreen, which hides the gear.
(4) In the states where the gear does show, "me" uses .stand: the find asking/declined stages and bump .found (AppStore+Map.swift:152,161). For .stand, startPoint is the target point itself, so the rebuilt node already stands in the right place.
(5) Settings could already be open when a walk starts. In the demo walk, tickWalk never calls syncScene, so remainingRoute always differs from the last stored motion and apply still runs. In a real-device walk, remainingRoute is a single point (travelled = pathLength), so standing still is correct.
(6) DemoScript opens Settings only at step 62 of script3, with no walk or find running, and never calls setAvatar.
So this is a latent defensive gap, not a visible behavior bug.
